title: AVP, Claims Strategy and Process Innovation – Remote
description:
Symetra is seeking an AVP, Claims Strategy and Process Innovation to help shape the future of our Group Benefits Claims organization. This leader will drive claims transformation by modernizing systems, optimizing operations, and advancing innovative solutions that improve customer outcomes and position the business for sustainable growth.

About the role

As the AVP, Claims Strategy and Process Innovation, you will serve as a strategic leader focused on transforming disability and absence management operations through technology, process excellence, automation, and data-driven decision making. You will partner closely with Claims, Technology, Product, Compliance, Legal, and Operations leaders to improve business performance, elevate the customer experience, and support enterprise growth objectives.

What You will Do

  • Lead the strategy and roadmap for claims transformation, process innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Partner across Claims, Technology, Product, Compliance, and Legal teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Serve as the business lead for major claims system initiatives, including FINEOS enhancements, implementations, and modernization efforts.
  • Drive process improvement and automation opportunities that simplify operations and reduce complexity.
  • Translate business needs into future-state operating models, technology solutions, and transformational initiatives.
  • Establish metrics, governance practices, and reporting frameworks to measure business impact and operational performance.
  • Lead organizational readiness efforts, including change management, stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption strategies.
  • Leverage data and operational insights to identify opportunities, solve business challenges, and improve claims outcomes.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure the organization remains competitive and positioned for future growth.
  • Influence strategic priorities and investment decisions through strong partnerships with executive leadership.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Modern, scalable claims capabilities that support business growth.
  • Simplified processes and increased operational efficiency through automation and innovation.
  • Successful adoption of new technologies and business processes.
  • Improved customer, claimant, and employee experiences.
  • Strong partnerships across business and technology functions.
  • Measurable improvements in productivity, service quality, and operational performance.
  • A culture that embraces innovation, change, and continuous improvement.

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:

"Everyone that works here wants to be here and enjoys their job here. We work as a team and are definitely swift to serve our customers as well as EE's!!" - Julie M., Regional Manager

“I chose Symetra because I heard it was a pro-employee company—and it’s absolutely true. The work environment is supportive, the people are great, and the benefits are generous. Symetra truly cares about its employees. The relaxed atmosphere and opportunities to learn and grow—both within your role and beyond—make it a great place to build your career.” - Alicia L., Claims Examiner

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out our Symetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $141,600 - $236,000 plus eligibility for annual bonus program and long-term incentive plan

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of leadership experience in disability, absence management, employee benefits, or claims operations required.
  • 10+ years working with FINEOS claims platforms required.
  • A strategic claims or absence management leader with deep expertise in disability and leave administration.
  • Experienced in leading large-scale operational transformation, process improvement, and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Recognized for building strong partnerships and influencing outcomes across complex organizations.
  • Skilled at leveraging data, analytics, and operational insights to drive business performance and customer outcomes.
  • Knowledgeable in FMLA, ADA, ERISA, Paid Family & Medical Leave programs, and related regulations.
  • An effective communicator who can translate complex business needs into practical solutions and drive organizational change.
  • Passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences while improving operational effectiveness.
  • Industry certifications related to disability management, absence administration, or claims leadership preferred.
  • Strong relationships and industry presence within the group benefits and absence management marketplace.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred. High school diploma required.
  • Ability to travel occasionally as business needs require.

Travel:

Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.

Reasonable Accommodations
Symetra is committed to providing equitable access to all job-related responsibilities, including required travel. If reasonable accommodations are needed for travel, Symetra’s HR department will work to provide appropriate solutions in alignment with individual needs and company policies.

We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.
Identity Verification
Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Direct Surfaces Team’s mission is to make it delightful for users to manage their money. We’re rebuilding and unbundling the core of Stripe so that no matter what the business, the location or use‑case there is a single place that can fulfil all financial needs: Stripe Treasury.   • Have experience in ensuring great user experience and ease of use of features and products you build

Preferred qualifications

  • Have experience using React Native
  • Have experience in ensuring great user experience and ease of use of features for products you build.
  • Have experience with financial product companies and interest in financial products and markets

title: Asset Protection Specialist
description:
Job Posting Title:

Asset Protection Specialist

Req ID:

10161634

Job Description:

At Disney, we are storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts, and a cruise line to sports, news, movies, and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we are constantly looking for new ways to enhance and protect these exciting experiences!


We are seeking an Asset Protection Specialist to aid the Disney Store Cast in supporting a safe and secure environment for Cast Members and Guests! This is accomplished through proactive deterrence, identification, and resolution associated with suspicious activity and potential unsafe behaviors.


What You Will Do…

  • Acts as a visible deterrent to potential risk at store entrances/exits and throughout site maintaining high visibility, monitoring for, responding to and escalating incidents of suspicious activity, unsafe behaviors and other potential workplace security concerns
  • Conducts onsite security/safety inspections in person (and via CCTV where applicable), responding to and escalating identified risks to Store Leadership and Corporate Asset Protection (Loss Prevention)/Safety
  • Supports emergency preparedness and crisis response programs to help mitigate potential impacts, support Cast and Guest needs and promote a risk adverse culture
  • Supports Store Leadership with deterrence and response to aggressive theft activity/organized retail crime, escalated Guest interactions and assists store Cast with response to Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS) activations when needed
  • Conducts 24/7 camera and alarm monitoring (where applicable), related incident notification, investigation, trend analysis and case management documentation
  • Conducts Cast Member and vendor site access security screening related to bag/package/coat inspections
  • Acts as law enforcement liaison and security/safety point of contact for regional industry and TWDC partners at the direction of Corporate Asset Protection/Safety
  • Demonstrates and acts in accordance with Disney values, behaviors and guidelines
  • Utilizes specialized training related to Retail Counter-Terrorism and TWDC Workplace Security Programs to identify, deter and report associated activity such as but not limited to aggressive/escalated behavior, civil unrest protests, imminent threat, terrorism, etc.


Here’s what you will need to be successful in this role…

  • +3 year of Asset Protection /Loss Prevention/Security experience within a retail environment or the Hospitality field
  • Attention to detail, ability to prioritize and tasks
  • Demonstrated time management and organizational skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated success in working in a team environment
  • Job may require lifting boxes that weigh up to 40 pounds and climbing a ladder
  • Must be able to provide full availability to work any schedule on Friday, Saturday and Sunday along with a few shifts during the week OR full availability


It would be a plus if you had these skills…

  • +5 years Asset Protection /Loss Prevention/Security experience within a retail environment
  • Has a thorough understanding of Loss Prevention and Security procedures, regulations and practices
  • Has an understanding of basic Safety practices and procedures and working knowledge and experience utilizing retail CCTV systems​
  • New York State Security license

Education is important to us, here is what we are looking for…

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Preferred degree within Criminal Justice, Public Safety, or similar related fields

title: Backend Engineer - Product Eligibility
description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

Job Description

We’re unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship for this role. Candidates will need to already be based in the UK (or able to work from the UK). Product Eligibility team is a fairly new team that was formed under Regional Platform Squad. We are one of the longest-running squads in the company building the platform for the core domains of Wise - Transfer, Payout and Partner Integrations. Besides that we are supporting product teams to extend the Platform capabilities for the new products and the new markets.

Product Eligibility team's main goal is to help Wise accurately determine which products and features are available to a particular customer.

To achieve this, we need to make sure we have a clear understanding of where our customers reside or operate business. As such, one of the first big challenges the team will tackle is overhauling of how Wise captures and validates customer's residence, present location and address information.

How we work

We work in an agile fashion, with engineers closely collaborating with the product manager, and the analyst. The team operates across our London and Cherkasy offices.

What will you be working on?

You will be part of an autonomous team, driving the technical vision for the owned domain. Contributing to the platform, back office tooling and episodically to the customer-facing flows. You will help us scale-up and build a world class transfer product.

Qualifications

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more, we do want to hear from you!

  • You have experience working with large scale distributed systems
  • You have years of Java 8+ knowledge
  • You have experience working with relational and non-relational databases, query optimisation and designing schemas
  • You have experience in designing, deploying and maintaining clean RESTful APIs
  • You believe in and follow best coding practices, code reviews and open feedback
  • You enjoy writing testable code and believe in Test Driven Development

Nice to have:

  • You have experience with Spring boot

title: Optician - The Village at Newtown
description:
Warby Parker is searching for skilled and enthusiastic Opticians to join our growing team of in-house optical all-stars and play an integral part in what we're all about-helping people see! In this role, you'll become an expert in our brand and our glasses (take a peek at how they're made). Whether you're helping longtime Warby Parker fans or first-time wearers, you'll deliver

extraordinary customer service to leave them excited and confident about our glasses. Along the way, you'll partner with motivated, collaborative individuals who take their work (but not themselves) seriously. You'll also expand your current skill set with a slew of career-advancing resources and benefits. Our ideal candidate is a lifelong learner who's eager to help WarbyParker grow. Sound a lot like you? Wonderful-read on!

What you'll do

● Work directly with customers to help meet all of their eyewear needs

● Take and record measurements, adjust and fit eyewear, and execute these details with flawless accuracy

● Check that our finished eyewear meets our optical standards, as well as customer requirements and requests

● Use your expertise to explain prescription terminology and product offerings to customers

● Work with your team to make sure all customers receive exceptional service

● Help customers choose the best frames and lenses based on their prescription needs, face fit, personal style, and lifestyle

● Collaborate with your team to form best practices for sales and customer service that can be implemented throughout the organization

● Represent our brand to help educate others and get them excited about our values and mission

Who you are

● A licensed dispensing optician in states that require a license (or an ABO-certified optician in non-licensing states)

● Passionate about the eyewear and retail industries

● A clear, effective, and professional communicator-you can break down technical terms for customers to easily understand

● Dedicated to going above-and-beyond to make customers (and your teammates!) happy

● An energetic, positive team player who's able to adapt in a fast-paced, ever-changing work environment

● Extremely detail-oriented and capable of juggling a wide range of responsibilities

● Open-minded-you're constantly learning and challenging what you know

● Someone who takes your work very seriously, but not yourself

title: Controller
description:
Duties/Responsibilities of the Controller:

  • Directs and manages the Accounting Department’s daily operations related to the general ledger, receivables, payables and payroll.
  • Manage the company’s treasury function, receivables and bank borrowing base reports.
  • Mentors, coaches and develops accounting management and staff accountants through effective delegation of accounting duties and special projects.
  • Develops and maintains effective working relationships with all departments of the company including creating and maintaining service level standards for delivery of accounting related services throughout the company.

  • Establishes, implements and communicates accounting policies and procedures to company.

  • Develops, implements and monitors effectiveness of internal controls and associated documentation and processes. Work directly with sales and operations person to identify and implement revenue enhancing and cost reduction projects.

  • Detailed knowledge of ERP, implementation experience preferred.
  • Direct operations experience is preferred

  • CPA, and job costing or auditing experience is preferred

title: Data Engineer - Airflow/AWS/Python
description:

Location: Madrid Spain

Rate:30-34 Eurios an hour

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with a minimum of 3 years' commercial experience to join our data engineering team. The successful candidate will have strong hands‑on experience with AWS, Apache Airflow and Python, together with a good understanding of data quality and production data pipelines.

You will work closely with senior data engineers and the wider technology team, providing operational support and helping to ensure our data pipelines are reliable, scalable and fit for purpose.

  • Monitor day‑to‑day pipeline performance and investigate failures or data issues.

  • Troubleshoot production data pipeline issues and implement appropriate fixes.
  • Contribute to data quality initiatives, including identifying, monitoring and resolving data quality issues.
  • Implement data validation and quality checks across pipelines and datasets.
  • Support continuous improvements to pipeline reliability, performance and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, analysts and other stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Follow engineering best practices around testing, documentation, version control and deployment.
  • Participate in incident resolution and root‑cause analysis where required.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Data Engineering or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands‑on Python development experience.
  • Practical experience with AWS cloud technologies and services.
  • Strong experience using Apache Airflow to develop and manage data workflows.
  • Experience working with production data pipelines and supporting operational environments.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering or contributing to data quality projects.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills.
  • Understanding of data engineering principles, ETL/ELT processes and data pipeline architecture.
  • Experience working with relational databases and SQL.
  • Familiarity with Git and standard software development practices.
  • Ability to work effectively with senior technical colleagues and provide reliable day‑to‑day operational support.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Redshift or CloudWatch.
  • Experience with data quality or data observability tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure‑as‑code technologies such as Terraform.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Experience with large-scale or cloud‑based data platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving ability.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Comfortable working in a production environment where reliability is important.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly around data accuracy and quality.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with senior team members.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve existing processes.
  • Able to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of delivery.

title: Junior Program Analyst / Reporting
description:
Overview

Steampunk is seeking a Junior Program Analyst to support recurring, statutory-cadence program reporting for a large federal advisory program.

  • Support quarterly risk register updates
  • Maintain the issue log and escalation report, updated continuously and submitted with each monthly status report

  • Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills

Preferred

description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
FirstLight is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to support data engineering, reporting, and business analytics activities within a fiber telecommunications environment. This role will focus on building and maintaining and developing dashboards and reports in Power BI and partnering directly with business stakeholders to turn data into actionable insight across the business.

Summary:

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analytics function through data pipeline scoping, dashboard design and development, and business partnership. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a modern cloud data warehouse, building and maintaining Power BI reports, and working and influencing stakeholders to optimal solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform data modeling within Snowflake and Power BI to support scalable, reusable, and performant reporting layers.
  • Monitor data quality and pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data integrity issues.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations in Power BI that surface KPIs and business-critical metrics.
  • Write efficient SQL queries against Snowflake to support ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs.
  • Apply strong dashboard design principles to make complex data intuitive and actionable for non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, pain points, and the questions they need to answer
  • Combine technical output with subject-matter context to deliver insights and recommendations, not just numbers.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the business's model, competitive landscape, and key drivers so analysis is grounded in real business context.
  • Ensure data used in reporting and pipelines is accurate, secure, and compliant with applicable regulations and internal governance guidelines.
  • Document data sources, transformation logic, and report definitions for maintainability and knowledge-sharing.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data model accuracy, and overall analytics team efficiency.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Business, Finance, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 2-4 years of relevant experience in data engineering, business intelligence, or business/data analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse), including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.
  • Strong Power BI development skills, including data modeling (DAX), dashboard/report design, and data source connectivity.
  • Proficiency in SQL; familiarity with ETL/ELT tools and data pipeline concepts.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data findings to business outcomes and communicate with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including presenting to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and manage expectations across business units.
  • Ability to work autonomously, support ad hoc requests, and adapt shifting priorities

About FirstLight:

FirstLight, headquartered in Albany, New York, provides fiber-optic data, Internet, data center, cloud and voice services to enterprise and carrier customers throughout the Northeast connecting more than 13,000 locations in service with more than 125,000 locations serviceable by our more than 25,000-route mile network. FirstLight offers a robust suite of advanced telecommunications products featuring a comprehensive portfolio of high bandwidth connectivity solutions including Ethernet, wavelength, and dark fiber services as well as dedicated Internet access solutions, data center, cloud and voice services. FirstLight's clientele includes national cellular providers and wireline carriers and many leading enterprises, spanning high tech manufacturing and research, hospitals and healthcare, banking and financial, secondary education, colleges and universities, and local and state governments.

title: Fleet Coordinator
description:
Job Overview

The Fleet Coordinator supports the day-to-day administration and coordination of Gateway's fleet operations. This position maintains accurate fleet records, coordinates routine vehicle lifecycle activities, and develops collaborative working relationships with Care Center leadership, vendors, and internal partners to support fleet operations, resolve day-to-day issues, and help keep vehicles compliant, properly documented, and operationally ready. The Fleet Coordinator performs work within established procedures and approval authorities and escalates exceptions, significant cost or risk concerns, and unresolved issues to the Fleet Manager.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate day-to-day fleet operational and administrative activities, including but not limited to vehicle registrations and renewals, fleet system updates (e.g., Fleetio, Geotab, WEX, and other fleet systems), management of Fleetio Issues and follow-up activities, responding to Care Center requests, and ensuring activities are completed in accordance with established policies, procedures, and approval requirements.
  • Maintain accurate fleet records and documentation and coordinate administrative activities for existing, new, and transferred vehicles by creating, updating, and verifying information within applicable fleet systems and files, while partnering with Care Centers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to support vehicle readiness and lifecycle activities.
  • Monitor vehicle lifecycle activities by tracking order, delivery, registration, inspection, maintenance, repair, and other fleet-related status information; communicating updates; and following up on missing, overdue, or inaccurate information.
  • Coordinate vehicle maintenance and repair activities by reviewing repair estimates and maintenance records; communicating with repair vendors to clarify service recommendations, resolve billing and service issues, document approvals, monitor vehicle downtime, coordinate roadside assistance, towing, and rental vehicles as needed, provide maintenance reminders, and escalate issues outside established approval authority.
  • Support vehicle transfers, lease returns, and disposals by coordinating required documentation, confirming approvals, updating fleet systems and records, communicating next steps, and tracking activities through completion.
  • Administer assigned fuel card, PIN, transponder, and related fleet programs, including setup, assignment, replacement, record updates, issue resolution, and deactivation, as applicable.
  • Provide responsive service and guidance to Care Center leadership, drivers, vendors, and internal partners by responding to routine inquiries, coordinating requests, and routing or escalating matters that fall outside established procedures or authority.
  • Participate in cross-training, process improvement initiatives, fleet procedure implementation, and team coverage during absences, workload fluctuations, or special projects.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education or training in business administration, fleet operations, transportation, automotive services, or a related field is preferred.
  • Prior experience in fleet administration, transportation, automotive service, office coordination, vendor support, customer service, or a related operational environment is preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company driving requirements when operation of a company vehicle is required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong organizational and administrative skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, records, and follow-up activities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work professionally with employees, leaders, vendors, and external service providers.
  • Working knowledge of fleet, vehicle maintenance, registration, insurance, fuel, toll, telematics, or related processes, or the ability to learn these processes.
  • Ability to interpret and follow policies, procedures, approval requirements, and system workflows; sound judgment to recognize when escalation is required.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to accurate, complete, and timely documentation.
  • Customer-service orientation with practical research, problem-solving, and issue-resolution skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively as part of a team and providing backup coverage across assigned areas.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or related productivity tools; ability to learn and use fleet management and vendor platforms.
  • Ability to handle company and employee information appropriately and maintain confidentiality.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

  • Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote-office environment and involves prolonged periods of sitting, computer use, telephone communication, and repetitive hand and finger movement.
  • Occasional visits to Care Centers, vehicle locations, vendors, or service facilities may be required.
  • The position may require responding to time-sensitive fleet issues during normal business hours and, on an infrequent basis, outside normal hours when business needs warrant.

title: Senior Linux Software Engineer (US Citizenship Required)
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

Job Summary

The Sr. Linux Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain applications and embedded software for advanced analytical instrumentation systems. This role spans the full software development lifecycle and requires expertise in Linux-based embedded systems, application development, instrument control, and software architecture for complex scientific products.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and embedded systems throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field strongly preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • 8+ years of software development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux development, including Linux system configuration, Bash scripting, Yocto/BitBake, Linux kernel and driver development, device trees, U-Boot, software package management, and deployment/update frameworks such as SWUpdate.
  • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, and object-oriented software design.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.
  • Experience developing software for embedded systems and distributed architectures.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threaded programming, debugging, and software security principles.
  • Programming experience in C and C++; Rust experience is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, if required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Blazor, WebSockets, and GraphQL.
  • Experience with Docker or other containerization technologies.
  • Experience with instrumentation control, scientific instruments, or mass spectrometry systems.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Familiarity with electro-mechanical systems and hardware integration.
  • Experience using Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) in a development environment.

title: Tech & Engineering Investment Consultant

Vacker Sten are a technology and engineering-focused investment consultancy that works at the intersection of technology, engineering, innovation, and investment. We help venture capital firms and private equity investors evaluate technology-driven companies and engineering startups by combining technical expertise with commercial and financial perspectives.

Our work involves understanding complex technologies, assessing engineering capabilities, identifying opportunities for digital transformation, and translating technical findings into clear insights that support investment and business decisions.

What you will do

As a Tech & Engineering Investment Consultant, you will work with venture capital firms, private equity investors, technology companies, and engineering startups to evaluate technologies, businesses, products, and investment opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assessing engineering startups, technology companies, products, and investment opportunities from a technical and operational perspective.

  • Conducting technical due diligence and identifying opportunities, limitations, risks, and areas requiring further investigation.

  • Researching emerging technologies, engineering trends, startups, and technology markets.

  • Communicating technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Working independently on technical analyses while collaborating with investors, founders, engineers, and other specialists.

Work at the intersection of technology and investment

  • Gain exposure to emerging technologies, business models, and rapidly evolving industries.

Turn technical expertise into business impact

  • Help investors understand complex technologies and engineering risks.

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reflect the technical, analytical, and commercial responsibilities of the role.

Compensation

We are looking for candidates who combine strong technical or engineering understanding with analytical thinking and an interest in business and investment.

Experience in engineering, R&D, product development, technical consulting, investment analysis, technical due diligence, digital transformation, AI, automation, or startup environments would be valuable.

Please submit your CV and cover letter outlining your technical background, analytical experience, and interest in technology investment and consulting to Moon-suck.song@panagora.se before October 26 2026.

title: Tool Room Technician

description:
1. Position Information

Office/Unit/Project

UNDP Türkiye

Climate Change and Environment Portfolio

EU Partnership for Local Climate Action in Türkiye Project
Title Project Associate
Level NPSA-7

Type (Regular or Short term) Regular
Office- or Home-based Office
Expected starting date 1 November 2026
Expected Duration 6 Months, with possibility of renewal based on the satisfactory performance and availability of funding
Position Number 224128

2. Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP is the UN's global development network, an organization advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience and resources to help people build a better life.

UNDP positions itself as a development partner that brings global knowledge, through a multi-sectoral approach – the key comparative advantage of UNDP - and concentrates its work on 3 programmatic fields: i) Inclusive and Sustainable Growth, ii) Inclusive and Democratic Governance, iii) Climate Change and Environment (CCE).

CCE Portfolio focuses on three programmatic areas that complement each other: 1-Natural Resource Management contributing to sustainable environment management and conservation of natural resources in production landscapes, within the general framework of the ecosystems approach; 2- Climate Change and Disaster Resilience (including chemicals and waste) strengthening institutional capacities for analysis and risk management for resilience with a specific emphasis on climate change, and 3- Cooperation with relevant stakeholders to promote energy efficiency and renewable energy.

The European Union and the Government of Türkiye are jointly implementing the 'EU Partnership for Local Climate Action in Türkiye' project, in a bid to bolster local climate action and guide the nation towards a future that is both climate-resilient and low-carbon. Working closely with the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change (MoEUCC), local authorities, and key stakeholders, the project focuses on enhancing capacities at different levels of governance and society.

The Project;

  • aims to enhance climate risk assessment capacity. It focuses on bolstering the preparedness of local authorities to tackle climate change impacts by conducting comprehensive vulnerability and risk assessments.
  • is directed towards improving local climate planning capacity. The aim here is to provide a regulatory framework for developing Local Climate Change Action Plans (LCCAPs), and pilot the creation of these plans in select municipalities.
  • targets the enhancement of local decision-making and implementation capacities for climate action. Interactive tools developed as part of this component, integrated into the online national climate portal, will arm local stakeholders with vital resources to make informed decisions and effectively execute climate action plans.
  • is designed to improve public awareness, enhance local stakeholder capabilities, and foster collaboration to implement climate actions. Through tailored capacity-building programs and awareness-raising initiatives, this component aims to equip municipalities and local stakeholders with the tools and knowledge needed to design and implement effective climate change actions.

The Projet Associate (PA) will be assigned full time for the whole project’s duration. PA will assist the Project Manager in fulfilling his/her duties and tasks. The PA shall be responsible for supporting day-to-day implementation of project activities, drafting progress reports and output related substantial documentation as well as liaising with the EUD as well as national and international stakeholders at the institutional level. PA will also provide assistance to other key experts or relevant stakeholders, as deemed necessary by the Project Manager. PA will report to the Project Manager.

3. Scope of Work

Under the supervision of the Project Manager, the Project Associate is responsible for efficient and timely implementation of the activities referred in the project document and the associated work plan. S/he is also expected to support project planning and AWP formulation as well as quality check of the technical reports and other outcomes. S/he will maintain high standards of service delivery, including adherence to deadline, quick response time, accuracy and completeness of information, sensitivity to client needs.

Project planning and AWP formulation:

• Support the preparation of AWPs of the Project.

• Support the preparation of the annual budgets and procurement plans of the Project under the coordination of Project Manager and Projects Implementation Administrator.

• Make periodic revisions of AWPs and procurement plans of the Project in consultation with the Project Manager.

Timely and effective implementation of the project

• Provides general administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the project management.

• Provides project logistic support to the Project Manager and short term consultants in conducting different project activities (trainings, workshops, stakeholder consultations, arrangements of study tour, etc.).

• Supports the control of budget expenditures by preparing payment documents, travel related documents for the project staff and reviewing financial reports.

• Controls the usage of non-expendable equipment (record keeping, drawing up regular inventories).

• Keeps regular contact with project experts and consultants to inform them about the project details and changes.

• Provides English translation as required.

• Provides logistical support to the project staff and project consultants, inter alia, for travel arrangements.

• During the visits of foreign experts, manages their visa support, transportation, hotel accommodation etc.

• Supports project experts during implementation and monitoring of site-based joint activities with local stakeholders.

• Files and archives all relevant correspondence and project related documents (tender dossiers, proposals, technical reports, evaluation reports etc.).

• Plans and organizes implementation of project activities according to AWP and project budget. Coordinates implementation with, and between, the project partners ensuring effective information flows between partners.

• Organizes the Project Steering Committee meetings.

• Organizes and coordinates project meetings, reviews and site visits.

• Organizes project events (meetings, workshops, events, seminars, training).

• Monitors timetable and performance of contractors (consultants, companies) and makes necessary amendments thereto.

• Monitors bottlenecks and problems in project implementation, proposes/takes necessary corrective actions as required.

• Prepares inputs to APR and compile project reports according to the project document (monthly reports, quarterly reports, donor reports, final report).

• Drafts correspondence, notes, briefs and other materials and documentation.

Project inputs administered timely and efficiently according to project plans and UNDP procedures

• Prepares inputs to procurement related documents such as ToR/RFP/RFQ/ITB,etc.

• Assists in evaluation of bid and offers, compiles and prepares necessary documentation.

• Assists in selection of project experts and consultants and participates in selection process.

• Prepares documents related to HACT framework such as Direct Payments (RDPs) for signature.

• Provide assistance in formulation of expectations, duties and deliverables of the experts and companies as necessary.

• Provide support in reviewing and providing feedback on the technical reports submitted by the contractors of the project.

• Assist in ensuring that the deliverables submitted by the contractors of the project are in alignment with the defined deliverables in the ToRs.

4. Institutional Arrangement

Project Associate will report to the Project Manager and work in close co-operation with the Projects Implementation Administrator to ensure the project inputs are administered timely and efficient manner according to UNDP rules and procedures. The Project Associate will be expected to be present on the premises of the Directorate of Climate Change of the Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change during the expected days of the weekdays.

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

description:
(English version below)


Explorance est à la recherche d’un(e) directeur(trice) de l’assurance qualité expérimenté(e) pour diriger notre fonction d’assurance qualité et faire évoluer la façon dont la qualité est intégrée à notre cycle de développement logiciel.


En étroite collaboration avec les leaders de l’Ingénierie et du Produit, vous définirez notre stratégie d’assurance qualité, renforcerez l’automatisation des tests, ferez évoluer nos pratiques et dirigerez une équipe hautement performante. Nous recherchons un(e) leader qui combine expertise technique, vision stratégique et solides compétences en gestion d’équipe.


Vos responsabilités

  • Fournir un leadership technique face aux enjeux de test complexes et participer aux discussions pertinentes sur l’architecture et l’ingénierie.
  • Superviser la capacité de l’équipe QA, les priorités et la préparation aux mises en production.
  • Diriger, accompagner et développer l’équipe QA tout en favorisant une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration et d’amélioration continue.


Ce que nous recherchons

  • Expérience significative en assurance qualité, en ingénierie de la qualité ou en tests logiciels, incluant de l’expérience dans un poste de leadership senior en QA.
  • Solides connaissances techniques en ingénierie logicielle et en pratiques modernes de développement.
  • Expérience démontrée dans le développement ou l’évolution de stratégies QA et de cadres d’automatisation.
  • Solide expérience en automatisation des tests pour les API et les applications Web complexes.
  • Expérience en gestion et en développement d’équipes techniques.
  • Solide connaissance des méthodologies de test et des pratiques exemplaires en ingénierie de la qualité.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en collaboration et en influence.
  • Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.


Une expérience avec les environnements SaaS, Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, Selenium, Jira, Spira ainsi qu’avec les tests de performance, de sécurité ou de fiabilité constitue un atout.

Notre environnement de travail


Il s’agit d’un poste de leadership à temps plein, en présentiel, à notre bureau de Montréal. Les candidat(e)s doivent résider à Montréal ou dans les environs et être à l’aise de travailler au bureau cinq jours par semaine.


Si vous êtes un(e) leader expérimenté(e) en QA qui aime combiner stratégie, technologie et leadership d’équipe afin de créer de meilleurs logiciels, nous aimerions faire votre connaissance.



***

Montreal, QC | Full-time | On-site


Explorance is looking for an experienced Director of Quality Assurance to lead our QA organization and shape how quality is embedded across our software development lifecycle.


In this leadership role, you will define and evolve our QA strategy, strengthen our approach to test automation, and build the practices, processes, and capabilities needed to deliver reliable, high-quality SaaS products at scale.

Working closely with Engineering, Product, and other technical leaders, you will have the opportunity to influence not only how we test software, but how we think about quality throughout the organization.


We're looking for a leader who combines strong technical depth with strategic thinking and people leadership. Someone who can set the vision while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge assumptions, guide technical decisions, and help teams continuously improve.


What you'll be responsible for


QA Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the overall QA strategy, vision, and roadmap, aligned with Explorance's product and engineering objectives.
  • Establish quality standards, practices, and measurable outcomes across the software development lifecycle.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership to embed quality throughout product development rather than treating testing as a final step.
  • Represent QA within leadership discussions and champion a strong culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve our QA organization, processes, technology, and operating model as our products scale.

Quality Engineering & Automation

  • Lead the evolution of our test automation strategy, with a strong focus on API and complex UI environments.
  • Define and maintain scalable automation standards, frameworks, and practices.
  • Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve test coverage, reliability, speed, and efficiency.
  • Help teams determine the right balance between automated and manual testing based on risk, complexity, and business impact.
  • Drive continuous improvement of testing practices throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Technical Leadership

  • Bring strong knowledge of software engineering principles, architecture, testing methodologies, and modern development practices.
  • Participate in technical and architectural discussions, bringing a quality and testability perspective to engineering decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering teams to identify quality risks early and improve the testability and reliability of our applications.
  • Provide technical direction on complex testing challenges and help teams establish effective solutions.

Quality Operations

  • Develop and continuously improve QA processes, methodologies, metrics, and best practices.
  • Establish meaningful quality indicators and use data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure QA capacity and resources are aligned with product priorities and delivery requirements.
  • Oversee testing readiness and quality standards for software releases.
  • Support compliance and servicing requirements as they relate to software quality and testing.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing QA organization.
  • Establish clear expectations, goals, and accountability across the team.
  • Coach and mentor QA professionals, supporting both technical development and career growth.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Regularly assess team capabilities and organizational needs to ensure the QA function remains effective and appropriately structured as the business evolves.


What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced QA leader who understands both the technical and organizational sides of software quality.


You should bring:

  • Significant experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or software testing, including experience in a senior QA leadership role.
  • Strong technical knowledge of software engineering and modern software development practices.
  • Demonstrated experience building or evolving QA strategies and operating models.
  • Strong experience with test automation, particularly for APIs and complex web applications.
  • Experience defining or scaling automation frameworks and testing practices.
  • Strong understanding of software development methodologies, testing strategies, and quality engineering best practices.
  • Experience leading and developing technical teams.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with senior leaders across Engineering, Product, and other functions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate technical challenges into practical strategies and priorities.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.


A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is an asset, but equivalent technical and leadership experience will also be considered.


Nice to have

Experience with any of the following would be an asset:

  • SaaS products and cloud-based software environments
  • Agile/Scrum development environments
  • Selenium or other modern test automation technologies
  • Jira
  • Spira
  • CI/CD pipelines and automated testing within deployment workflows
  • Performance, scalability, security, or reliability testing


Why Explorance?

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on how quality is defined and delivered across our products.

Rather than simply maintaining an established QA function, you'll have the opportunity to evolve our strategy, strengthen automation, develop our QA talent, and work directly with Engineering and Product leadership to improve how we build and deliver software.

You'll join a global technology organization where your decisions can directly influence product quality, engineering practices, customer experience, and the continued evolution of our SaaS platform.


Our workplace

This is a full-time, on-site leadership position based in our Montreal office.

We believe in the value of working together in person and have built an engaged and collaborative office environment. Candidates should therefore be located in Montreal or the surrounding area and be comfortable working from the office five days per week.

If you're an experienced QA leader who enjoys combining strategy, technology, and people leadership to build better software, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Markedsansvarlig - Tur, fly og ekspressbuss
description:
Om Tide

I Tide jobber vi for å skape gode og bærekraftige reiseopplevelser hver dag. For å lykkes med dette søker vi nå en erfaren, kommersiell og gjennomføringssterk markedsansvarlig som vil bidra til at flere velger å reise med våre tur-, fly- og ekspressbusser.

En sentral og operativ markedsrolle

Vi søker deg som har solid markedsføringserfaring og et analytisk blikk, kombinert med kreativitet og stor gjennomføringsevne. Du får ansvar for å videreutvikle og synliggjøre Tides tur-, fly- og ekspressbusstilbud i markedet. Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å jobbe operativt og få ting til å skje, fra idé og planlegging til gjennomføring, publisering, oppfølging og måling av effekt.

Du får også en sentral rolle i hvordan Tide ser ut og oppleves. Som konsernets faglige ansvarlige for profilering skal du forvalte og videreutvikle Tides visuelle identitet og sørge for at den tas godt i bruk i praksis. Du vil både gi råd og selv bidra operativt til et tydelig, helhetlig og gjenkjennelig uttrykk på tvers av virksomheter, markeder og flater. Det gjelder alt fra kjøretøy og materiell til digitale og fysiske møteplasser.

Du er digitalt sterk og trygg i moderne verktøy for markedsføring, analyse, annonsering og innholdsproduksjon. Du er vant til å jobbe operativt i digitale kanaler og verktøy, og forstår hvordan data og innsikt kan brukes til å forbedre og optimalisere markedsarbeidet. Du er også nysgjerrig på hvordan AI og ny teknologi kan gjøre arbeidet smartere og mer treffsikkert.

Du rapporterer til kommunikasjonsdirektør og blir en sentral fagressurs i markeds- og kommunikasjonsavdelingen. Rollen innebærer tett samarbeid med forretningsområdene og andre relevante fagmiljøer på tvers av Tide.

Dine viktigste ansvars- og arbeidsområder

  • Ha ansvar for markedsføring og synliggjøring av Tides tur-, fly- og ekspressbusstilbud

  • Utvikle og gjennomføre markedsplaner, kampanjer og aktiviteter som støtter forretningsområdets kommersielle mål

  • Planlegge, produsere, publisere og følge opp markedstiltak i relevante kanaler

  • Analysere resultater og kontinuerlig optimalisere markeds- og kampanjearbeidet

  • Ha ansvar for digital markedsføring og tilstedeværelse i relevante kanaler og plattformer

  • Ha ansvar for nettsidene knyttet til tur-, fly- og ekspressbuss og bidra til gode digitale kundereiser

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle Tides visuelle profil og sikre god og konsistent bruk på tvers av konsernet

  • Være faglig rådgiver i profileringsspørsmål og samtidig selv bidra operativt i arbeidet

  • Bidra i sponsorarbeid knyttet til forretningsområdet

  • Samarbeide tett med interne fagmiljøer, eksterne partnere, byråer og leverandører

  • Ha budsjettansvar for eget markedsarbeid

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har relevant høyere utdanning, fortrinnsvis på masternivå, innen markedsføring, økonomi, kommunikasjon eller tilsvarende.

  • Har solid og relevant markedserfaring, gjerne fra reiseliv, transport, tjenesteyting eller andre kommersielle virksomheter

  • Er en erfaren bruker av relevante digitale markedsføringsverktøy, eksempelvis Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, CMS og AI-verktøy, og trives med å jobbe operativt i verktøyene selv

  • Har et analytisk og kommersielt tankesett og evner å omsette innsikt til konkrete tiltakHar gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

Vi tilbyr

  • En sentral markedsrolle i et stort mobilitetskonsern med høy aktivitet og store ambisjoner

  • Mulighet til å påvirke både kommersiell utvikling og hvordan Tide fremstår som merkevare

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Candidates performs welding processes on aluminum, steel, and alloy parts and assemblies to required tolerances using welding metals and metal alloys and precision blending using hand tools to prepare metallic surfaces for welding and non-destructive evaluation. Determines layouts and welds parts and assemblies according to engineering drawings and specifications. Monitors and verifies quality in accordance with statistical processes or other control procedures. Joins metal parts to form a permanent bond. Welds metal components and parts using standard specialized equipment such as gas welders and gas torches and may also utilize friction stir welding (FSW) methods using solid-state joining. Uses electrical currents or friction to create heat and bond metals. Observes tests on welded surfaces to evaluate weld quality and conformance to specifications. Set up and operate large, motion-controlled machines to create friction stir welds on launch vehicles. Perform periodic maintenance on machines with complex pneumatic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. Accurately use precision measuring tools such as micrometers, calipers, and torque wrenches.

You will be supporting production and development related activities that directly affect rocket launch vehicles and spacecraft. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

General Summary:

About the Role

Are you an experienced Java developer with experience in creating Java-based server applications that use the most sensitive of security assets — cryptographic keys? We are looking for a passionate and skilled software engineer to join the development branch of Qualcomm's Cryptographic Operations Group. This team creates the services that support device image signing and factory provisioning with keys protected by Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) across the entire Qualcomm organisation. Our services our mostly exposed through Java implementations running on standalone, on-premises servers with attached HSMs which have to meet very high security and assurance requirements.

You will be an integral part of a highly-skilled team and will contribute to all facets of the system: architecture, development, testing, integration, and debugging. You will also contribute to the architecture of Qualcomm's products by working with the device engineering teams about what is possible and efficient with our secure infrastructure systems.

Please note that this position is part of the Qualcomm engineering team. It is not a cybersecurity IT position.

What are we looking for?

  • Proven programming skills with C and Python.

  • Experience using build toolchains to support code base and working with multi-modular projects.

  • Experience with 'C' targeting embedded environments (e.g., PowerPC architecture, ELF binary generation).

  • Experience with SDLC using defined tools and processes.

  • Experience using build frameworks like Maven or Gradle.

  • General understanding of Source Code Management tools and practices, including use of tools like GIT

  • General understanding of PKI.

  • General understanding with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, sign, and publish workflows.

  • Strong communication and documentation skills, and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed teams.

An ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate the following additional skills and experience:

  • Experience with Java development, and Java frameworks, including Spring, RESTEasy, JAXB, and JCA/JCE.

  • Experience building, signing, and publishing native applications using Java-centric/Python-centric based toolchains in a cross-platform environment.

  • Clear understanding of PKI/certificates, and cryptographic key management.

  • Broad understanding of Web and REST API services.

  • General understanding of UI frameworks.

  • General understanding of interoperable data formats, like XML and JSON.

  • Working experience with OpenSSL integration (1.x FIPS and 3.x) for various cryptographic operations.

  • Working experience with PKCS11.

  • Working experience with Hardware Security Module (HSM) platforms and associated toolchains for application signing and deployment.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, sign, and publish workflows.

  • Familiarity with Post-Quantum Cryptography.

  • Experience with Containerization concepts (using technologies Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)

Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.
There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Job Posting Title: Senior Therapeutic Area Specialist, Cardiovascular Community (Portland, ME)

Therapeutic Area (TA): Cardiovascular

Primary Location: Field – United States

Primary Job Posting Location: Portland, ME


At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. The BMS Mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer.

Join us, build your professional career within one of the most innovative bio-pharma companies, and make a difference.

Position Summary

The Therapeutic Area Specialist (TAS) is a critical role in our unique customer model to execute the BMS aspiration to be the BioPharma that delivers the most impactful engagement with Health Care Providers (HCPs), driving adoption of new and existing medicines for appropriate patients.

The primary role of the TAS is to drive demand for BMS medicines within their portfolio for the appropriate patients. To meet the HCPs expectations, the TAS engages them with a differentiated Customer Experience (Cx) through deeper scientific dialogue on and consistent with label, leveraging new ways of working and CE^3.

The role builds and maintains strong professional credibility with regional thought leaders (RTLs) and community-based physicians/HCPs in private practice, medical groups practices, office staff, and other stakeholders in the patient care continuum as their primary point of contact.

The TAS liaises with other BMS functions as needed to deliver an overall higher Customer Experience (Cx) – by meeting HCP needs in a timely and scientific manner. This role will prioritize the safe and appropriate use of BMS products while also focusing on overall business results and performance objectives while exemplifying BMS values.

The TAS role is field-based. A TAS is anticipated to spend much of their time spent field with external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Promotion

  • Promotes approved indications of BMS products within a defined territory or region to meet or exceed assigned sales targets in a compliant manner.
  • Creates demand for BMS medicines by articulating in a balanced manner the clinical and scientific rationale for use of products in appropriate patients.
  • Engages with and continuously maintains/grows a high level of scientific expertise in all assigned products and therapeutic areas.
  • Prepares and successfully implements comprehensive territory and account plans.
  • Proactively uses available tools such as SOPHIA to derive insights and to dynamically inform call plans.
  • Provides feedback on experience using these tools to leadership to enable continuous improvement.

Fair & Balanced Scientific Dialogue

  • Demonstrates scientific expertise and passion in using approved scientific resources and publications to present information to HCPs and ensures medical accuracy.
  • Conducts in-office presentations (e.g., lunch and learns) and discusses product-related scientific information with HCPs that is consistent with label.
  • Organizes external speaker programs, selecting speakers from list approved by Speakers Bureau and facilitating scheduling and logistics.
  • Maintains a high level of working expertise on emerging data for approved indications.
  • Engages real-time medical support through Medical on Call to reactively answer unsolicited questions and complex technical inquiries.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Proactively collaborates with other field teams to ensure the best Customer Experience (Cx) for HCPs.
  • Gathers and shares relevant insights and information internally with the appropriate stakeholders to enable BMS to better serve its customers.

Complies with all laws, regulations, and policies that govern the conduct of BMS.

Required Qualifications & Experience

title: Mechatronics Systems Engineer
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Product Development uses design thinking & user experience methods to deliver breakthrough products and services that delight our customers. We bring innovative, exciting, and sustainable ideas to life. We have opportunities around the world for you to contribute to advancements in autonomy, electrification, smart mobility technologies, and more!

In this position...

We are seeking a highly capable and rigorous Core Architect to serve as the senior technical lead and primary authority for mechatronic feature definition, from initial concept definition through logical requirements handoff, and as the accountable Core SE representative through cross-validation, system/subsystem sign-off, and physical prototype direction.

In this role, you will own the front end of the feature lifecycle — driving stakeholder and use-case elicitation, system architecture and behavior definition, functional safety/DFMEA analysis, and formal requirements development — while engaging with a Modeling Engineer and Testing Engineer to execute the modeling, simulation, and verification/validation work needed to bring the feature to a fully signed-off, physically realized system.

What you'll do...

  • Feature Intake Gate: Lead completion and submission of the conceptual intake form (Impacted Teams, Business Case, Scoping) on behalf of the requesting program, and drive the feature through the applicable gate reviews to secure formal Feature Owner assignment.
  • Concept of Operations: Engage program, customer experience, and vehicle architecture stakeholders to define problem statements, identify and map stakeholders, define lifecycle contexts, elicit INCOSE/EARS-compliant needs, collect use cases, and establish measurable success criteria (MoE/MoP), driving stakeholder validation and sign-off.
  • System Architecture Definition: Define system boundary, external interfaces, internal architecture (plant vs. controller partitioning), behavioral models (e.g., state machines), and interface specifications, establishing full structure-behavior-interface-use case traceability.
  • System Analysis Requirements Engineering: Lead system-level analyses (functional safety, DFMEA prioritized by severity, cybersecurity/physical safety as applicable), define prevention controls for critical failure modes, and formalize INCOSE/EARS-compliant system requirements with full traceability and defined verification methods.
  • Requirements Validation Handoff: Validate that requirements satisfy stakeholder needs and MoE/MoP thresholds, resolve gaps via iteration, and finalize and formally transmit the logical requirements package to the Mechatronics application team, establishing the ongoing support channel for cascade-phase clarifications.
  • Cross-Validation Sign-off: Lead the functional safety-to-DFMEA cross-validation checkpoint, ensuring every hazard and high-severity failure mode is reconciled with a control or documented rationale, and serve as the primary Core SE stakeholder in joint system/subsystem sign-off with the Mechatronics team.
  • Physical Realization Oversight: Engage in the proposition of the physical prototype strategy (mockup, fixture, 3D print, or hybrid) and approve builds against signed-off design intent, and provide technical guidance during test plan development and execution, reviewing failed/at-risk requirement dispositions that affect sign-off validity.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the technical authority and escalation point for architecture, requirements, and DFMEA decisions; direct and prioritize modeling and testing support requests to the Modeling Engineer and Testing Engineer; and represent Core SE at design reviews, program gateways, sign-off boards, and DFMEA workshops.

You'll have...

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of proven experience in systems engineering, systems architecture, or mechatronic systems engineering within automotive or a related industry, including ownership of requirements definition and sign-off decisions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the systems engineering lifecycle: stakeholder/use-case elicitation (INCOSE/EARS), Concept of Operations, system architecture/structure-behavior-interface definition, and requirements traceability.
  • Strong experience with functional safety analysis and DFMEA, including cross-validation of safety hazards against design failure modes.
  • Hands-on proficiency with SysML and CATIA V6 for system/architecture modeling.
  • Working familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink modeling concepts sufficient to direct and review modeling work performed by supporting engineers.
  • Exceptional analytical thinking and the ability to effectively negotiate and drive cross-functional trade-offs and sign-off decisions.

Even better, if you have …

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Systems Engineering or a related field.
  • INCOSE Systems Engineering Professional Certification (ASEP/CSEP) or OMG SysML Certification.
  • Experience with functional safety standards (e.g., ISO 26262) and ASPICE processes.
  • Experience directing physical prototype strategy (mockups, fixtures, rapid prototyping) and DVP&R-style test planning.
  • Prior experience as a technical lead, chief/core architect, or systems engineering lead on electromechanical or mechatronic vehicle systems.
  • Familiarity with HIL/SIL environments (dSPACE, CANoe/CANalyzer) and requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, JIRA).

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance
• Established and active employee resource groups
• Paid time off for individual and team community service
• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 7-8 and ranges from $84,600 - $166,200.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
