Job Description:

Principal Software Test Engineer - Solution Engineering – Customer Solution Validation

Location (HYBRID): Sunnyvale, CA


HPE Networking is seeking a Principal Solution Test & Automation Engineer to drive quality engineering for large-scale networking and distributed software solutions. This is a highly technical Individual Contributor role requiring visible technical impact on products and major components, customer success, and engineering excellence. The role combines strong software testing expertise, system-level engineering knowledge, customer engagement, and technical leadership. The successful candidate will be recognized as an internal authority in key technology areas, drive innovation in automation and validation, and improve product quality, scalability, observability, and reliability across the product lifecycle.

You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, product management, sales engineering, services, support, and customers to validate complex networking solutions, establish scalable quality engineering practices, and deliver long-lasting improvements to engineering productivity and product quality. In addition to technical execution, you will provide leadership across functions, mentor engineers, and help define the future direction of solution validation and automation.

Success in this role requires visible technical impact on products or major components, recognized expertise in key technology areas, contributions to cross-functional initiatives, mentorship and knowledge sharing, and innovation that advances customer outcomes and business objectives.


Solution Validation & Customer Engagement


  • Understand customer deployments, business requirements, architectures, and large-scale operational environments to develop comprehensive validation strategies.
  • Lead validation efforts for customer solutions and complex networking deployments.
  • Collaborate with customers, field engineers, solution architects, sales engineers, and services teams to validate real-world networking solutions and operational readiness.
  • Participate in and influence technical design workshops, architecture reviews, and strategic planning discussions to improve reliability, scalability, observability, and serviceability.
  • Translate customer requirements into repeatable, solution-focused validation frameworks.
  • Present technical findings, risk assessments, quality recommendations, and executive-level updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that improve customer outcomes and product quality.

Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Contribute to and help drive automation strategy across products, programs, and engineering teams.
  • Architect, develop, and evolve scalable automation frameworks supporting functional, integration, system, resiliency, scale, performance, and solution validation.
  • Establish engineering best practices and standards for continuous validation through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive innovation in automation infrastructure, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
  • Drive organization-wide adoption of quality engineering methodologies that improve time-to-market and engineering productivity.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify validation workflows and reduce operational costs through automation.

System-Level Testing & Debugging

  • Validate distributed, multi-component software and networking platforms at scale.
  • Utilize logs, metrics, traces, telemetry, observability platforms, and diagnostic frameworks to troubleshoot complex failures.
  • Drive root-cause investigations spanning multiple teams and technology domains.
  • Differentiate product defects from infrastructure, automation, and environmental issues.
  • Influence architecture and design decisions to improve product testability, diagnosability, and operational excellence.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership for significant project and program initiatives.
  • Serve as a recognized internal authority for solution validation, automation, and quality engineering.
  • Lead and connect engineering teams across functions to align around common quality objectives.
  • Drive quality-first engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to technical innovation through patents, white papers, standards participation, publications, and architectural proposals.
  • Contribute to long-term technical capabilities that create recurring business value and customer impact.

Basic Qualifications

Software Engineering & Automation

  • Expert-level programming expertise in Python, Go, or C++, with deep proficiency in at least one language.
  • Extensive experience designing and building automation platforms, frameworks, and quality engineering ecosystems.
  • Experience integrating large-scale automated testing into CI/CD environments.
  • Proven experience delivering impactful automation initiatives.

Systems & Networking

  • Strong understanding of Linux/UNIX operating systems, networking, processes, memory management, and system internals.
  • Extensive experience validating distributed and multi-component systems.
  • Deep hands-on expertise configuring and validating multi-vendor networking environments.
  • Experience supporting service provider, enterprise, and cloud networking deployments.
  • Strong knowledge of performance testing and traffic-generation platforms such as Ixia and Spirent.


Testing & Quality Engineering

  • Deep expertise in system-level and end-to-end validation.
  • Multi-feature, longevity, resiliency, interoperability, scale, and performance testing.
  • Fault injection and recovery validation.
  • Root-cause analysis and complex defect investigation.
  • Advanced troubleshooting across multiple software and infrastructure layers.

Leadership & Influence

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver visible technical impact on products or major components.
  • Proven ability to influence engineering decisions and technical direction within and across teams.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to cross-functional technical initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12+ yrs of industry experience.
  • Advanced networking expertise in Layer 2, Layer 3, TCP/IP, Routing, MPLS, EVPN, and data center technologies.
  • Experience with network operating systems, cloud infrastructure, observability platforms, and distributed architectures.
  • Working knowledge of JUNOS.
  • Industry certifications such as JNCIA, CCIA, or equivalent.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools for automation development, test generation, diagnostics, failure analysis, and productivity improvements.
  • Track record of innovation resulting in patents, publications, standards contributions, or architectural leadership.

title: IT Engineer II, Client Platform Engineer (CPE)
description:
🚀 The Opportunity: Fleet as Code

At Flywire, we don't do traditional, old-school IT support. We approach endpoint management much closer to Platform and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). We manage a global fleet of devices the way a cloud team manages infrastructure: as code.

As a Client Platform Engineer based in Valencia, you will treat the entire device lifecycle—from provisioning and compliance to patching and offboarding—as an end-to-end automated system. Reporting to the IT Client Platform Engineering Manager in Spain, you will collaborate closely with our team lead in the US, enjoying full autonomy to build quality, maintainable code and shape our global endpoint strategy.

🧠 How We Think (Our Engineering Culture)

  • Systems Thinking: We analyze the full workflow before automating to anticipate failures.

  • Declarative over Imperative: We define the desired end state and let modern tools converge the device toward it, instead of running messy, one-off scripts.

  • Idempotency & State: Our automation runs repeatedly and safely, managing the actual state of the device at all times.

  • Cattle, Not Pets: When a machine drifts from our baseline, we wipe and redeploy from a code-defined source of truth rather than hand-nursing it.

  • Automation-First & Self-Service: If we have to do it twice, we script it. We build low-friction paths so engineers can focus on the platform.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • Automate Everything: Implement provisioning, configuration, and patching workflows across the full device fleet (~90% macOS, ~10% Windows).

  • Code & Scripting: Write clean, reusable, and well-tested scripts (Python, Bash) to power our endpoint management platform.

  • MDM & Compliance: Enforce security baselines, track real-time fleet performance, and investigate compliance anomalies using modern MDM tooling.

  • API Integrations: Connect platforms like Okta, Iru, and FleetDM via APIs to streamline identity, access, and self-service IT workflows.

  • Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain idempotent automation pipelines for deployment, fleet monitoring, and state enforcement.

🛠️ Our Stack

  • Device Management: Iru (formerly Kandji)

  • Observability (o11y): FleetDM

  • Identity & Access: Okta

  • IaC & Automation: Terraform, Ansible

  • Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell

  • Cloud & Version Control: AWS, GitLab

✨ What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in client platform engineering, endpoint engineering, or a highly technical IT infrastructure/SRE role.

  • OS Deep Dive: Deep knowledge of macOS system internals and preference management, plus solid hands-on experience securing Windows endpoints.

  • Tooling & Scripting: Proven track record with MDM platforms and solid programming skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

  • DevOps Mindset: Comfortable working with Git/GitLab using code-review and branch-based workflows.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Exposure to Terraform, administering core SaaS apps (Okta, Google Workspace, Jira), or AWS cloud infrastructure familiarity.

We Offer:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Work with brilliant people that will keep you on your toes, learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
  • Dynamic & Global Team (we have been collaborating virtually for years!)
  • Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
  • Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
  • Competitive time off including FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in and Digital Disconnect Days!
  • Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers!)

Submit today and get started!

Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

title: President and Head of Distribution Services
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a President and Head of Distribution Services based in United States.

This executive role will lead the launch and growth of a newly established ETF distribution and statutory underwriting business. You will own the organization from regulatory approval through operational launch and long-term scale, combining regulatory leadership with commercial and financial accountability. The position will oversee the transition of statutory distribution and marketing compliance activities from an external provider while building the operating model, governance framework, and team. You will work closely with executive leadership, fund boards, counsel, service providers, and cross-functional teams to establish a controlled, client-focused operation. The role requires a hands-on leader who can navigate complex regulatory environments while turning strategic plans into disciplined execution. You will also own the entity’s P&L and help determine future opportunities to expand distribution and compliance services.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the regulatory launch of the newly established broker-dealer, including the FINRA New Membership Application, operational readiness, financial preparation, legal requirements, and launch execution.
  • Establish the governance, controls, reporting, books and records, insurance coverage, and decision-making structures required for a regulated financial-services entity.
  • Serve as, or directly oversee, registered principal leadership and maintain a high standard of regulatory preparedness as the organization grows.
  • Lead the phased transition of statutory ETF distribution from an incumbent external provider, managing contractual requirements, fund board approvals, client communications, authorized participant relationships, and implementation sequencing.
  • Coordinate closely with fund boards, outside counsel, Client Success, Fund Operations, and other stakeholders to maintain visibility into responsibilities, timelines, risks, and decisions.
  • Establish and maintain Authorized Participant agreements and related infrastructure supporting statutory distribution responsibilities, including approval of daily AP activity.
  • Lead the transition and ongoing operation of FINRA Rule 2210 marketing compliance review, including review teams, compliance technology, quality standards, and service-level expectations.
  • Analyze submission volume, utilization, quality, and service data to anticipate capacity requirements and prevent operational or regulatory issues.
  • Own pricing strategy and the business P&L, including revenue, cost management, net capital compliance, forecasting, and financial reporting to executive leadership and the CFO.
  • Ensure distribution and marketing compliance services deliver sustainable economics while maintaining strong controls, service quality, and client relationships.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand statutory distribution, marketing compliance, and related services to external ETF issuers based on market demand, operational readiness, risk, and financial considerations.
  • Build and execute the staffing strategy, including recruiting and developing registered leadership and other capabilities required for growth.
  • Manage key outsourced partners and relationships, including compliance and financial/operations leadership, with clear expectations, reporting structures, and succession planning.
  • Collaborate across legal, compliance, finance, fund operations, technology, relationship management, and executive leadership to resolve issues efficiently and maintain strong client and business outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    • 15+ years of experience in broker-dealer operations, fund distribution, asset management, or a closely related financial-services discipline, including direct experience with FINRA-registered entities.
    • Direct experience with statutory underwriting or distribution functions for registered investment companies, particularly ETFs or mutual funds, or leadership experience within a comparable distribution or compliance service provider.
    • Demonstrated experience managing FINRA membership applications or examinations.
    • Required securities licenses, including either SIE + Series 7 + Series 24 + Series 63 or SIE + Series 6 + Series 26 + Series 63.
    • Demonstrated success launching, building, or scaling a regulated financial-services entity or function, with relevant supervisory and principal registrations held or readily obtainable.
    • Proven ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder transitions involving contractual notice periods, governance or fund board approvals, client communications, and operational implementation.
    • Experience owning a business-unit P&L and making pricing, investment, staffing, and vendor decisions based on business performance.
    • Strong knowledge of broker-dealer controls, net capital requirements, compliance governance, and books and records obligations.
    • Ability to communicate complex regulatory, financial, and operational matters clearly to executives, fund boards, clients, counsel, and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong commercial judgment, regulatory discipline, organizational skills, and ability to operate hands-on within a lean, evolving environment.
    • Preferred experience with ETF platforms, ETF servicing providers, fund administrators, or similar financial-services organizations.
    • Experience managing compliance functions and relationships with Chief Compliance Officers, Financial and Operations Principals, and compliance technology providers is a plus.
    • Experience bringing previously outsourced regulated services or operating functions in-house is preferred.
    • Additional supervisory or principal securities licenses, such as Series 27 or Series 28, are advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Executive-level opportunity to build and lead a new ETF distribution and statutory underwriting operation.
      • Fully remote position within the United States.
      • Direct ownership of the business strategy, operating model, regulatory launch, and financial performance.
      • Opportunity to shape distribution, marketing compliance, and client service capabilities from the ground up.
      • High-level collaboration with executive leadership, fund boards, counsel, service providers, and cross-functional teams.
      • Opportunity to build and lead a growing team and establish scalable processes and governance.
      • Ability to influence future expansion into external distribution and compliance services.
      • Compensation and benefits appropriate to the executive-level scope of the position.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
We're seeking a Principal Data Engineer who can work across the full stack of Anaplan’s data platform, setting the technical direction for how we ingest, transform, store, serve, and govern data at scale. You will build highly performant, robust data pipelines that process massive volumes of data in real-time and batch. This foundational work empowers business users to leverage vast datasets in their planning workflows and forms the bedrock for our advanced analytics and AI initiatives. You'll need deep knowledge of distributed computing, data architecture, and strong software engineering skills to tackle complex, high-scale data challenges.

Your Impact

Lead the data architecture, design, and deployment of scalable, high-throughput Big Data systems into production environments.

Architect, deploy, and manage the foundational data systems that underlie modern AI infrastructure, including vector, NoSQL, and document databases.

Develop end-to-end data engineering solutions, including robust ETL/ELT pipelines, API services, and data ingestion frameworks.

Design and build the storage and processing layers powering our analytics workloads: data lakes, data warehouses, distributed file systems, and real-time streaming architectures.

Engineer feature-rich context pipelines that process large-scale enterprise data, balancing batch and streaming patterns seamlessly.

Optimise and scale large distributed queries and data transformations to ensure high performance and low latency for end users.

Implement data quality frameworks to measure and ensure data integrity, reliability, and governance across all data assets.

Collaborate with analytics, product, and platform teams to build data models that capture the semantics of customer metrics, hierarchies, and relationships.

Stay current with the modern data stack and big data landscape, evaluating new tools, distributed computing frameworks, and database technologies for potential adoption.

Your Skills

Extensive data engineering experience, demonstrating a strong track record of hands-on execution and delivery in complex data environments.

Deep practical understanding of the database ecosystems that power AI and machine learning infrastructure (e.g., Vector databases, NoSQL, and Document stores).

Hands-on experience building, scaling, and shipping large-scale data platforms in production.

Deep practical experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Flink, Hadoop).

Strong expertise in message brokers and event streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka, Kinesis).

End-to-end exposure to data pipeline lifecycle development, including extensive experience with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Dagster).

Hands-on expertise with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and data lake architectures (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg).

Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python.

Strong background in modern software development practices (testing, code review, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code).

Extensive, progressive experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineering teams.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Experience implementing data observability, monitoring, and alerting frameworks at scale.

Familiarity with Anaplan or similar enterprise planning platforms.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITAAt SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.Are you ready to love your job?The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

PURPOSE

As a Data Engineer, you will accelerate new airline onboarding by ingesting heterogeneous airline systems and external sources, and turning them into trusted data for OCCam, SITA’s AI-powered Operations Control Center solution that helps airlines manage and recover from operational disruptions.You will be accountable for building a common datalake and canonical data model that the product, Back-End and Science teams can rely on.Reporting to the Head of Engineering – Disruption Management Solutions (OCCam), you will be part of the OCCam team. We are hiring two Data Engineers to grow the team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ingest heterogeneous airline systems and external sources into OCCam's data platform
  • Build a common datalake and canonical data model that the product reads from
  • Own data quality at the pipeline level, including checks, reconciliation and issue investigation
  • Partner closely with Back-End and Science teams so product features and algorithms are built on reliable data
  • Work on several airline integrations in parallel, accelerating client onboarding and keeping delivery organized and well documented
  • Map airline source schemas into a canonical data dictionary and document assumptions clearly

Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and SQL across relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle
  • You have hands-on experience with Airflow and ETL or ELT design
  • You understand datalakes, data modeling and canonical data model design
  • You can work with MSSQL linked servers, schema mapping and source-system reverse engineering
  • You have experience with, or can quickly ramp up on, AWS data services and data-quality frameworks
  • You understand airline operational data such as schedules, crew, assignments and qualifications, or are ready to build that domain knowledge quickly
  • You bring structured problem-solving to messy real-world data and can collaborate in client-facing onboarding situations
  • You have strong documentation discipline and a data-trust mindset
  • You understand the importance of handling personal data, including crew data, under GDPR and client data-privacy requirements

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Experience with airline operational systems such as Netline, SCHEDOPS, XCREW or similar

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

You possess Airline Operations Management knowledge and understand the operational, commercial, and customer service challenges faced by airlines.

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

  • Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  • Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  • Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  • Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  • Professional Development: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative, and Airport Council International -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like Pluralsight for technology upskilling, Harvard Business Publishing for people leadership, Stanford for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  • Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

  • Tools & Technologies CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI (preferred)

  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes

  • Observability (Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience working across at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to analyze complex issues, develop and recommend options, and implement solutions
  • Understanding of DevSecOps practices.
  • Exposure working in an Agile environment, or an understanding of Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated practice thriving in a hybrid work environment
  • Familiarity with test automation tools and integrating those into your development process
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models.

How We Work

Work Schedule: 37.5 hours per week - flexible within core business hours.

Work Arrangement : A mix of onsite and remote work, as determined by business and role requirements.

title: Physiotherapist - Fraser
description:
At Myo, our mission is to raise body IQ globally. We aim to empower clients with the tools they need to move better, feel better, and do what they love—longer.
We envision a world where everyone feels empowered to care for their bodies with clarity and confidence.
Who We Are
Myo is modern physical therapy to futureproof your body. Through 1:1 expert care, our team of physiotherapists, chiropractors, and massage therapists use full-body awareness and proactive insights to intercept injury, reduce pain, and improve your every day.
With 20 locations (and counting!) across Canada and the U.S., including our clinics in Vancouver (Main, Oak, North Shore, Chinatown, Fraser, Kitsilano, Park Royal and Richmond), Myo is leading the movement-health conversation and inspiring the world to make proactive care a part of everyday life.
Why Fraser?
Our Fraser clinic in Vancouver is looking for a Physiotherapist to join our team! Nestled in the dynamic and diverse Fraser neighbourhood, this clinic serves a mix of young families, working professionals, and long-time residents. The area is known for its rich cultural diversity, with a strong sense of community and active lifestyles.
Many of our clients are health-conscious individuals who prioritize fitness, wellness, and staying active, making it a perfect environment for an RMT who thrives on building relationships with clients across all age groups.
Whether it’s helping parents with their kids’ sports injuries or supporting active professionals, Fraser offers a unique opportunity to make an impact in a vibrant, engaged community!
Clinic Address: 3505 Fraser St, Vancouver, BC V5V 4C5
Your Impact
If you’re passionate about our mission and values, let’s connect to begin the conversation. This is an opportunity for immediate availability, so don’t wait— join a team that’s all about delivering exceptional care, supporting your growth, and taking movement health to the next level!

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver high-quality care to every client that walks through our door
  • Use your own clinical reasoning and judgment to deliver care and create action plans to help clients do what they love, longer
  • Engage with local referral sources to support the development of your own caseload
  • Participate in ongoing mentorship and clinical education provided from within the organization as well as external resources
  • Partner with your Clinic Director and Lead Clinician on an ongoing basis to determine the level of support and training required to help you grow

About You

  • Licensed and in good standing with your affiliated college
  • Have the appropriate liability insurance
  • Put your clients' needs first, demonstrated through behaviours such as: cross-referring clients to other clinicians when appropriate, following up with clients after appointments, managing outreach to unscheduled or "dropped" clients and an openness to work with your clients’ schedules
  • An advocate of your own growth and development and are eager to learn from your Clinic Director, Lead Clinician, your Regional Director of Clinical Development, and fellow clinicians
  • Thrive on giving and receiving feedback, adjusting your client care and performance accordingly
  • A team player and care deeply not only about your own growth, but ensuring the development of your entire team
  • Contribute to clinic culture as demonstrated through behaviours such as: excitement to mentor students, flexibility to cover shifts (on the occasion!), participation at clinic events/workshops/recharges, etc.
  • Collaborative in nature and see the importance and impact of partnering closely with your clinic’s Front Desk team
  • A strong communicator and understand the importance of a positive customer service experience

Working at Myo

  • 1:1 care with every client
  • Onboarding like no other: a 90 day plan to ensure you are set up for success, from building a caseload to understanding our #futureproof plan
  • At least 2 in-clinic mentors dedicated to your personal growth and development
  • Structured mentorship program and consistent clinical workshops in a collaborative team environment
  • Highly motivated and engaged client base dedicated to moving and feeling their best in life beyond pain
  • Professional Development: “LIT” (Leadership In Training) Program, Evolve (Personal Development Program) and opportunities to lead educational workshops
  • Culture of Growth: Part of a large and growing team adding new clinics within Vancouver region and expanding rapidly to new markets across the US

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive fee split + annual $1000 Continuing Education Reimbursement + bonus payouts for team member referrals
  • Financial Stability: The unique option to start with a structured monthly Stipend Model for your first three months—designed to provide stability and ease your transition into building a caseload, before moving onto our standard fee split.
  • Performance-Based Recognition: Access to our Senior Clinician Program, a performance-based pathway that recognizes and rewards clinical excellence through a 20% increase in service pricing - a reflection of your continued growth and impact.
  • Career Pathways: Clear opportunities to grow into leadership roles such as Lead Clinician, Clinic Director, or Regional Director - supported by mentorship, development programs, and influence across the Myo community.
  • Employee Wellness: Complimentary, paid staff treatment sessions + employer-paid mental health support through our EAP, Homewood
  • Pet Insurance: To take care of our furry friends!
  • Access to Partnerships: Community discounts and partnerships with top tier brands
Let’s Connect: Your Path to Joining Myo
At Myo, we believe in building connections that matter and fostering open communication throughout the interview process. Here’s what you can look forward to after applying for the Physiotherapist role at our Fraser location:
Step 1: Video Interview with the Clinic Director
Kick things off with an inspiring conversation with our Clinic Director. You’ll get an introduction to Myo, our mission, and values while sharing more about your unique experience and perspectives. This is your chance to explore how you can contribute to our dynamic team.
Step 2: In-Person + Practical Interview with the Clinic Director + Lead Clinician
Come visit our Fraser Street clinic and see the Myo difference firsthand! Led by Lindsay, our Clinic Director and our Lead Clinician, the Practical allows us to see your clinical expertise in action. At this stage, you’ll demonstrate your skills and approach + have the opportunity to connect with the team.
We’re excited to meet passionate professionals who are as energized about movement health as we are! Apply today and let’s start the journey together! All applicants can expect to hear back within 1 week.
Core Values
At the heart of our operational ethos lie our core values, encapsulated by a commitment to:
* Care Deeply (Empathy)
* One Team, One Dream (Collaboration)
* Make it Count (Focus)
* Set the Pace (Ambition)
* Never Stop Learning (Curiosity)
💡 Learn more about us through our YouTube and Instagram.

description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Job Posting Title: Therapeutic Area Specialist, Cardiovascular Community - Irvine, CA

Therapeutic Area (TA): Cardiovascular

Primary Location: Field – United States

Primary Job Posting Location: Irvine, CA


At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. The BMS Mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer.


Join us, build your professional career within one of the most innovative bio-pharma companies, and make a difference.


Position Summary

The TAS is a critical role in our unique customer model to execute the BMS aspiration to be the BioPharma that delivers the most impactful engagement with Health Care Providers (HCPs), driving adoption of new and existing medicines for appropriate patients.


The primary role of the TAS is to drive demand for BMS medicines within their portfolio for the appropriate patients. To meet the HCPs expectations, the TAS engages them with a differentiated Customer Experience (Cx) through deeper scientific dialogue on and consistent with label, leveraging new ways of working and CE^3.


The role builds and maintains strong professional credibility with regional thought leaders (RTLs) and community-based physicians/HCPs in private practice, medical groups practices, office staff, and other stakeholders in the patient care continuum as their primary point of contact.


The TAS liaises with other BMS functions as needed to deliver an overall higher Customer Experience (Cx) – by meeting HCP needs in a timely and scientific manner. This role will prioritize the safe and appropriate use of BMS products while also focusing on overall business results and performance objectives while exemplifying BMS values.


The TAS role is field-based. A TAS is anticipated to spend much of their time spent field with external customers.


Key Responsibilities


Portfolio Promotion

  • Promotes approved indications of BMS products within a defined territory or region to meet or exceed assigned sales targets in a compliant manner.
  • Creates demand for BMS medicines by articulating in a balanced manner the clinical and scientific rationale for use of products in appropriate patients.
  • Engages with and continuously maintains/grows a high level of scientific expertise in all assigned products and therapeutic areas.
  • Prepares and successfully implements comprehensive territory and account plans.
  • Proactively uses available tools such as SOPHIA to derive insights and to dynamically inform call plans.
  • Provides feedback on experience using these tools to leadership to enable continuous improvement.

Fair & Balanced Scientific Dialogue

  • Demonstrates scientific expertise and passion in using approved scientific resources and publications to present information to HCPs and ensures medical accuracy.
  • Conducts in-office presentations (e.g., lunch and learns) and discusses product-related scientific information with HCPs that is consistent with label.
  • Organizes external speaker programs, selecting speakers from list approved by Speakers Bureau and facilitating scheduling and logistics.
  • Maintains a high level of working expertise on emerging data for approved indications.
  • Engages real-time medical support through Medical on Call to reactively answer unsolicited questions and complex technical inquiries.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Proactively collaborates with other field teams to ensure the best Customer Experience (Cx) for HCPs.
  • Gathers and shares relevant insights and information internally with the appropriate stakeholders to enable BMS to better serve its customers.

Complies with all laws, regulations, and policies that govern the conduct of BMS.


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific degree and/or preferred 5+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience as healthcare sales / MSL / HCP / nurse.
  • Ability to communicate scientific or clinical data accurately and convincingly to help physicians best serve their patients.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining strong credibility with key customers, office staff, and others in the customer influence network via a customer-centric mindset and desire to create positive and differentiated Customer Experience (Cx).
  • Experience in cardiovascular preferred.
  • Demonstrated strong capability in account management skill sets, superior selling competencies, and proven sales performance track record of meeting or exceeding goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functionally with a positive team mindset and can-do attitude.
  • Strong selling and promotional skills proven through a track record of performance.

Key competencies desired


Customer/commercial mindset

  • Demonstrated ability to drive business results.
  • Experience identifying, engaging, and cultivating credibility with customers across the patient care journey.
  • Demonstrated account management skills and problem-solving mentality. Understands the patient journey and can customize engagement and deliver tailored messages.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness and ability to connect with customers.

Patient centricity

  • Understands the patient journey and experience.
  • Has a patient-focused mindset.

Scientific Agility

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate scientific and clinical data in an easy-to-understand manner to help HCPs best serve their patients.
  • Has a strong learning mindset and passion for science. Prioritizes staying current with the latest data.

Analytical Capability:

  • Ability to analyze data, such as prescribing patterns, market trends, and HCP preferences. Data-driven insights help TAS strategize and target their efforts effectively.
  • Ability to segment HCPs based on their preferences and other relevant factors. This helps them tailor their communication and product presentations to suit individual HCP needs.
  • Understanding how to interpret and analyze data related to BMS products, customer preferences, clinical data.
  • Ability to use CE^3 to generate insights and do dynamic call planning.

Digital Agility:

  • Understanding, adapting, and effectively using technology in various aspects of healthcare business and interacting with HCPs.
  • Utilizing various digital communication channels such as emails, instant messaging apps, and video conferencing to stay in touch with healthcare professionals, colleagues, and clients. This enables TAS to respond promptly to inquiries, share updates, and maintain effective communication.
  • Competency using CE^3 and other software or CRM tools to collect, enter, and manage quality data in a timely and compliant manner, track interactions, and plan future engagements with healthcare professionals.
  • Ability to use the Medical on Call technology effectively.
  • Keeping up to date with technological advancements and changes.

Teamwork/Enterprise mindset

  • Strong business acumen to understand and analyze business, market drivers, and develop, execute, and adjust business plans.
  • Demonstrates a strong sense of learning agility. Seeks out and learns from unfamiliar experiences, and then applies those lessons to achieve better results in subsequent situations.
  • Track record of balancing individual drive and collaborative attitude.
  • Holds a high level of integrity and good judgment to navigate the role's requirements effectively and compliantly in accordance with BMS policies and procedures.

As this position requires the operation of a Company-provided vehicle, offers of employment are contingent upon the candidate meeting the requirements of “Qualified Driver,” as determined by the Company in its sole discretion, including but not limited to the following: 1) at least 21 years of age; 2) a driver’s license in good standing issued by your state of residence; and, 3) a driving risk level deemed acceptable by the Company.

Job Posting Title: Senior Therapeutic Area Specialist, Cardiovascular Community, Lower Manhattan, NY

Therapeutic Area (TA): Cardiovascular

Primary Location: Field – United States

Primary Job Posting Location: Lower Manhattan, NY

At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. The BMS Mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer.

Join us, build your professional career within one of the most innovative bio-pharma companies, and make a difference.

Position Summary

The TAS is a critical role in our unique customer model to execute the BMS aspiration to be the BioPharma that delivers the most impactful engagement with Health Care Providers (HCPs), driving adoption of new and existing medicines for appropriate patients.

The primary role of the TAS is to drive demand for BMS medicines within their portfolio for the appropriate patients. To meet the HCPs expectations, the TAS engages them with a differentiated Customer Experience (Cx) through deeper scientific dialogue on and consistent with label, leveraging new ways of working and CE^3.

The role builds and maintains strong professional credibility with regional thought leaders (RTLs) and community-based physicians/HCPs in private practice, medical groups practices, office staff, and other stakeholders in the patient care continuum as their primary point of contact.

The TAS liaises with other BMS functions as needed to deliver an overall higher Customer Experience (Cx) – by meeting HCP needs in a timely and scientific manner. This role will prioritize the safe and appropriate use of BMS products while also focusing on overall business results and performance objectives while exemplifying BMS values.

The TAS role is field-based. A TAS is anticipated to spend much of their time spent field with external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Promotion

  • Promotes approved indications of BMS products within a defined territory or region to meet or exceed assigned sales targets in a compliant manner.

  • Creates demand for BMS medicines by articulating in a balanced manner the clinical and scientific rationale for use of products in appropriate patients.

  • Engages with and continuously maintains/grows a high level of scientific expertise in all assigned products and therapeutic areas.

  • Prepares and successfully implements comprehensive territory and account plans.

  • Proactively uses available tools such as SOPHIA to derive insights and to dynamically inform call plans.

  • Provides feedback on experience using these tools to leadership to enable continuous improvement.

Fair & Balanced Scientific Dialogue

  • Demonstrates scientific expertise and passion in using approved scientific resources and publications to present information to HCPs and ensures medical accuracy.

  • Conducts in-office presentations (e.g., lunch and learns) and discusses product-related scientific information with HCPs that is consistent with label.

  • Organizes external speaker programs, selecting speakers from list approved by Speakers Bureau and facilitating scheduling and logistics.

  • Maintains a high level of working expertise on emerging data for approved indications.

  • Engages real-time medical support through Medical on Call to reactively answer unsolicited questions and complex technical inquiries.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Proactively collaborates with other field teams to ensure the best Customer Experience (Cx) for HCPs.

  • Gathers and shares relevant insights and information internally with the appropriate stakeholders to enable BMS to better serve its customers.

Complies with all laws, regulations, and policies that govern the conduct of BMS.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific degree and/or preferred 5+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience as healthcare sales / MSL / HCP / nurse.

  • Ability to communicate scientific or clinical data accurately and convincingly to help physicians best serve their patients.

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining strong credibility with key customers, office staff, and others in the customer influence network via a customer-centric mindset and desire to create positive and differentiated Customer Experience (Cx).

  • Experience in cardiovascular preferred.

  • Demonstrated strong capability in account management skill sets, superior selling competencies, and proven sales performance track record of meeting or exceeding goals.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functionally with a positive team mindset and can-do attitude.

  • Strong selling and promotional skills proven through a track record of performance.

Key competencies desired

Customer/commercial mindset

  • Demonstrated ability to drive business results.

  • Experience identifying, engaging, and cultivating credibility with customers across the patient care journey.

  • Demonstrated account management skills and problem-solving mentality. Understands the patient journey and can customize engagement and deliver tailored messages.

  • Demonstrated resourcefulness and ability to connect with customers.

Patient centricity

  • Understands the patient journey and experience.

  • Has a patient-focused mindset.

Scientific Agility

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate scientific and clinical data in an easy-to-understand manner to help HCPs best serve their patients.

  • Has a strong learning mindset and passion for science. Prioritizes staying current with the latest data.

Analytical Capability:

  • Ability to analyze data, such as prescribing patterns, market trends, and HCP preferences. Data-driven insights help TAS strategize and target their efforts effectively.

  • Ability to segment HCPs based on their preferences and other relevant factors. This helps them tailor their communication and product presentations to suit individual HCP needs.

  • Understanding how to interpret and analyze data related to BMS products, customer preferences, clinical data.

  • Ability to use CE^3 to generate insights and do dynamic call planning.

Digital Agility:

  • Understanding, adapting, and effectively using technology in various aspects of healthcare business and interacting with HCPs.

  • Utilizing various digital communication channels such as emails, instant messaging apps, and video conferencing to stay in touch with healthcare professionals, colleagues, and clients. This enables TAS to respond promptly to inquiries, share updates, and maintain effective communication.

  • Competency using CE^3 and other software or CRM tools to collect, enter, and manage quality data in a timely and compliant manner, track interactions, and plan future engagements with healthcare professionals.

  • Ability to use the Medical on Call technology effectively.

  • Keeping up to date with technological advancements and changes.

Teamwork/Enterprise mindset

  • Strong business acumen to understand and analyze business, market drivers, and develop, execute, and adjust business plans.

  • Demonstrates a strong sense of learning agility. Seeks out and learns from unfamiliar experiences, and then applies those lessons to achieve better results in subsequent situations.

  • Track record of balancing individual drive and collaborative attitude.

  • Holds a high level of integrity and good judgment to navigate the role's requirements effectively and compliantly in accordance with BMS policies and procedures.

As this position requires the operation of a Company-provided vehicle, offers of employment are contingent upon the candidate meeting the requirements of “Qualified Driver,” as determined by the Company in its sole discretion, including but not limited to the following: 1) at least 21 years of age; 2) a driver’s license in good standing issued by your state of residence; and, 3) a driving risk level deemed acceptable by the Company.

Logistics Analyst

Description -

Role Summary


The Outbound Operations Lead / Analyst is the on-site expert who orchestrates all shipping activities- picking, packing, staging, loading, and system transactions within HP’s distribution operations. Blending shop-floor coordination with advanced analytics, the role ensures that every order departs safely, on time, and in full. Working side-by-side with 3PL partners, Transportation, Customer Support, and IT teams, this individual contributor drives day-to-day execution while uncovering process improvements that elevate customer experience, cost efficiency, and compliance. This position will work fulltime onsite at our east coast DC in Hagerstown, MD.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily outbound operations, ensuring accurate and timely order fulfillment, packing, and shipping in line with HP’s quality and service standards.
  • Lead and support process improvement initiatives focused on optimizing outbound flow, reducing order cycle times, minimizing shipping errors, and enhancing on-time delivery performance.
  • Collaborate with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Warehouse, IT, and Transportation teams to coordinate outbound shipments, resolve exceptions, and ensure alignment with customer requirements.
  • Track real-time metrics such as pick accuracy, order fill rate, on-time ship, trailer utilization, and dock-to-door cycle time; initiate immediate countermeasures when performance drifts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for order expedites, configuration changes, embargo checks, and any customer-facing shipment issues.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs for outbound operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform outbound quality audits- scan accuracy, weight checks, and load inspections- to prevent mis-ships and damage, driving corrective actions with 3PL floor leaders.
  • Train and coach warehouse staff on best practices for picking, packing, and shipping processes.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects related to layout optimization, packaging solutions, and supply chain transformation.
  • Analyse order, carrier, and freight-cost data to uncover waste and bottlenecks; develop dashboards and executive summaries that translate insights into actionable improvement roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in outbound or shipping operations within a distribution, fulfillment, or manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP) and familiarity with transportation processes managed through a 4PL model.
  • Proficiency with Excel plus a data-visualization tool such as Power BI or Tableau; able to translate raw data into actionable insights.
  • Strong communication and influence skills; comfortable directing 3PL associates and collaborating with a remote 4PL team without direct authority.
  • Understanding of domestic parcel, LTL, and truckload shipping requirements and basic export documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a 3PL-run facility or a technology supply chain
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or APICS certification (CSCP, CPIM).
  • Exposure to CTPAT, ISO 9001, or other compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with HP’s products, distribution models, or technology sector best practices.

title: Transformation Lead - Data & Technology Op Model Delivery
description:
Transformation Lead - Data & Technology Op Model Delivery

location: London

practice area: Change and Transformation

Altum Consulting is partnering with a leading charity to recruit a Transformation Delivery Manager to deliver a new operating model across its Data & Technology function.

Alongside a major digital transformation, the organisation is reshaping how data and technology support its wider strategic ambitions. This includes strengthening capabilities, responding to emerging technologies and ensuring the function can meet changing business needs.

Working closely with the CTO, Chief Data Officer and executive sponsor, you will translate operating model design into practical delivery, carrying the programme through implementation and embedding new ways of working. This is a senior, hands‑on opportunity to influence how an entire function operates within a purpose‑led organisation.

The role

Partnering with an external specialist consultancy leading the organisation design work, you will bring structure and momentum to the programme, ensuring decisions translate into coordinated action.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and managing an integrated delivery plan across organisation design, governance, capability development and change.
  • Coordinating workstreams, managing dependencies and maintaining oversight of milestones, risks and decisions.
  • Running programme governance and steering committees, ensuring clear reporting and timely escalation.
  • Bringing together senior stakeholders across technology, data and the wider organisation.
  • Planning workshops and building an effective communications and change approach to support colleagues through the transition.
  • Translating external recommendations into achievable implementation plans and embedding changes to responsibilities and ways of working.
  • Defining success measures and tracking improvements in organisational effectiveness and delivery performance.

The role has no direct reports, so you will need to be comfortable driving delivery through influence while remaining closely involved in the detail.

About you

We are looking for an experienced Programme Manager or Transformation Delivery Lead with a strong track record of delivering operating model and organisational change within a data or technology function.

You will bring:

  • A practical understanding of data and technology operating models, governance and capability requirements.
  • Experience taking organisational change from design through implementation and adoption.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to work across technical specialists, organisation design experts and executive leadership.
  • Experience coordinating external partners and multiple interdependent workstreams.
  • Excellent communication and change management skills, with a sensitive approach to changes affecting people.
  • The confidence to work through ambiguity and maintain delivery momentum as priorities evolve.

Charity experience is not essential. Experience within other complex organisations is welcomed, alongside an appreciation of working in a purpose‑led environment.

title: Internal Auditor II
description:
Overview

The Internal Auditor II independently performs professional audit assignments of moderate complexity involving financial, operational, compliance, and information technology reviews. This position applies professional judgment in evaluating risks, internal controls, and business processes while developing recommendations that strengthen governance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

Responsibilities

Audit Planning and Execution

  • Plan and conduct financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and effectiveness audits of moderate scope and complexity.
  • Perform preliminary research, process walkthroughs, interviews, and risk assessments to understand the area under review and identify significant risks and controls.
  • Develop audit objectives, scopes, work plans, testing procedures, sampling approaches, and timelines with guidance on new or unusually complex engagements.
  • Manage assigned audit engagements, communicate progress, address emerging issues, and complete work within established quality and timeline expectations.

Control Evaluation and Analysis

  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls intended to protect university resources, support reliable reporting, and promote compliance.
  • Test financial and operating processes for compliance with laws, regulations, contracts, professional standards, and university policies and procedures.
  • Analyze financial, transactional, operational, and system-generated data to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, compliance concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain complete audit working papers that clearly document evidence, analyses, professional judgments, findings, and conclusions.

Findings, Reporting, and Recommendations

  • Develop well-supported audit findings that clearly describe the condition, criteria, cause, risk, impact, and recommended corrective action.
  • Prepare formal written reports and management communications that present complex or sensitive audit information clearly, objectively, and constructively.
  • Discuss preliminary observations with departmental representatives, validate factual accuracy, and obtain management perspectives before finalizing findings.
  • Recommend practical corrective actions that strengthen controls, reduce risk, improve compliance, and enhance operational efficiency.

Investigations and Corrective Action Monitoring

  • Participate in investigations involving suspected misconduct, misuse of resources, control violations, or improper activities by evaluating allegations and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor management corrective action plans, evaluate implementation evidence, and communicate unresolved or overdue actions to audit leadership.
  • Determine whether completed corrective actions adequately address the identified condition and associated risk.

External Audit and Advisory Support

  • Coordinate external auditor and regulatory agency requests, including document collection, departmental communication, scheduling, and response tracking.
  • Provide advice to university departments regarding internal controls, policy interpretation, risk mitigation, and sound business practices without assuming management responsibility.

Team and Departmental Contributions

  • Provide technical guidance, peer review, and day-to-day support to entry-level audit professionals.
  • Contribute to departmental risk assessments, audit planning, process improvement, and professional practice initiatives.
  • Share knowledge, templates, and lessons learned that improve consistency across audit engagements.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Public Administration, or related field with 3 years of relevant work experience OR an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to attain a certification such as Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) within 2 years from hire date.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in higher education, government, nonprofit, or other public sector environments.
  • Professional certification (e.g., CIA, CPA, CISA, or a similar credential).
  • Familiarity with higher education administrative systems, such as Banner.
  • Experience auditing federally funded programs, grants, or sponsored research.
  • Knowledge of higher education regulations and compliance requirements.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  • Knowledge of auditing principles, internal controls, accounting fundamentals, professional ethics, and Microsoft Office and data analysis tools.
  • Knowledge of internal auditing standards, risk assessment methodologies, internal control frameworks, higher education business operations, and applicable compliance requirements.
  • Skill in planning and conducting audits, analyzing data, interviewing stakeholders, preparing professional reports, and solving complex problems.
  • Ability to independently manage audit assignments, evaluate operational processes and internal controls, communicate audit results effectively.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent engagements.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Ability to build collaborative working relationships while managing multiple assignments and competing priorities.

Required Documents

Along with the online application, please attach:

  • Resume to be uploaded at the beginning of your application in the Candidate Profile under “Resume/CV”
  • Cover letter to be typed/pasted at the end of your application

**Document size may not exceed 10 MB.**

Minimum $63,070; Commensurate with experience, plus excellent benefits

title: Java Backend Engineer
description:
Java Backend Engineer - Requirements & Job Description

We are looking for strong Java candidates with knowledge of Apache Flink and experience with AWS services (EKS, S3, etc.). Our application focuses heavily on file processing.

Required Skills

Core Engineering

  • Strong proficiency in Java and object-oriented programming.
  • Ability to write custom frameworks and reusable components.

Data & File Processing

  • Hands-on experience with file handling and processing on VSIs and Amazon S3.
  • Proven experience with large-file processing at scale.
  • Working knowledge of Apache Flink (recommended).
  • Hands-on experience with messaging and streaming technologies such as MQ and/or Kafka.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native application development.
  • Working knowledge of AWS (recommended).
  • Experience designing highly resilient, share-nothing, multi-region architectures.

Ways of Working & Tooling

  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and/or Claude.
  • Experience working in Agile, self-managing teams.

Job Description

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Java backend services.
  • Engineer large-scale file handling and processing across VSIs and Amazon S3, and build streaming/batch pipelines with Apache Flink on AWS.
  • Deploy on Kubernetes using cloud-native patterns, with share-nothing, multi-region architecture for fault tolerance, high availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Develop robust REST APIs, enforcing best practices for security, scalability, versioning, documentation, and error handling.
  • Integrate and manage service registries for dynamic service discovery in microservices environments.
  • Use AI-assisted tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

title: Regional Echo Liaison (REL) - LA, E. TX
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Are you passionate about advancing cardiovascular care and improving patient outcomes? Join our field medical team as a Regional Echo Liaison, where you’ll play a critical role in bridging clinical science and real-world practice.

In this role, you will engage directly with healthcare professionals and thought leaders, providing scientific expertise and education in echocardiography—particularly in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). Your work will help ensure the safe and effective use of therapies while delivering valuable insights from the field to inform broader medical strategy. You’ll be part of a team committed to innovation, collaboration, and improving patient outcomes. We offer a supportive and high-performing environment where your expertise is valued, your voice is heard, and your work makes a meaningful impact across the healthcare community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with Thought Leaders and Healthcare Providers
  • Lead peer-to-peer scientific discussions focused on the safe and appropriate use of therapies
  • Gather and communicate field-based insights on disease state, clinical practice, and patient management
  • Translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, actionable insights for echocardiography and sonography professionals
  • Serve as a trusted scientific resource within the healthcare community
  • Align field activities with medical strategy and evolving stakeholder needs


Qualifications & Experience

  • Graduate of an accredited ultrasound program (echocardiography required); bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Active cardiac ultrasound registry (RDCS or RCS required)
  • Minimum of 5 years of adult echocardiography experience
  • Experience in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) strongly preferred
  • Strong knowledge of HCM and familiarity with relevant scientific literature
  • Proven ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical data clearly and effectively
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Additional Requirements

  • Home-based role with 50–70% travel, including overnight and occasional weekend travel
  • Ability to travel by car and/or air as needed
  • Ability to lift up to 45 lbs and transport educational equipment (e.g., simulator)

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

The Datacenter Engineer- L3/ERT role requires supporting Aruba products as per the entitlement. It involves understanding the customer environment, capturing logs, and troubleshooting to achieve the resolution or provide the Root Cause of the incident.

The Level 3 TAC engineer is expected to work across different shifts in a dynamic 24x7 work environment.

In a typical day as a Datacenter Engineer- L3/ERT, you would...

  • Provide HPE Aruba customers & Engineers troubleshooting & support in the areas of HPE Aruba Networking and related areas.
  • Provide leadership in technical problem management and the resolution of all issues, working closely with Global Enterprise Customers, HPE Aruba remote, and field support staff.
  • Develop action plans to investigate and resolve complex issues/problems and communicate these to engineers, customers, and/or relevant managers.

4+ Years’ experience in the Networking field with a minimum of 3 years supporting Data Center Technologies.

title: Advanced Gameplay Engineer
description:
Job Posting Title:

Advanced Gameplay Engineer

Req ID:

10161215

Job Description:

About the Role

Disney Digital Entertainment is on a mission to create the ‘digital front door’ for The Walt Disney Company, bringing all of the magic of Disney together into a new interactive universe.


We are building an expert development team that will be building game experiences that will herald the next generation of Disney to the world. Working with top-class industry talent, this role is perfect for the accomplished game engineer looking to create something epic - collaborating with an incredible group of game developers focusing on individual experiences to build a wonderfully rich and cohesive product that is truly “Disney”.


We are looking for a uniquely talented Advanced Gameplay Engineer to join us on this journey! If you are an experienced game programmer with a love of Disney/Pixar, Star Wars, 20th Century, and Marvel properties, you’ll want to check out this opportunity!


This role will report to the Director, Gameplay Engineering.


What You Will Do

  • Leverage your experience and knowledge to help implement several interactive games and experiences based on Disney’s robust portfolio of characters and worlds including Disney/Pixar, 20th Century, Marvel and Star Wars.
  • Be an active, hands-on participant in the process, directly writing code and working daily with design/production/art to establish and achieve goals for each game experience.
  • A significant portion of this work will involve implementation of experiences using SceneGraph and Verse (UEFN/Unreal Editor Fortnite) as a base. This role will require a willingness and ability to operate within the limitations of that ecosystem and grow with it as the functionality matures.
  • There may be additional work within the native Unreal Engine environment (C++/Blueprints), however the primary responsibility will still come back to SceneGraph and Verse. This is not a 100% C++ position.
  • Help the team understand and debug a large legacy Unreal Engine project. This job may involve helping to extend that codebase to meet our needs.
  • Empower designers by serving as their main support avenue during game development. Find creative ways to overcome limitations, maintaining a positive outlook along the way.
  • Work closely with other members of the engineering team to ensure that implementation quality is maintained. Be an advocate of stability and flexibility.
  • Champion Disney and team values. Maintain a ‘guest-first’ mentality by being an advocate for the player experience.
  • As an advanced-level engineer, you will help drive critical leading edge projects for the company.
  • Serve as a key member of a growing game development team at Disney.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 8 years of experience developing console/PC/mobile games or other digital interactive entertainment.
  • Experience with Unreal Engine 4/5+ at the native (C++) level. Capable of understanding and working in an existing legacy C++/Blueprint-heavy project.
  • Some experience with UEFN/Verse, at least at the hobby-ist level.
  • Participated in the creation and release of a major product, in a hands-on programming role. Was one of the main authors of a significant gameplay system.
  • Served as a programmer during the prototype phase of a project. Understands the difference in requirements/goals between prototyping and production.
  • Understands and implements the following concepts at a production-quality, AAA level:
    • C++ code (Performance Impact, Memory Management, Inheritance, etc.)
    • Client/Server architecture (Replication, Client-side Prediction, Movement Syncing, etc.)
    • Game Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Vector Math, Kinematic Physics, Collision, etc.)
  • Able to mentor and to guide junior engineers.

Education:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with publishing and supporting live UEFN content.
  • Graphics Programming, Mobile experience, and familiarity with Online Services are all bonuses.
  • Has a broad, current understanding of Fortnite and the various devices that are available for User Generated Content (UGC).
  • Experience developing and supporting products in the AAA space.

Additional Information

  • There will be a technical assessment as part of the interview process.

Benefits
