description:
WHO WE ARE

Apex Fintech Solutions (Apex) powers innovation and the future of digital wealth management by building tech-forward solutions that help simplify, automate, and facilitate access to financial markets for all. Our robust suite of fintech software enables us to support clients such as Stash, Betterment, SoFi, Webull, and eToro, amongst many others; collectively, Apex powers access to the stock market for over 22+ million end customers.

At Apex, we are changing how the securities industry operates by reinventing the status quo, which was manual, slow, and accessible only by the ultra-wealthy. We're digitizing and democratizing systems so that everyone has an opportunity to invest.

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

We’re proud to be recognized for the innovative work we do, the purpose-driven nature of our work, and the collaborative culture we’ve created. Here are just a few of the many awards we’ve recently received:

Best Places to Work

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023- Presented by BuiltIn

WealthTech of the Year

2025- Presented by US FinTech Awards

The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies

2024- Presented by CNBC

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Position Overview:

As a DevOps Engineer you will be a key member of the Apex Tax and Cost Basis engineering team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the automation that runs our batch processing platform across client environments. Your primary focus will be converting today's run-day and disaster recovery scripts into parameterized, orchestrated deployment pipelines and workflows, and building the deployment management tooling that tracks which version is running in each environment. This is a hybrid application engineering / systems engineering role: you will support new client implementations and custom scripts on the application side, and manage pipelines and run-day operations on the systems side. You will work closely with our development, TechOps, and cloud infrastructure teams to make the platform more sustainable and scalable.

Workflow Orchestration:

Migrate existing run-day, disaster recovery, and operational scripts into orchestrated deployment pipelines and workflows. Design, build, and operate production workflows with clear dependencies, retries, and alerting.

Script Parameterization:

Refactor runtime scripts so they are parameterized, reusable, and environment-agnostic, eliminating hardcoded per-client and per-environment values and the manual edits that come with them.

Deployment Management:

Build and maintain tooling that tracks build versions across environments (development, QA, UAT, production) and automates deployment and promotion between them.

Client Implementations:

Support new client onboarding by developing and adapting custom scripts, configuration, and automation on the application side.

Run-Day Operations:

Manage processing pipelines and run-day operations. Troubleshoot batch failures, identify root cause, and replace repeat manual intervention with durable automated fixes.

Cloud Automation:

Build and operate automation on Amazon Web Services (AWS) using native CLIs, SDKs, and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Monitoring and Notifications:

Build alerting and notification automation (Slack, email) so failures and stalls surface before they affect clients.

Process Improvement:

Think critically about existing processes and propose better solutions rather than maintaining the status quo. Drive improvements that make the platform more sustainable and scalable.

Documentation:

Maintain comprehensive documentation of workflows, runbooks, deployment procedures, and automation standards.

Collaboration:

Collaborate with development, TechOps, and infrastructure teams to streamline how work moves from code to production.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years experience as a developer (Python, Java, shell, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience building and operating orchestrated deployment pipelines and production workflows.
  • Strong Python and shell scripting (bash) skills.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, primarily Amazon Web Services (AWS), and automating against them.
  • Experience with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and managing versions and releases across multiple environments.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL).
  • A developer's mindset applied to operations: the ability to see a manual process, understand why it exists, and design something better.
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Apache Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools.
  • Experience automating disaster recovery processes.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Java development experience.
  • Background in financial services, brokerage operations, tax reporting, or cost basis processing.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Our Rewards

We offer a robust package of employee perks and benefits, including a market-leading salary with an annual bonus, 28 days of annual leave plus 10 Northern Ireland national holidays, a training and development budget, and a pension matched up to 7%. Our benefits also cover private health insurance for medical, dental, and optical care, and life insurance. We emphasize work-life balance with flexible working hours, parental leave, a modern city center office, and a hybrid work schedule that allows for greater flexibility by partially working from home. Additional perks include monthly catered lunches, unlimited drinks and snacks, hackathon events, poker tournaments, and a charitable matching gift program.

title: Director, AI & Machine Learning
description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Director, AI & Machine Learning


ABOUT AMGEN

At Amgen, if you feel like you are part of something bigger, it is because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we have helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With a focus on oncology, inflammation, general medicine, and rare disease, we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you will help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines.

Our culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Role Description

Let's do this. Let's change the world.

The Director, AI & Machine Learning will play a key role in advancing Amgen Research’s AI capabilities by providing technical direction and engineering leadership across strategic initiatives. The role will help accelerate the development and adoption of AI solutions while building a strong, reusable technical foundation that can support evolving priorities across the Research organization.

The leader will provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering expertise to advance scalable AI and machine learning capabilities across Amgen Research. This role will guide the design, integration, and evolution of AI-enabled solutions, helping translate scientific and business needs into reliable, scalable, and maintainable technical capabilities.

The successful candidate combines strong AI/ML and software engineering expertise with technical leadership, product thinking, and scientific curiosity. You will partner across multidisciplinary teams to guide technical decisions, establish engineering best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and enable the effective adoption of AI capabilities across a broad portfolio of Research initiatives.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Set AI and ML strategy and roadmap. Develop and guide multi-department AI/ML strategy aligned to R&D, clinical, medical, operations, and commercial priorities. Shape and lead the R&D AI/ML roadmap, with a focus on shared scientific data and models, reusable AI capabilities, and scalable end-to-end research workflows. Identify investment opportunities with clear scientific, operational, and business value.
  • Lead advanced ML programs. Sponsor and direct the design, validation, and scale-up of ML, generative AI, foundation-model, and agentic AI solutions from opportunity framing through production adoption.
  • Establish production ML architecture. Drive platform choices, modernization roadmaps, reusable engineering patterns, and quality standards that enable dependable model delivery at scale across multiple departments. Establish scalable architecture patterns that integrate scientific data, tools, predictive and generative models, and AI agents into reusable end-to-end scientific workflows.
  • Guide MLOps and data platform strategy. Prioritize investments in data quality, lineage, experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, model registry, release governance, and lifecycle operations to reduce delivery time and improve compliance readiness.
  • Champion responsible AI and model governance. Ensure AI/ML governance standards are implemented across the portfolio; balance innovation, patient impact, regulatory expectations, security, privacy, and operational risk through practical controls and review forums.
  • Build high-performing teams and capability. Recruit, develop, and retain strong ML engineering talent; guide senior professionals and create an inclusive culture of technical excellence, scientific rigor, continuous learning, and accountable execution.
  • Drive portfolio value and measurable outcomes. Set investment logic, success measures, and portfolio-level KPIs that demonstrate scientific, operational, and business impact. Measure the adoption and value of scientific AI capabilities through outcomes such as workflow completion time, research productivity, result quality, user satisfaction, and production adoption, while managing value, risk, feasibility, adoption, cost, and speed trade-offs.
  • Build strategic alliances and influence decisions. Partner with scientists, digital and technology leaders, data/platform teams, quality, legal, compliance, privacy, and information security to plan major changes and integrate AI/ML into real workflows.
  • Communicate with executive clarity. Develop clear narratives, roadmaps, and recommendations that enable senior stakeholders to understand technical options, assumptions, risks, and investment decisions.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a Director with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:


Doctorate degree and 4 years of Director, AI & Machine Learning experience
OR
Master’s degree and 8 years of Director, AI & Machine Learning experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 10 years of Director, AI & Machine Learning experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have at least 4 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above

  • AI/ML technical leadership. Expert AI/ML engineering knowledge with a demonstrated record of setting technical and modeling strategy for scientific research applications. Proven ability to evaluate emerging AI/ML methods, make consequential architecture and technology decisions, and translate scientific needs into reusable, scalable AI capabilities and production-grade research workflows.
  • Production systems and architecture. Deep hands-on understanding of software engineering and production AI/ML system design, including scalable APIs and pipelines, cloud platforms, model serving, evaluation, observability, and maintainable system architecture that support reusable scientific capabilities and workflows..
  • Data, MLOps, and lifecycle operations. Experience directing reusable data and MLOps capabilities, including lineage, reproducibility, validation, monitoring, drift detection, CI/CD, incident response, auditability, and model retirement.
  • Responsible AI in a regulated environment. Ability to implement fit-for-purpose governance, validation evidence, model documentation, risk controls, access safeguards, and review mechanisms for sensitive or regulated AI/ML applications.
  • People and organizational leadership. Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing technical teams, developing senior professionals, informing resource allocation, and guiding advanced programs through major change.
  • Strategic stakeholder management. Strong record of building alliances across scientific, business, and technology functions; partnering with scientists and research workflow owners to translate complex scientific needs into scalable AI/ML solutions; influencing decisions without formal authority; and communicating complex ML strategy to leadership audiences.
  • Generative AI and systems thinking. Experience setting strategy for foundation models and enterprise AI adoption, balancing innovation, compliance, platform reuse, operating risk, workforce enablement, and scientific or business value.

Education and Professional Certifications

  • Education. Doctorate degree with 10-12+ years of relevant experience in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, computational science, data science, engineering, or a related field; OR Bachelor's degree with 12-14+ years of relevant experience.
  • Technical depth. Demonstrated experience with Python and modern ML/deep-learning frameworks (for example, PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX), along with cloud and data platforms used to deploy AI/ML solutions at scale.
  • Certifications. Relevant cloud, AI/ML, or MLOps certifications (for example, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks) are a plus.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Agentic AI architectures. Experience designing, evaluating, and governing agentic AI architectures, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, guardrails, human oversight, and production monitoring.
  • Scientific background. Academic or professional background in chemistry, biology, biochemistry, biophysics, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related life-science discipline.
  • Scientific AI and foundation models. Experience with AI/ML enabled approaches for biological and molecular research, including protein structure prediction, Protein Language Models (PLMs), biological foundation models, molecular design, or related computational biology and chemistry applications is a plus.
  • Biopharma and regulated domains. Experience applying AI/ML in pharma, biotech, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, including an understanding of privacy, consent, data provenance, quality, and compliance expectations.
  • Enterprise platform experience. Experience partnering with cloud, data engineering, security, and platform teams to build reusable AI/ML capabilities using Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable technology ecosystems.
  • Scientific and executive communication. Ability to turn technical evidence into concise, decision-ready narratives for scientific leaders, business leaders, and senior executives.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. We are in Barcelona, we are being built from scratch this year, and we have the backing, the customers and the product portfolio of a company that has been around for decades. You get the interesting part of a new team without the part where you check whether payroll clears.Two more things about where this comes from and where it goes. The group has been running a tech lab in Casablanca for more than eight years — Barcelona is its second, built to sit closer to the teams we build for, and AI-native from the first commit, because it starts from a blank page. You would arrive at the start of that curve, not after it.What we build is the software that automates professional-services work — across roughly fifteen countries, for businesses that are drowning in process. title: Shop Helper
description:
The Shop Helper supports technicians and the service team in the safe, efficient maintenance and repair of cranes and lifting equipment. Typical duties include:

Essential Functions

  • Keep shop, yard, and work areas clean and organized (sweeping, trash removal, wiping down equipment, spill clean-up).
  • Assist with moving cranes, components, and attachments under supervision (using forklifts, overhead cranes, pallet jacks, etc., as trained).
  • Set up and tear down work areas for incoming jobs (stands, cribbing, blocking, drip pans, lighting, extension cords)
    • Help technicians with basic tasks: removing/installing covers, panels, guards, and components as directed.
    • Hold, position, and secure parts or tools during repairs.
    • Run for parts, tools, and supplies from the parts room, yard, or trucks.
    • Help with basic lubricating and greasing, checking fluid levels, and simple inspections under direct supervision
      • Clean and put away shop tools, cords, and hoses at the end of jobs.
      • Inspect basic shop tools for obvious damage and report issues.
      • Help maintain shop equipment (cleaning pressure washers, welders’ leads, torches, etc.).
      • Ensure ladders, stands, rigging, and cribbing are stored properly.
        • Assist with rigging and moving components under the direction of a qualified rigger/technician.
        • Help set up blocking and cribbing for booms, counterweights, and other heavy components.
        • Follow all rigging and signaling instructions from designated personnel.
          • Follow all shop safety policies, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout instructions.
          • Maintain clear walkways, exits, and equipment access areas.
          • Immediately report unsafe conditions, leaks, spills, or damage to equipment.
          • Participate in safety meetings and basic safety training as required.

          Other duties and qualifications

            • Assist with fueling, washing, and detailing cranes and service vehicles as directed.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client builds drugs for patient populations that traditional generic development doesn't reach, not more of the same generic drugs. To do it, their pharma, ML and data scientists rely on a mix of LLM-based applications and standard full stack software. They build this software in-house. Engineers work directly alongside the scientists using it, turning their sharpest and most ambiguous questions into shipped features, not into a support ticket for someone else's platform.

What you'll do

  • Own applications end to end. Get up to speed across their mix of LLM-based and standard full stack applications, then take ownership of a growing share of them. As you take on more, you'll be designing and building features end to end rather than working one corner of a single product.
  • Turn scientists' questions into shipped software. You'll work day to day with pharma, ML and data scientists, and with a few other engineers on the team. Take a rough idea of what a scientist needs, spec it out into concrete requirements yourself, then build it. There's no separate product function doing that translation for you.
  • Move fast with unclear inputs. This is a high-velocity, low-structure job: expect a constant stream of unstructured feedback and the need to turn it into shipped, working software, not a fully-scoped ticket.
  • Build the agents, not just use them. Build and evaluate agentic and multi-agent systems as a core part of the job. This isn't a side project or an experiment, it's part of the core application set scientists rely on day to day.
  • Grow by taking on more. Our client is a young company without a fixed playbook: the more you build, the more you can own. Progression here is driven by impact rather than tenure. One of the team's current engineers joined as an intern and now owns engineering end to end.

Who we're looking for

A full stack engineer who has taken a product from an idea to production, and who has built and shipped a real AI agent, not just experimented with one.

Core experience

  • 3 to 5 years as a full stack engineer, strong in Python and TypeScript
  • Has taken at least one application from zero to one (full front end and back end) through to completion
  • Has built a real agentic AI application and can talk about how its impact was measured, not just that it was built

Preferred background

  • Pharma or biotech experience is the strongest fit
  • A general research background, in any field, is a solid second
  • Open to strong candidates from other backgrounds too
  • Startup experience is strongly preferred over big tech

Also required

  • High autonomy: comfortable owning a problem end to end with minimal hand-holding
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities
  • Confident coordinating directly with non-engineering stakeholders (scientists), not just other engineers

title: Coop/Student - Full Stack Developer (On-site)
description:
Coop/Student - Full Stack Developer (On-site)

Altona, MB Full-time

At Elmer’s we’ve been equipping farmers with innovative solutions for 40 years. Owning and operating our own farm we understand what farmers need and want out of our products and our company. We strive to provide our customers with products that will effectively handle even the toughest environments. Harvest after harvest, our mission is to produce world-class farm equipment for the needs of the progressive farmer.

We have an upcoming opportunity in the Software Development Department as a Full Stack Developer co-op student, working alongside the engineers who design, build and support the machines themselves.

Every machine we build sends data home. Weights, field locations, unload records and diagnostics travel from a controller in the field, through the cloud, and into the apps that farmers, dealers and our own support team rely on. As a student on our applications team you will work across that whole path: the interfaces people use, the services behind them, and the integration points where embedded controllers, mobile apps and cloud systems have to agree with each other. We work in Laravel and Vue, Rust, PostgreSQL and .NET MAUI, but we hire on how you think rather than on what you have already used.

Availability: 4-month or 8 month co-op term

In This Role You Will

  • Build features end to end, from the interface a customer sees through to the services and data behind it.
  • Work on the APIs that connect our field equipment to the cloud, where the controller on the machine, the mobile app and the web application all have to agree on the same record.
  • Help design integration points between systems that were not built to talk to each other, including our equipment, our web platform and the software the rest of the business runs on.
  • Solve the problems that come with equipment operating where connectivity is poor: syncing, conflict resolution and making sure nothing is lost when a machine comes back online.
  • Turn raw machine telemetry into something a farmer can act on: dashboards, reports, maps and exports.
  • Contribute to cross-platform mobile apps that pair directly with equipment in the field.
  • Design database schemas and write queries that stay fast as the data grows.
  • Write tests, review code and ship through our CI pipeline.
  • Take part in planning, standups and demos, and present your own work to the team.
  • Working toward a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience building something real on either side of the stack, with any modern framework. We care that you have shipped something, not which tools you used.
  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data modelling.
  • Git, and the habits that come with working in a codebase other people also touch.
  • Curiosity about the physical side of the system. The data in these applications comes off a real machine.
  • An asset: TypeScript, PHP, C# or Rust.
  • An asset: Docker, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or any experience running what you built.
  • An asset: time-series or geospatial data, mobile development, working with APIs or hardware, or a good eye for interface design.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a dynamic, growing workplace that provides opportunities for all staff to have an impact.

Our facility is conveniently situated near Altona, MB. Altona is an attractive, caring, and progressive community with abundant cultural, recreational, and educational opportunities for all ages. With amenities and opportunities that rival much larger municipalities, there’s no better place to be.

• Cross-functional collaboration skills

________________________________________

o Enterprise switching TAC
o Network engineering
o Data-center / campus networking

Preferred Certifications

• ITIL Expert (nice to have)

The Sr. Director leads a globally distributed organization responsible for building scalable data pipelines, operating enterprise data platforms, defining architecture standards, delivering business insights and reporting, executing enterprise migrations and integrations, and establishing governance practices that ensure enterprise data is trusted, consistent, discoverable, and aligned to business objectives.

The role partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Applications, Finance, Product Ownership, Integration Delivery, Information Security, Service Management, and business stakeholders to align data strategy, reporting, analytics, governance, migration, and integration priorities with enterprise objectives while maximizing business value from the firm's data assets.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Enterprise Data & Analytics Strategy

  • Define and execute the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy, operating model, roadmap, and service delivery framework.

  • Lead the Data & Analytics organization across Data Foundations, Architecture, Analytics, Migration & Integration, and Governance.

  • Establish a scalable internal capability for data delivery, strengthening ownership, accountability, quality, reliability, and business outcomes.

  • Partner with business, technology, product, finance, security, and operational stakeholders to align enterprise priorities with data investments and capabilities.

  • Govern the portfolio of data initiatives spanning platform modernization, analytics, enterprise reporting, migration programs, AI readiness, and governance.

  • Define success measures for adoption, reuse, data quality, governance maturity, compliance, and business value realization.

  • Build a product-oriented operating model where enterprise data assets are reusable, governed, scalable, and business aligned.

Data Foundations & Platform Operations

  • Lead the build and operation of the enterprise data foundation, including data engineering, platform operations, observability, lifecycle management, and operational governance.

  • Oversee enterprise data pipelines supporting ingestion, transformation, curation, and consumption.

  • Ensure the enterprise data lake and medallion architecture supports reporting, analytics, AI, and data product requirements.

  • Drive DataOps practices including monitoring, orchestration, deployment, testing, lineage, SLA management, and support.

  • Establish standards for reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational excellence.

  • Enable reusable datasets and shared data assets to improve consistency and reduce duplication across the firm.

Data Architecture

  • Lead enterprise data architecture, standards, and governance.

  • Define the enterprise data blueprint across business domains, integrations, analytics, reporting, AI, and products.

  • Establish standards for data models, domain architecture, metadata, master data, reference data, and information architecture.

  • Ensure enterprise and SAP-related data structures support integrated reporting, migration, governance, analytics, and business operations.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture to ensure data solutions align with enterprise technology standards and long-term architecture objectives.

  • Govern architecture reviews, design standards, and data solution approvals.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights

  • Lead delivery of enterprise reporting, dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, self-service analytics, and advanced analytics capabilities.

  • Ensure trusted enterprise data is transformed into actionable business insights, operational transparency, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Partner with business leadership to define KPIs, performance metrics, executive dashboards, financial reporting, client reporting, and operational insights.

  • Lead enterprise reporting strategy, including operational, management, financial, executive, historical, and regulatory reporting capabilities.

  • Lead SAP reporting strategy and ensure SAP reporting data aligns with enterprise definitions, governed metrics, financial hierarchies, security requirements, and reporting standards.

  • Coordinate reporting integration with enterprise platforms, applications, data products, and analytics environments.

  • Establish reporting standards covering certification, documentation, access management, refresh cycles, governance, and retirement.

  • Ensure reporting consistency, data trust, reconciliation processes, metadata management, and common business definitions across the enterprise.

  • Drive adoption and value realization of analytics and reporting products through stakeholder engagement, change management, and continuous improvement.

  • Establish quality controls, data validation, auditability, and lineage practices that support executive confidence in reporting outputs.

Data Migration & Integration

  • Lead enterprise data migration, conversion, integration, and cutover capabilities.

  • Define migration strategies, runbooks, field mappings, harmonization rules, transformation logic, validation frameworks, reconciliation processes, and readiness criteria.

  • Lead enterprise and SAP data migration programs supporting platform modernization, ERP transformation, acquisition integrations, and technology initiatives.

  • Oversee profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and loading of enterprise and SAP data into target platforms.

  • Ensure migration programs include mock conversions, testing cycles, cutover planning, operational readiness, business signoffs, and post-conversion stabilization.

  • Partner with application teams, finance, operations, technology leaders, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure successful data conversion outcomes.

  • Establish reusable migration assets, utilities, transformation patterns, data mappings, conversion methodologies, and playbooks that accelerate future programs.

  • Govern integration patterns spanning APIs, middleware, enterprise service buses (ESB), event-driven architectures, and point-to-point integrations.

  • Ensure migrated and integrated data meets quality, compliance, reporting, operational, governance, security, and audit requirements.

Data Governance & Enterprise Trust

  • Establish enterprise data governance policies, standards, business definitions, and stewardship practices.

  • Define and operate the Data Owner and Data Steward model across business domains.

  • Lead enterprise data quality management, metadata management, lineage, catalog, glossary, and discoverability initiatives.

  • Govern data classification, retention, lifecycle management, usage standards, and access controls.

  • Facilitate governance forums and decision-making bodies that align business, technology, analytics, and architecture stakeholders.

  • Ensure governance practices support analytics, reporting, migration, AI, business operations, and enterprise compliance requirements.

  • Drive accountability for trusted data definitions, ownership, quality, and regulatory compliance.

Leadership & Operating Model

  • Build and lead a high-performing global Data & Analytics organization.

  • Establish clear accountability across Data Foundations, Architecture, Analytics, Migration & Integration, and Governance functions.

  • Develop future leaders and technical talent across engineering, architecture, analytics, governance, and migration disciplines.

  • Create a culture focused on business value, accountability, trust, innovation, operational excellence, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead workforce planning, vendor management, financial management, investment prioritization, and capacity planning.

  • Provide executive-ready communication regarding roadmap progress, migration readiness, reporting delivery, business value realization, risks, quality, compliance, and strategic investment needs.

  • Partner closely with other CTO leadership functions to support enterprise transformation, AI enablement, platform modernization, and M&A integration activities.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in Data & Analytics, data engineering, enterprise architecture, data migration, analytics delivery, reporting, governance, or related technology leadership roles.

  • 7+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale data organizations and global delivery teams.

  • Demonstrated experience building or transforming Data & Analytics organizations with responsibility for foundations, architecture, analytics, migration, and governance functions.

  • Experience leading major ERP, SAP, enterprise platform, data migration, and reporting transformation initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise reporting, business intelligence, semantic models, analytics platforms, KPI frameworks, and executive dashboarding.

  • Experience operating enterprise data platforms including data lakes, medallion architectures, cloud data platforms, and modern analytics ecosystems.

  • Experience establishing enterprise data architecture standards, governance frameworks, stewardship models, metadata management, and data quality programs.

  • Experience managing large-scale migration and integration programs involving data conversion, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, testing, and cutover execution.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to influence executive stakeholders and align technology investments to business outcomes.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics, Business, or related field required.

  • Master's Degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, ERP modernization, SAP reporting, or SAP migration programs.

  • Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Services, or modern cloud data platforms.

  • Experience supporting M&A integrations, platform consolidations, operating model transformations, or enterprise modernization programs.

  • Experience operating within professional services, financial services, consulting, or other complex global enterprises.

  • Experience building AI-ready data foundations and governed analytics ecosystems.

  • Experience developing global delivery center (GDC) operating models across U.S., India, Poland, and Colombia teams.

Success Measures

  • A mature enterprise Data & Analytics operating model is established with clear accountability across Foundations, Architecture, Analytics, Migration & Integration, and Governance.

  • Enterprise data platforms deliver trusted, governed, AI-ready data assets that support business decisions, analytics, products, and reporting.

  • Migration and integration programs are delivered with strong data quality, governance, reconciliation, business signoff, and minimal business disruption.

  • Enterprise reporting provides reliable operational, financial, management, regulatory, and executive visibility.

  • Data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, and stewardship capabilities demonstrate measurable improvements.

  • Reporting and analytics products achieve strong adoption, trust, reuse, and business value realization.

  • Data initiatives are delivered through scalable, repeatable, and governed processes that support future transformations and M&A integrations.

  • Business stakeholders have confidence in enterprise data, reporting, governance, and analytics capabilities as strategic business assets.

title: Senior Creative Producer
description:
Senior Creative Producer

Our Company

Empowering everyone to create.

Adobe empowers everyone, everywhere to imagine, create, and bring any digital experience to life. From creators and students to small businesses, global enterprises, and nonprofit organizations, customers choose Adobe products to create, collaborate, grow their businesses, and build remarkable experiences.

We're looking for curious, ambitious makers who want to help define world-class creativity in this new era. We believe the craft is more essential than ever while AI should help people create more, explore more, and unlock new possibilities while keeping creators at the center of the creative process.

Adobe is amplifying human ingenuity with AI.

Our Team

Adobe Creative is Adobe’s in-house brand-creative engine, developing the ideas, campaigns, and assets that power Adobe’s brand and business. We are part of the broader Content & Creative (“C&C”) organization. We work alongside Adobe Content, which focuses on publishing and audience development through owned, earned, and partner channels; an Experiences team, which oversees Adobe’s real-world moments; and shared service teams spanning Video, Talent, Partnerships, and Production.

Together, C&C commissions and produces work while equipping teams across Adobe’s Global Marketing Organization and the company to create, adapt, and distribute high-quality work with greater speed and consistency.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Creative Producer who will manage large scale campaigns across a pod, overseeing multiple workstreams and coordinate with a wide team of internal collaborators.

The ideal candidate has experience managing complex creative campaigns and high volume work. They are energized by improving the production workflow itself, not just the individual outputs.

You will partner closely with the Director of Production and Executive Producer on capacity planning, vendor governance, and workflow architecture across Adobe's portfolio, translating Adobe Creative production standards into practice for your team.

What You’ll Do

  • Work inside a fast-paced team, leading all aspects of the creation of assets that will launch at a global scale.

  • Own creative campaign lifecycle from end to end: project intake, creating timelines, creative reviews and approvals, and cross-functional coordination across every stage of creative development.

  • Support the creative team by prioritizing tasks, tracking feedback, and mitigating roadblocks to keep the team moving.

  • Act as the bridge between internal teams and agencies, communicating details clearly throughout the production process so everyone stays aligned from briefing to delivery.

  • Maintain a view of all active and incoming projects in your group. Collaborate with your EP and Director of Production to identify risks, dependencies, and resourcing gaps proactively.

  • Bring an AI-first lens to production processes to streamline process and enable faster iteration.

What You Need to Succeed

  • You have strong project management skills with deep, hands-on production experience of creative assets.

  • 7+ years of experience as a producer or program manager driving creative deliverables, ideally in a fast-paced brand, agency, studio, or product-led creative environment.

  • Hands-on experience delivering a high volume of assets across a range of content formats and channels: video, 3D, digital, and print.

  • Skilled at managing multiple projects, schedules, budgets, and competing priorities across high-profile workstreams.

  • Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail. Ability to identify critical paths and dependencies to drive projects forward and ensure quality execution.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Comfortable interfacing with executive collaborators and working with teams across various functions.


About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.


Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

title: Recovery Specialist - Victoria Main
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The candidate is responsible for pursuing collection of charged-off loans while projecting a professional company image through phone interaction and occasionally through in-person meetings. Performance of the candidate will include skip tracing; negotiating workout or settlement terms; filing lawsuits; performing asset searches; analyzing financial statements and making collection strategy recommendations to management. The candidate will also be responsible for the assignment of various loan collateral for repossession or foreclosure as well as its liquidation. The position will report to the Special Assets Recovery Manager.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND BASIC DUTIES

  • Locate and contact charge-off debtors to make arrangements for repayment of debt owed to the Bank.
  • Negotiate loan workout or settlement terms with debtors.
  • Monitor payment arrangements to ensure adherence to agreed upon terms.
  • Pursue suit-worthy debtors through litigation which includes filing suit in Small Claims Court and working with outside legal counsel.
  • Conduct asset searches and locate non-exempt property which could be subject to execution.
  • Monitor Judgments for renewal.
  • Prepare debt cancellation and 1099-C requests for accounts that are settled, deemed uncollectible or time barred.
  • Monitor bankruptcy proceeds in connection with assigned accounts.
  • Assign repossessions and monitor agency process on individual assignments.
  • Document all collection efforts on Akuvo collection system.
  • Maintain discretion and confidentiality in all phases of handling sensitive data or account information.
  • All other duties as needed or required.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work only. They are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties, and skills. Other duties may be added, or this job description amended at any time.

This position does not have a supervisor role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Certification:

High School diploma or equivalent Associate degree or Bachelor’s degree.

Required Knowledge:

Experience Required:

None, but prior experience is preferred.

Skills/Abilities:

Ability to fluently communicate in English

Moderate computer application skills; including Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Demonstrated ability to make appropriate judgments and decisions with limited guidance.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Ability to quickly assess problem loan and deposit account situations and implement solutions to resolve same.

Maintain professionalism when communicating with borrowers and others.

Demonstrated ability to resolve conflicts and implement effective negotiation skills.

Good organizational skills, or ability to prioritize and complete various tasks within deadlines.

Ability to multi-task.

CUSTOMER CONTACT:

Ability to make accurate inquiries with borrowers as to issues with problem loans and deposit accounts, in a firm and professional manner.

Ability to overcome objections

PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS OF THIS POSITION

TALKING:

Especially where one must frequently convey detailed or important instructions or ideas accurately, loudly, or quickly.

AVERAGE HEARING:

Able to hear average or normal conversations and receive ordinary information.

REPETITIVE MOTION:

Movements frequently and regularly required using the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

AVERAGE VISUAL ABILITIES:

Average, ordinary, visual acuity necessary to prepare or inspect documents or products, or operate machinery.

PHYSICAL STRENGTH:

Sedentary work; sitting most of the time. Exerts up to 10 lbs. of force occasionally. (Almost all office jobs.)

WORKING CONDITIONS NONE:

No hazardous or significantly unpleasant conditions (such as in a typical office).

MENTAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS OF THIS POSITION

REASONING ABILITY:

Ability to apply logical or scientific thinking to define problems, collect data establish facts and draw conclusions.

Able to interpret a variety of technical instructions and can deal with multiple variables.

MATHEMATICS ABILITY:

Ability to compute discount, interest, profit, and loss; commission markup and selling price; and ratio, proportion, and percentage.

Able to perform very simple algebra.

LANGUAGE ABILITY:

Ability to use passive vocabulary of 5,000-6,000 words; read at a slow rate.

And define unfamiliar words in dictionaries for meaning, spelling, and pronunciation.

Ability to write complex sentences, using proper punctuation, and using adjectives and adverbs.

title: Director Reproductive Toxicologist
description:
Position: Senior Reproductive Toxicologist
Location: Cambridge, UK
Competitive Salary & Excellent Company Benefits


Application Closing Date: 9th October 2026


At AstraZeneca, we are driven by science and united by our commitment to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. With one of the industry's most diverse and successful portfolios spanning multiple therapeutic areas and modalities, we offer a unique opportunity to contribute to drug development from early discovery through to post-marketing support.


We are seeking an experienced Senior Reproductive Toxicologist to join our developmental and reproductive toxicology team within Regulatory Toxicology and Safety Pharmacology, part of Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Sciences (CPSS). This is a role for an individual who combines deep reproductive toxicology expertise with the ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and contribute strategically to drug development programmes.


Working across a broad portfolio, you will help shape development plans, support regulatory submissions and health authority interactions, guide product labelling strategies, and ensure reproductive safety considerations are appropriately integrated throughout the development lifecycle.


The role will be based at one of AstraZeneca's major US R&D site in Cambridge (UK), however other AstraZeneca strategic R&D locations may be considered for exceptional candidates.


What you'll do

As a Senior Reproductive Toxicologist, you will provide expert scientific leadership and strategic guidance across AstraZeneca's portfolio, supporting programmes ranging from discovery through late-stage development, registration, and post-marketing activities.


Key responsibilities include:

· Providing expert interpretation of developmental, reproductive and juvenile toxicology data and translating findings into development and regulatory strategy.

· Partnering with multidisciplinary project teams to support clinical development plans, regulatory submissions, health authority interactions and product labelling.

· Advising on reproductive safety assessments, inclusion of women of childbearing potential and paediatric populations in clinical development programmes.

· Designing and overseeing reproductive toxicology programmes that support global development and registration strategies across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities.

· Contributing to governance discussions and presenting reproductive toxicology positions to project teams.

· Supporting interactions with global regulatory agencies and contributing to responses to regulatory questions.

· Representing AstraZeneca in external scientific forums, industry collaborations and consortia related to reproductive toxicology and paediatric development.

· Contributing to the continued evolution of AstraZeneca's reproductive toxicology strategy, including innovative approaches that advance science and reduce animal usage.


Essential requirements

We are looking for an experienced reproductive toxicologist with strong scientific judgement, strategic thinking and the ability to influence across multidisciplinary teams.



You will bring:

· Considerable industry experience applying developmental and reproductive toxicology expertise, including experience supporting one or more of: marketing applications, health authority interactions, regulatory submissions or product labelling.

· Demonstrated experience supporting late-stage clinical development, marketing applications, product labelling and post-marketing activities.

· Strong knowledge and practical application of relevant global regulatory guidelines, including ICH M3, S5, S6, S9 and S11.

· Experience supporting health authority interactions and regulatory submissions across global regions (EMA, PMDA, CDE and FDA).

· Demonstrated expertise in the interpretation and strategic application of developmental, reproductive and juvenile toxicology data.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary global teams.

· The ability to balance scientific rigour with pragmatic decision-making in a fast-paced development environment.


Desirable experience

The following would be advantageous:

· Experience supporting paediatric development programmes.

· Exposure to a broad range of therapeutic modalities.

· Experience supporting innovative approaches to reproductive safety assessment.

· Experience participating in external scientific working groups, consortia or industry initiatives.


Why join us?

This role offers a rare opportunity to apply reproductive toxicology expertise across the entire drug development lifecycle. You will work on a diverse portfolio of innovative medicines, engage with a broad network of scientific and clinical experts, and contribute directly to development strategies that impact patients around the world.


You'll join a supportive and collaborative team of reproductive toxicology specialists where scientific excellence, partnership and continuous learning are highly valued. Whether supporting regulatory strategy, influencing clinical development, or contributing to industry-wide scientific initiatives, you will play a key role in advancing AstraZeneca's commitment to delivering medicines that make a meaningful difference to patients.


Interested? Apply now by submitting your CV together with a cover letter

title: Copy of Software Engineering Developer, DevOps
description:
Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission‑critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team and enhance our development and operational efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a cloud‑agnostic environment and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable infrastructure across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

The ideal candidate will work closely with a large number of stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery pipelines, strong infrastructure‑as‑code practices, and a robust DevOps culture. This will include integrating numerous open source and commercial applications such as Docker, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab Artifactory, VMware, and Kubernetes. You will experience a diverse variety of tasks through all stages of the software development life cycle.

This role will be a combination of working remotely and onsite at our Calgary or Ottawa office. We have a number of measures in place for onsite working – our top priority remains the health and safety of our colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes.
  • Design and implement cloud‑agnostic infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Ansible.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and applications.
  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Optimize system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system availability, scalability and reliability across cloud platforms.
  • Evaluate, prototype, and roll out new tools and technologies to support the DevOps automation transformation effort.
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices and implement system hardening and compliance measures.
  • Configure, manage and maintain functional and virtualized networks, devices and infrastructure.
  • Integrate tools together and automating their provisioning, configuration, and management across cloud and on‑prem infrastructure.
  • Writing software and scripts necessary to deploy solutions and automate tasks.
  • Developing automated tests for new and updated functionality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering; Computer Science; or a related technical/engineering degree
  • 4+ years of previous DevOps experience
  • Tools & Technologies
    • CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI (preferred)
    • Scripting languages: Python, Bash
    • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
    • Configuration: Ansible, Terraform, Packer
    • Observability (Prometheus, Grafana)
    • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and branching strategies
    • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix based systems
    • Experience working through the software development life cycle
    • Knowledge of networking concepts (DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, etc)
    • Experience with virtualized environments
    • Experience working across at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Thrive working in a team environment, developing consensus rather than working alone.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, develop and recommend options, and implement solutions
  • Understanding of DevSecOps practices.
  • Exposure working in an Agile environment, or an understanding of Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated practice thriving in a hybrid work environment
  • Familiarity with test automation tools and integrating those into your development process
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models.

How We Work

  • Work Schedule: 37.5 hours per week - flexible within core business hours.
  • Work Arrangement: A mix of onsite and remote work, as determined by business and role requirements.

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

Additional Information

What We Offer

  • Relevant experience
  • Technical and non-technical skills
  • Education and certifications

The expected hiring range for this position is $85,000-$110,000 CAD annual.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents, from day one of employment at no cost to you.
    • Flexible benefit options available (including HCSA).
    • Emergency medical travel insurance.
    • 24/7 virtual health care services.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP) – counselling, life coaching, lifestyle change support, and financial planning.
  • Onsite fitness facilities & employee resource groups.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP) with employer contributions after 3 months of service.
    • Access to financial advisors for investment advice and comprehensive financial planning.
    • Voluntary Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) accessible from day one.
  • Flexible time away to rest and renew with vacation, holidays, vacation purchase plan and parental leaves (with top up options).
    • Sick leave and disability programs.
  • Grow your career your way with free access to a learning platform offering a wide range of courses and resources.

    • Reimbursement for professional and industry-related memberships and dues.
  • Employee discounts on travel, home and auto insurance, as well as services and activities.
    • Free onsite parking.

    • Employee social clubs and recreational activities.

Why join us?

  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading‑edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next‑generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.

Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world‑class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensure every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways: Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check‑ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. You’ll work on high‑profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and provide opportunities to learn from experienced mentors and grow as an early‑career professional. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network.

Accommodation

title: Data Engineer / Network Traffic Analysis
description:
Data Engineer / Network Traffic Analysis

£500 - £550 per day Inside IR35 6-Month Contract Hybrid - 2 Days per Week in Islington, London

83zero is recruiting for a Data Engineer / Network Traffic Analysis specialist to join a highly technical team working with large volumes of network and traffic data.

This is not a traditional Data Engineering position. We are looking for someone who combines strong networking knowledge with hands‑on packet and traffic analysis, particularly using Wireshark, PCAP and tcpdump.

You will be working at packet and protocol level, capturing, investigating and analysing network traffic before turning that information into usable data for further processing and analysis.

What you'll be doing

  • Capturing and analysing network traffic using Wireshark, PCAP and tcpdump

  • Investigating network behaviour at packet and protocol level

  • Analysing TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, protocols and traffic flows

  • Filtering packet captures to identify patterns, anomalies and potential issues

  • Troubleshooting network connectivity, latency, routing and protocol issues

  • Extracting, transforming and analysing technical/network data

  • Using Python and SQL to work with network, telemetry or data sets

  • Working alongside data, networking and security teams

  • Supporting cloud‑based data and network environments

What we're looking for

You should have strong hands‑on experience across:

  • Wireshark

  • PCAP / packet capture

  • Network traffic analysis

  • Network sniffing

  • tcpdump

  • TCP/IP

  • DNS

  • HTTP / HTTPS

  • Network protocols and troubleshooting

  • Python and/or SQL

Experience with GCP / Google Cloud, BigQuery, Pub/Sub or Dataflow would be beneficial, but it is not essential. The priority is genuine hands‑on network traffic and packet analysis experience.

Contract Details

Rate: £500 - £550 per day
IR35: Inside IR35
Duration: 6 months
Location: Islington, London
Working Pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week onsite

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
The highest calling for AI is improving human health. At Perceptic, we're building the AI operating system that powers drug discovery - a unified intelligence layer that connects evidence, reasoning, and action across the entire drug lifecycle.

We were built by operators from Palantir who spent years deploying production AI in the world's most demanding enterprise environments. We know what it takes to make ambitious technology hold up under real pressure. Now we're applying that to pharma and we're hiring engineers who've operated at the same standard.

A single drug can take more than a decade and billions of dollars to reach a patient, and the systems we build are meant to compress that timeline. They run inside some of the most security-conscious, compliance-bound enterprises in the world, where the infrastructure underneath has to be as trustworthy as the science on top of it.

Who we need

We need a Lead DevOps Engineer to own that infrastructure end to end. You'll be the single, clear owner of how Perceptic deploys, operates, secures, and scales, across our own platform and across the isolated customer environments where the bar for trust is absolute. It's a large amount of responsibility, which is exactly what we're offering.

What you'll own

  • Our GitOps deployment backbone on Argo CD, so a small team can ship continuously and safely across many clusters
  • Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) across our fleet of production environments
  • Infrastructure-as-code in Terraform/OpenTofu and Terragrunt, the source of truth for everything we run
  • Multi-tenant, per-customer isolation: standing up a fully isolated, compliant environment for each pharma customer, with its own cluster and data plane, and deploying to it with confidence. This is the hardest and most important part of the job.
  • Security and compliance posture: secrets management, access controls, infrastructure hardening, and the SOC2-and-beyond controls that customers will audit you on
  • Observability: telemetry, metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting that keep a complex distributed system legible
  • Reliability, incident response, and the operational runbooks that protect customer trust
  • CI/CD and release automation that keep our shipping cadence high
  • Developer experience: making it fast and painless for engineers to deploy and debug

What we're looking for

  • At least 4 years in DevOps, platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure
  • You've owned production systems rather than only contributing to them, including multi-tenant or customer-specific environments, and you understand the complexity that comes with them
  • Deep fluency with Kubernetes, a major cloud (AWS preferred), GitOps, and infrastructure-as-code, plus the judgment to know when not to add another layer
  • You come from somewhere that held a high bar, and you expect engineering excellence from yourself and the systems around you
  • You're hands-on and have no interest in a purely architectural role. You explain complex tradeoffs simply and you don't over-engineer.
  • You treat speed, security, cost, and reliability as constraints that all apply at once, and you've struck that balance before
  • Bonus: you've operated under formal security or compliance regimes (SOC2, HIPAA, GxP, or similar) and know how to make controls a strength rather than a tax

This is a high-intensity, high-stakes role. We move quickly and give direct feedback, the responsibility you carry will likely outrun your title, and you'll go wherever the company needs you most, which sometimes means unglamorous work that matters more than anything else that week. The people who do well here find that kind of ownership and growth exciting, and they weren't looking for a nine-to-five.

location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:

General Summary:

Job Overview/Summary: Senior automotive software engineer with 5+ years of experience focused on Android Automotive, software development, system integration testing, debugging, validation, and integration of next-generation automotive experience platforms.

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation toward a smarter, more connected future. The Automotive Experience Platform team within Qualcomm’s automotive business unit builds solutions that showcase future technologies in the automotive industry. The team highlights upcoming automotive technologies from Qualcomm and its partners at global trade shows and in private demonstrations for key industry stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Automotive Experience Platform team, you will design, develop, debug, validate, and integrate Android and automotive software features that demonstrate future vehicle experiences. You will work hands-on across development and system integration testing activities, including triaging complex issues, analyzing logs, debugging software across Android, Linux, QNX, middleware, and embedded interfaces, and driving issues to closure. You will collaborate with platform teams, UX teams, system integration teams, and partner organizations to support rapid prototyping, demo readiness, and reliable execution for customer and trade show showcases. This role is well suited for an engineer who can both build software and perform deep SIT-level debugging in a fast-paced automotive environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in Android, Android Automotive, embedded systems, or automotive software platforms.

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Java or Kotlin, with solid working knowledge of C/C++ and scripting languages such as Python.

  • Strong understanding of Android framework, Android services, application lifecycle, IPC mechanisms, permissions, build systems, debugging tools, and system-level behavior.

  • Experience with Android Automotive OS, automotive middleware, vehicle interfaces, CAN, SOME/IP, MQTT or other in-vehicle communication technologies is highly preferred.

  • Experience performing system integration testing, issue triage, log analysis, root-cause analysis, and debugging across software, middleware, operating system, and hardware interfaces.

  • Familiarity with Linux and QNX operating systems, embedded software environments, and cross-platform integration workflows.

  • Strong software design, development, unit testing, debugging, validation, and integration skills.

  • Experience with source control, issue tracking, CI/CD workflows, release processes, and collaborative software development practices.

  • Ability to work independently, drive technical issues to closure, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering, UX, platform, and partner teams.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation of technical findings, integration steps, defects, and validation results.

  • Experience with Qt, IoT, cloud-connected vehicle experiences, or AI-assisted software development tools is a plus.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, modify, validate, and debug Android, Android Automotive, embedded, edge, and utility software applications for automotive experience platforms.

  • Develop and integrate software features that support concept vehicle demonstrations, prototype features, customer showcases, and global trade show experiences.

  • Perform system integration testing and SIT-level debugging by analyzing logs, traces, crashes, timing issues, interface failures, and end-to-end system behavior across multiple software and hardware layers.

  • Drive root-cause analysis and issue closure for complex integration problems involving Android framework, applications, middleware, vehicle interfaces, operating systems, and embedded components.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, define technical approaches, estimate work, manage dependencies, and deliver high-quality software within project schedules.

  • Support software bring-up, integration, validation, and demo readiness activities on target hardware, concept vehicles, and automotive development platforms.

  • Contribute to software architecture and design discussions, while ensuring practical implementation choices that support rapid prototyping and reliable demonstrations.

  • Mentor junior engineers, share debugging practices, review code, and promote engineering quality across development and integration activities.

  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation for software design, integration procedures, debugging findings, known issues, and validation results.

Success in This Role:

A successful candidate will be a hands-on senior engineer who can move confidently between software development and system integration testing. The candidate should have strong Android and automotive software experience, the ability to debug complex cross-layer issues, and the ownership mindset to drive problems from initial triage through root cause, fix validation, and closure. This person should communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and help deliver reliable, high-visibility prototype and demonstration software in a fast-paced automotive environment.

title: Scientist
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



The Lead Discovery and Optimization Group within Therapeutic Discovery Sciences in San Diego focuses on delivering novel therapeutics for disease intervention by engaging E3 ubiquitin ligases for targeted protein degradation. We seek a highly driven Scientist to help identify and characterize drug candidates for the treatment of human diseases. The successful candidate will work collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary environment to carry out cell-based and molecular assays in support of small molecule discovery for pre-clinical development.


Responsibilities will include but are not limited to the following:

  • Design, develop, and implement high-throughput cell-based assays to characterize and evaluate drug candidates
  • Conduct small molecule mechanism of action studies to elucidate biological activity and target engagement
  • Generate and characterize stable cell lines using lentiviral transduction and PiggyBac-mediated gene transfer technologies
  • Demonstrate a high level of scientific independence, initiative, and problem-solving ability while contributing to a collaborative research environment
  • Perform routine culture, expansion, passage, and maintenance of mammalian cell lines, ensuring cell health, quality, and experimental reproducibility to support drug discovery
  • Conduct routine molecular and cellular experiments including DNA/RNA/protein extraction, immunoblot analysis, and immunoprecipitation
  • Assist senior researchers in executing, conducting analyses, and reporting results of experiments
  • Familiarity with literature and internal best practices to identify opportunities to improve productivity and quality of work
  • Exhibit a strong commitment to professional growth, continuous learning, and career advancement
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and recommend corrective actions for routine problems
  • Maintain an accurate, comprehensive, and current laboratory notebook
  • Write protocols, procedures, and technical reports
  • Communicate results via written reports and oral presentations

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS with minimum 5 years of experience post-graduation or MS with 3 years of experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in mammalian cell culture, multi-well plate-based cellular assays, immunoblotting, stable cell line generation, cellular transfection, and basic molecular biology methodologies
  • Experience with medium and high-throughput screening is highly preferred
  • Experience with targeted protein degradation assay is a plus
  • Familiarity with automation instruments and multi-mode plate readers
  • Outstanding problem-solving and organization skills.
  • Effective team player and strong individual contributor
  • Self-driven, flexible, pragmatic, and able to handle multiple tasks while delivering high-quality data
  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written
