title: Director, Toxicology
description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.

Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.

Why Campbell’s…

  • Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
  • Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
  • Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
  • If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
  • Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
  • Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

How you will make history here...
As a leader within Campbell’s Corporate Food Safety & Quality organization, the Director, Chemical Safety, Toxicology and Analytical Chemistry is responsible for providing enterprise leadership, strategy, technical governance, and subject matter expertise for chemical safety, food toxicology, ingredient safety, and analytical chemistry across Campbell’s commercialization, manufacturing network, laboratories and supply base.


This role serves as Campbell’s senior technical authority for chemical hazard identification, toxicological risk evaluation, ingredient and packaging safety, and science-based decision-making. The position partners closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Operations, Legal, Packaging, Quality, and external technical experts to protect consumers and the Brand, maintain regulatory compliance, and proactively mitigate risk.


What you will do...
• Develop and execute the enterprise strategy for chemical safety and food toxicology, including standards, policies, risk-based decision criteria, and technical governance for chemical contaminants, ingredients, processing-related hazards, packaging and food contact materials, and analytical testing.
• Serve as the company’s subject matter expert for toxicological risk assessment, chemical hazard evaluation, exposure assessment, and interpretation of scientific literature, regulatory guidance, supplier data, analytical results, and external expert opinions.
• Provide chemical safety review and approval for ingredients and food contact materials through Campbell’s commercialization and ingredient approval processes
• Partner with internal analytical laboratories and external laboratory networks to guide testing strategies, method selection, data interpretation, proficiency expectations, laboratory priorities, and escalation of results requiring toxicological or regulatory review.
• Lead technical response for chemical safety incidents, supplier non-conformance, consumer and customer inquiries, regulatory requests, and other escalations.
• Monitor and evaluate evolving scientific, regulatory, consumer, customer, NGO, and legislative trends related to chemical safety, toxicology, contaminants, additives, packaging, GRAS, food contact materials, and global food safety expectations.
• Develop proactive risk mitigation plans, business position recommendations, communication materials, and escalation summaries for senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders on current and emerging chemical safety matters.
• Represent Campbell’s in selected external scientific organizations, trade associations, technical panels, and regulatory forums to influence outcomes, strengthen external networks, benchmark best practices, and advance Campbell’s scientific and regulatory strategies.
• Build internal capability through training, coaching, and cross-functional education on chemical hazard awareness, toxicology fundamentals, risk assessment principles, analytical interpretation, and emerging risk management.
• Establish impactful metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor chemical safety risks, program effectiveness, incident trends, laboratory performance, and progress against enterprise food safety priorities.
• Standardization of lab testing equipment and methods across the manufacturing network as applicable


• Operates as an enterprise-level technical authority to safeguard consumer safety, regulatory compliance, innovation timelines and business continuity.
• Evaluates complex scientific information from analytical chemistry results, toxicology literature, supplier documentation, global regulatory standards, exposure models, food contact evaluations, customer requirements, and cross-functional business inputs.
• Balances sound scientific judgment, regulatory expectations, operational feasibility, consumer trust, and business continuity when making risk-based decisions.
• Provides rapid technical support for critical incidents, recalls, regulatory inquiries, consumer-related escalations, customer concerns, and supplier disruptions, including support outside normal business hours when needed.
• Influences senior leaders and cross-functional teams without always having direct authority, requiring strong communication, collaboration, technical credibility, and practical decision-making.


Who you will work with...

  • Reporting into VP Food Safety Quality

What you will bring to the table... (Must Have)
• Bachelor's Degree
• 15+ years of progressive experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, ingredient, packaging, or related technical environments.
• Demonstrated leadership in chemical safety, food toxicology, ingredient risk assessment, analytical chemistry, food contact materials, contaminant evaluation, regulatory toxicology, or related food safety disciplines.
• Experience leading technical governance, enterprise standards, cross-functional risk decisions, external laboratory strategies, incident response, and regulatory or customer-facing technical matters.
• Experience interfacing directly with FDA, USDA, EPA, state agencies, international regulatory bodies, or customer regulatory and food safety teams.
• Experience participating in or leading industry association panels, scientific working groups, or external advisory forums such as GMA/CBA, IAFNS, AOAC, FARRP, Codex-related forums, or other specialized technical organizations.
• Experience with food manufacturing environments, supplier quality systems, co-manufacturers, ingredient commercialization, food packaging, external laboratories, and analytical chemistry program oversight.
• Knowledge of laboratory procedures and analytical equipment including


GC/MS, LC/QTOF, and ICPMS.
• Experience in managing and developing technical teams.


It would be great if you have... (Nice to Have)

• Ph.D. in Toxicology, Food Toxicology, Food Science, Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline strongly preferred;

• Board certification by the American Board of Toxicology or equivalent specialized toxicology credential preferred.

• Certifications or training in HACCP, PCQI, Lead Auditor, ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, risk assessment, regulatory science, or related technical disciplines preferred
• Deep expertise in food-relevant chemical hazards, including pesticides, heavy metals, acrylamide, mycotoxins, allergens at chemical safety interfaces, process contaminants, packaging migrants, food additives, colors, flavors, preservatives, and emerging contaminants.
• Strong working knowledge of U.S. and global food regulatory frameworks and standards relevant to finished products, ingredients, additives, contaminants, GRAS, food contact materials, packaging, Codex, FDA, USDA, EPA, state-level requirements, and customer expectations.
• Strong understanding of analytical chemistry methods, laboratory operations, data quality, method validation, uncertainty, exposure calculations, toxicological thresholds, and interpretation of testing results for decision-making.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific and regulatory information into clear, concise, practical recommendations for senior leaders, Legal, Regulatory, R&D, Quality, Procurement, Operations, and external stakeholders.
• Proven ability to anticipate business risks and opportunities, develop proactive mitigation plans, manage issue response, and support crisis management with sound scientific judgment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop technical positions, executive summaries, external responses, training materials, and governance documents.
• Strong collaboration, influencing, and relationship-building skills across corporate functions, plants, suppliers, co-manufacturers, regulators, trade associations, scientific organizations, and external experts.
• Strong program management, change management, prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a practical, risk-based mindset.
• Quality and usefulness of chemical safety metrics, dashboards, horizon scanning, and senior leadership reporting.

Compensation and Benefits:

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$170,200-$234,100

At AAPHC, we strive to provide comprehensive, coordinated, and continuous care to all who access our services. Did you know that all qualifying medical offices operated by AAPHC are recognized as a Level III Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) by the National Center for Quality Assurance (NCQA)? NCQA offers three levels of PCMH recognition with Level III being the highest level. As a Level III PCMH, AAPHC is committed to continuously raising the quality of care within our practices, while also lowering our patients health care costs.

Our health care teams are comprised of physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and nurse midwives. Assisting these providers are clinical staff members, laboratory personnel, and business office professionals.

Our goal is to always provide access, and even expand access, to your provider so you always can reach AAPHC when you need us most! When you visit an AAPHC office, you can trust that you'll be well cared for by our team. Always.


About the Role:

The Controller in the Health Care and Social Assistance industry plays a critical role in overseeing the financial integrity and operational efficiency of the organization. This position is responsible for managing all accounting functions, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and providing accurate financial reporting to support strategic decision-making. The Controller will lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis efforts to optimize resource allocation and enhance financial performance. Collaboration with clinical and administrative teams is essential to align financial goals with patient care objectives. Ultimately, the Controller ensures that the organization maintains fiscal responsibility while supporting its mission to deliver high-quality healthcare services.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Management Accountant (CMA) designation preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or financial management experience, preferably in healthcare or social assistance sectors.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, healthcare financial regulations, and compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency with accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.
  • Proficiency with NetSuite Business Software

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience in financial modeling, strategic planning, and process improvement.
  • Strong leadership experience managing finance teams in a healthcare environment.
  • Familiarity with government healthcare programs such as Medicare and Medicaid.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepares clinic financial statements monthly and distributes financials, Days in AR reports and FS Combined reports
  • Prepares financial statements on a monthly basis to include general ledger accounting preparation, posting, and balancing.
  • Prepare and post month-end entries which include Payroll Accrual, Prepaid and various other income items. Maintain lead schedules and balance them to financials.
  • Supervise accounting support staff to include purchasing and accounts payable staff. Responsible for training to keep those positions at the highest level of skill necessary to meet company needs and objectives, yearly review, and back up when necessary
  • Oversee the accounts payable process and ensure payables are processed in a timely manner
  • Audits payroll submission for accuracy and observe payroll transmission. After completion of payroll; review reports and compare debits from accounts.
  • Track line item budget expenditures on various grants. Hold periodic meetings with Grants Manager to review.
  • Acts as the lead on annual audit and cost report.
  • Assist CFO with Form 990 and yearly UDS preparation.
  • Maintains daily cash reports for banks and transfers funds as needed among operating accounts.
  • Reviews contracts to determine elements pertaining to the accounting department
  • Tracks encounters by provider/location for annual cost report purposes.
  • Review collection agency statements monthly and prepare/post entry. Contacts agency if discrepancies are found.
  • Participates in special projects such as analyzing general ledger balances, reviewing profit/loss of clinics to determine if re-allocations are necessary.
  • Reconciles retirement withholdings to payroll reports and bank withdrawal. Reviews discrepancies with payroll department.
  • Analyze and prepare revenue/cash updates throughout the month to Executive Team.
  • Responsible for presenting and interpreting monthly financial statements in the absence of the CFO.
  • Stay current with changes in healthcare financial regulations and accounting standards to ensure compliance.
  • Lead and mentor the finance team to promote professional development and high performance.
  • Other financial duties, as requested, by the Chief Financial Officer.
  • Manage and oversee all accounting operations including billing, accounts payable/receivable, general ledger, and payroll.
  • Prepare timely and accurate financial statements, reports, and forecasts in compliance with healthcare regulations and GAAP.
  • Develop and monitor budgets, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions to meet financial targets.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and organizational policies.
  • Collaborate with department heads to provide financial insights that support operational and strategic initiatives.
  • Implement and maintain internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure accuracy of financial data.
  • Attends Manager Meetings and Finance/Board meetings with Chief Financial Officer to gain better understanding of day-to-day activities.


Skills:

The Controller will utilize strong analytical and accounting skills daily to prepare and interpret complex financial data, ensuring accuracy and compliance with healthcare regulations. Effective communication skills are essential for collaborating with clinical and administrative teams to translate financial information into actionable insights. Leadership and team management skills are applied to guide and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Proficiency in accounting software and financial systems enables efficient management of financial operations and reporting. Additionally, problem-solving skills are critical for identifying financial risks and implementing solutions that support the organization's mission and financial health.

title: Product Designer
description:
At , we believe running a short-term rental company should feel effortless.

Our mission is ambitious: enable anyone to launch, operate and scale a short-term rental business on AI autopilot.

Born from the technology powering The Flex, Base360 brings property management, guest communications, bookings, cleaning, maintenance and finance into one platform.

We’re looking for a highly ambitious UX/UI Product Designer who wants to turn complex operations into simple, beautiful experiences. You’ll work directly with the founders and engineers to design products that solve real problems for property managers, operational teams and guests.

If you’re excited by thoughtful UX, exceptional interfaces, AI agents and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You’ll Design

As a UX/UI Product Designer, you’ll help shape every touchpoint of Base360—from the first website visit to the workflows operators rely on every day.

  • Core product experiences: Design dashboards and workflows for reservations, properties, guest communications, cleaning, maintenance and finance.

  • AI interactions: Make it easy to configure AI agents, understand their actions, review decisions and step in when needed.

  • Onboarding and setup: Help operators connect their channels, add properties and get value from the platform quickly.

  • Booking and guest journeys: Create smooth experiences for direct bookings, check-in, extensions and upsells.

  • Our design system: Build reusable components and consistent interaction patterns that keep the platform coherent as it grows.

  • Website and marketing assets: Design landing pages, feature visuals and launch assets that make the product’s value clear.

What You’ll Do

  • Own design from problem definition and user research through to prototypes, final interfaces and implementation reviews.

  • Speak with operators and internal teams to understand how they work and where they struggle.

  • Turn complex requirements into clear user journeys, wireframes and polished interfaces.

  • Work closely with engineers to deliver designs that account for real data, edge cases and technical constraints.

  • Test ideas early, incorporate feedback and improve experiences after launch.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate exploration and production while maintaining a high standard of design.

  • Take initiative: identify problems, propose solutions and drive them through to completion.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Experience designing SaaS products, dashboards or applications with complex workflows.

  • Strong Figma skills, including auto layout, components, design systems and interactive prototyping.

  • Excellent judgement in typography, spacing, hierarchy, colour and responsive design.

  • The ability to simplify complex information without hiding what users need.

  • Experience working directly with engineers and seeing designs through to production.

  • Clear communication and the ability to explain your decisions and respond constructively to feedback.

  • High ownership, attention to detail and the ability to move forward when requirements are still evolving.

Experience with short-term rentals, hospitality, AI products, conversion optimisation or front-end development is a plus.

Why Join Us

  • Make a visible impact. Design experiences that directly influence how short-term rental businesses operate.

  • Build with real users. Get access to the operational teams behind The Flex and learn from their daily challenges.

  • Work directly with the founders. Help shape product decisions and design direction from an early stage.

  • Own what you build. Take meaningful responsibility across discovery, design and delivery.

  • Push beyond conventional software. Help define how people work alongside AI agents.

  • Grow with the company. Take on broader responsibility as the product and design function expand.

You Should NOT Apply If

  • You're looking for a predictable corporate role with a fixed playbook.

  • You engage in office politics or gossip instead of communicating directly.

  • You're looking for a slow-paced role with limited ownership.

  • You don't aim to become one of the best at what you do.

title: Senior Test Engineer | Test Operations Maintenance
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

This individual will join the Alabama Test Operations (ATO) Maintenance team at Marshall Space Flight Center (MSFC) in Huntsville, AL. The ATO Maintenance team is responsible for the thousands of components and dozens of sub-systems that make up the historic MSFC 4670 Engine Test Stand facility structural, fluid, and electrical systems, as well as the component test capability supporting engine factory checkout areas, including environmental, proof, and flow testing. Our premier capability is full-scale liquid propellant rocket engine testing at Test Stand 4670. In this role, you will sustain that hardware and support the initial build and activation of facility upgrades in support of development, qualification, and acceptance testing of Blue Origin engines and their components.


As part of a small, passionate, and accomplished team, you will be responsible for maintenance plans, process architecture, maintenance requirement definition, troubleshooting hardware failures, risk identification and mitigation, automated data review scripts to support predictive maintenance, and a wide range of continuous process improvements.

This position will directly impact the history of space exploration in the heart of Rocket City and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention toward safe and repeatable operations. We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality for positive impact to spaceflight.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! Passion for our mission and vision is required!

This is a 1st shift position but will require the ability to perform job duties outside of normal shift hours as needed to support test operations and maintenance windows. Up to 10% travel may be required to support other Blue Origin test sites during surge needs, as well as for process and professional development.

Responsibilities

  • Consistently exhibit strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and computer skills; communicate clearly and promptly across all areas of the organization.
  • Author work instructions to safely perform maintenance on test facility hardware, including disassembly, inspection, and assembly of mechanical and electro-mechanical components.
  • Identify and define preventative maintenance for test facility hardware, including the support equipment needed to perform maintenance on facility components.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for permanent problem resolution.
  • Support functional testing of components (valves, filters, regulators, etc.) for acceptance using high-pressure pneumatics, cryogenics, or hydraulics. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and correct malfunctions using work instructions.
  • Coordinate with external vendors to support preventative maintenance and repair efforts.
  • Participate in Test Readiness Reviews and Risk Assessment Reviews to ensure compliance with the Blue Origin Health and Safety Manual.
  • Provide technical support for new designs to ensure maintainability and operability.
  • Perform operations as a certified operator to support return-to-service post-maintenance, as well as first-time activation of system upgrades.
  • Establish training curriculum for engineers and technicians and proctor training for the team as needed.
  • Support robust methods and strategies for sustaining a reasonable inventory of equipment and spares to support facility maintenance.
  • Support Supervisors and Managers in establishing best practices and effective work execution strategies.
  • Engage with multiple geographic locations and business units to support anomaly resolution, hazard and operability (HazOp) assessments, stand boards, design reviews, and operations and maintenance (O&M) considerations for future facility expansions and upgrades.
  • Actively introduce new technologies and capability improvements.
  • Identify inefficiencies, capability gaps, and potential improvements in the O&M process; advocate for and implement better solutions.

Scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level as described in the Minimum Qualifications below.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, with years of relevant experience per the level table below. Looking for Level IV however would also consider strong Level III.
  • Experience in a test, propulsion, industrial, energy, or comparable hardware-rich operating environment.
  • Working knowledge of high-pressure, cryogenic, hydraulic, pneumatic, data acquisition, and electrical power systems, commensurate with level.
  • Technical fundamentals in fluid mechanics and thermodynamics.
  • Ability to perform data analysis and establish dispositions or recommendations based on system performance.
  • Working knowledge of instrumentation, including pressure transducers, thermocouples, silicon diodes, resistance temperature detectors, flow measurement devices, and accelerometers.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering standards, technical requirements, and engineering drawings.
  • Ability to safely work around pressurized systems up to 6,000 PSIG.
  • Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Approachable disposition, open-minded, and able to adapt to rapidly changing requirements.
  • Calm demeanor in high-pressure situations, with the tenacity to resolve conflict and drive permanent problem resolution.
  • A safety first, continuous improvement mindset.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Must be able to obtain and maintain access to Redstone Arsenal.

Experience by Level


Test Engineer III

B.S. + 6 years, or M.S. + 4 years

Owns major systems and their maintenance strategy; leads root cause investigations and projects from concept through activation; mentors junior engineers and technicians.


Sr. Test Engineer

B.S. + 10 years, or M.S. + 8 years

Sets facility-wide maintenance architecture and standards; drives cross-site and cross-BU alignment; serves as technical authority in reviews and boards; leads capital upgrade and activation campaigns.

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience working at or with a rocket propulsion test facility.
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Management, or Business.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects from concept definition through full implementation.
  • Experience with environmental (thermal/vacuum/vibration), proof, and flow testing of flight components.
  • Experience with Windchill or a similar product lifecycle management tool.
  • Familiarity with CAD applications (Creo preferred).
  • Experience with LabVIEW, MATLAB, Python, Winplot, or advanced Excel functions (VBA, Power Query, etc.).
  • Experience with a computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and reliability-centered maintenance methods.
  • Working knowledge of aerospace cleanliness specifications for clean room activities and manufacturing environments.
  • Working knowledge of fabrication techniques for component hardware modification or creation of spare material from raw stock.
  • Experience in a formal or informal leadership position.
  • Experience with design tools and methods for facility fluid and/or electrical systems.
  • Operational understanding of engines and engine sub-components such as turbopumps, combustion devices, valves, and other fluid components.

Physical and Environmental Requirements

Join the Microsoft Turing Team and help shape the future of enterprise productivity through cutting-edge AI. We are responsible for the core systems that power the Microsoft 365 Chat Copilot for enterprise – a groundbreaking AI assistant used by hundreds of millions of users around the world. As an engineer on our team, you’ll work side by side with world-class scientists and developers to bring large language models (LLMs) to life, at enterprise scale.

We’re not just training and applying models — we’re building intelligent systems that run them. This is your chance to engineer the critical infrastructure, platforms, and features that power the Microsoft Copilot — with a direct impact on how the world works. Recent launches like Analyst Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot | Microsoft Community Hub showcase the breadth and depth of the impact you’ll help drive across the stack.

The Microsoft Turing team is an innovative engineering and research team working on state-of-the-art deep learning models to power end user experiences across the company. Software Engineers and Applied Scientists in the Turing team work together to push the boundaries of large-scale deep learning models on the Microsoft 365 Core world-class distributed training infrastructure.

As a Principal Software Engineer in the Turing team, you will leverage your skills and experience to help build the platform that powers enterprise Microsoft’s Copilots. You will work closely with applied scientists and engineers on building and designing both backend platform capabilities as well as core copilot scenarios aimed at delighting our customers. You will be responsible for building scalable, performant, and cutting-edge features. We’re solving some of the most technically demanding problems in distributed systems, language models, and production-scale AI. Whether you're passionate about finding innovative uses to apply AI, systems design, intelligent orchestration and reasoning systems, or building resilient services — this is the team where engineers thrive.

title: Senior Staff Deep Learning Researcher – Model Efficiency - Qualcomm - Amsterdam
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies Netherlands B.V.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Researcher

General Summary:

At Qualcomm AI Research, we are advancing AI to make its core capabilities – perception, reasoning, and action – ubiquitous across devices. Our mission is to make breakthroughs in fundamental AI research and scale them across industries. By bringing together some of the best minds in the field, we're pushing the boundaries of what's possible and shaping the future of AI.

Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Deep Learning Researcher to join our Amsterdam-based Model Efficiency research team.

The team’s mission is to do research that pushes the frontier of on-device efficiency. We focus on developing novel techniques to optimize LLMs and LVMs, including model quantization and compression, efficient data types, conditional compute and inference time compute. The team pushes the state-of-the-art to make modern foundation models more efficient and deployable on edge devices and the data center, ensuring best performance with minimal resource usage.

The ideal candidate will have a background in machine learning and deep learning with proven academic and/or industrial research experience, and a passion for pushing the boundaries of AI technology. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects as part of our team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • You conduct research and develop and quickly iterate on innovative deep learning-based models and algorithms. You design, experiment, and implement novel solutions that advance the state-of-the-art for inference efficiency, in close collaboration with other researchers and engineers.
  • As a senior member of the team, you effectively mentor and guide other team members, take on extended project responsibilities, define research roadmaps, and interact with cross-functional and cross-team/cross-departmental stakeholders.
  • Through your research and guidance, you create scientific as well as business impact, helping us develop impactful breakthroughs in AI Research. You engage with other teams to see your ideas deployed on millions of devices, such as mobile phones, robots, AR/VR headsets, or automated vehicles.
  • You stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning. You publish novel research findings in top-tier conferences and journals and engage with the academic community.

Requirements:

  • You have a PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Physics, Mathematics, Electrical engineering or similar field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have significant professional experience in machine learning and deep learning, either in an academic and/or industrial research setting (7+ years post-PhD, or equivalent).
  • You have proven experience in guiding others, e.g. through (co-)supervising PhD students, leading teams, or other equivalent manners.
  • You have hands-on experience developing and optimizing models and are comfortable with all aspects of the research cycle.
  • You have strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in deep learning research and impactful publications in top-tier machine learning conferences and journals (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, etc.) are a strong plus, ideally both as first and last author.
  • Prior experience with efficiency related topics such as quantization, compression, or hardware accelerators for neural networks is a plus, but not a necessity for this role.
  • Experience working with a variety of stakeholders and ability to communicate complex outcomes to a wide range of audiences.
  • Prior experience working in industrial research and/or technology leadership experience are a strong plus.

The role is based out of our Amsterdam office, and we are not seeking remote-based candidates.

Why Join Us

At Qualcomm AI Research, you will be part of a team with a wide range of backgrounds that values innovation and creativity. Our commitment to professional growth and development ensures that all team members can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives to making research and business impact.

You will be part of a global company (headquartered in San Diego) and work closely with exceptional researchers and engineers that publish at major conferences.

Additionally, you will be based in Amsterdam, a scenic, vibrant city known for its picturesque canals, rich history, and dynamic cultural scene, making it a wonderful place to live and work.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

The company partners with leading organisations to execute complex projects, leveraging cutting-edge technology and a skilled workforce to ensure efficient and reliable service delivery. MJ Quinn’s customer-focused approach and dedication to sustainability have solidified its reputation as a trusted provider in the infrastructure services sector.


DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

The MJ Quinn Technology Services Department support over 3000 people across our platforms and workforce and locations. The Department has complete ownership of our Microsoft Modern Workplace solutions combined with Microsoft Dynamics.


JOB OBJECTIVE

As a key member of our development team, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of applications and services built on the Microsoft technology stack. This role involves designing, developing, and testing high-quality solutions that support and enhance business-critical systems, hosted primarily on the Microsoft Dataverse and Microsoft Azure platforms.


Working across the full software development lifecycle, you will collaborate with stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Platform, C#, .NET, React and a broader mix of technologies both within and beyond the Microsoft ecosystem. Our solutions frequently integrate with third-party systems, requiring a thoughtful approach to interoperability, security, and performance.


In addition to your technical contributions, you will play an important role in upholding and promoting the organisation’s culture, reputation, and values. This includes demonstrating professionalism, accountability, and a commitment to high standards in both your work and interactions. You will contribute to a positive, collaborative environment, act as a trusted representative of the team, and ensure that the solutions you deliver reflect the quality and integrity expected of the organisation.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning technical solutions from concept to delivery, while also contributing to a strong team culture and delivering outcomes that positively represent the organisation both internally and externally.


KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and code clean, efficient and testable web-based applications and services.
  • Take ownership of projects from project kick-off through to deployment and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems across multiple projects.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to establish business needs and requirements.
  • Manage requirements and development tasks using Agile and Jira.
  • Transform requirements into technical designs that follow industry best practices and produce robust, quality solutions.
  • Participate in testing and code reviews to ensure technical accuracy, standards, and functional compliance to the design.
  • Identify issues and their underlying causes, clearly communicate them to stakeholders, suggest solutions and guide the implementation.
  • Participate in project meetings with stakeholders providing clear and concise guidance and progress updates throughout the life of projects.
  • To always promote a positive and professional image of the department, by adhering to company policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Work as part of a larger team to develop working practices and procedures.
  • Provide technical, application and systems support to all levels of the IT support teams.


PERSON SPECIFICAITON

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in software development using C# and .NET.
  • Experience with, or a strong willingness and ability to learn, Dynamics 365 and/or the Power Platform (e.g., Power Automate, Power Pages).
  • Experience developing modern front-end applications using React.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful Web API design and development.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure services (e.g., App Services, Functions).
  • Experience integrating with third-party systems and external APIs.
  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience working across the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, and deployment.


Desirable Experience


  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, particularly using Azure DevOps.
  • Experience working with technologies outside of the Microsoft stack (e.g., Node.js or other JavaScript frameworks).


Personal Attributes & Behaviours


  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Ability to take ownership of tasks and deliver solutions from concept through to production.
  • Contribute to the creation of a work environment which encourages and achieves success in individuals and retention of employees.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain and build up a good working relationship with internal and external stakeholders including colleagues, customers, suppliers, and senior management teams.
  • Proactive and adaptable, with a willingness to learn new technologies and approaches, particularly within the Dynamics 365 ecosystem.
  • A professional approach that actively upholds the organisation’s culture, values, and reputation in all interactions and deliverables.
  • A commitment to continuous improvement, both personally and within the team.
  • A legal right to work in the UK.


TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Working Conditions

Details

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description:

The Federal Enterprise Storage Solutions Architect is a senior customer-facing technical sales professional responsible for driving the adoption of HPE Storage solutions across U.S. Federal Government customers.

This role works directly with civilian, defense, national-security, and Federal Systems Integrator organizations to understand mission requirements, influence storage architecture decisions, and position HPE as the preferred storage technology provider.

The successful candidate combines deep enterprise storage expertise, Federal market knowledge, strong competitive selling skills, and a demonstrated track record of winning complex Federal opportunities.

Due to the responsibilities of this role and working closely with Federal Entities, this role requires a US citizen.

This role will require travel of 50%+

Requires Federal Clearance -TS/SCI with FSP poly

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead storage technical advisor and Solutions Architect for assigned Federal accounts.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer mission priorities, technical environments, acquisition strategies, security requirements, and modernization initiatives.
  • Architect and position HPE solutions across:
    • Block and mission-critical storage
    • File and unstructured data
    • Object storage
    • Data protection, disaster recovery, and cyber resilience
    • Virtualized and containerized environments
    • Private and hybrid cloud
    • AI and data-intensive workloads
    • Storage management, automation, and AIOps

  • Understand Federal buying cycles and engage early enough to influence requirements, architectures, specifications, and acquisition strategies.
  • Develop strong technical relationships with customer architects, engineers, program teams, acquisition stakeholders, and technical executives.
  • Work effectively with Federal Systems Integrators, prime contractors, OEM partners, and channel partners to develop and execute joint solutions and pursuit strategies.
  • Translate mission, workload, security, availability, performance, scalability, and resiliency requirements into differentiated HPE storage architectures.
  • Lead competitive strategy and clearly differentiate HPE against Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, NetApp, IBM, and other relevant storage competitors.
  • Support RFI, RFP, RFQ, technical proposal, architecture review, and solution-validation activities.
  • Coordinate HPE engineering, product, services, security, partner, and specialist resources in support of complex Federal pursuits.
  • Maintain technical ownership of strategic opportunities through successful technical closure.

Education and Experience

Required

  • Requires Federal Clearance -TS/SCI with FSP poly
  • Due to the responsibilities of this role and working closely with Federal Entities, this role requires a US citizen.
  • This role will require travel of 50%+
  • 6+ years working with or supporting the Federal Intelligence Community.
  • Significant experience as a Storage Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer, or equivalent customer-facing technical sales professional supporting Federal Government customers.
  • Demonstrated track record of successfully selling and architecting enterprise storage solutions into Federal accounts.
  • Experience supporting civilian and defense/national-security customers, or equivalent complex Federal environments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Federal acquisition processes, buying cycles, procurement practices, and contract vehicles.
  • Experience working with Federal Systems Integrators and prime contractors.
  • Strong working knowledge of HPE Storage solutions and related technologies.
  • Strong technical knowledge across block, file, object/unstructured data, data protection, virtualization, hybrid cloud, and cyber resilience.
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one major competitive storage portfolio such as Dell Technologies, Pure Storage, NetApp, IBM, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical pursuits from opportunity identification through technical closure.
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, preferred.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting classified or national-security environments.
  • Relevant HPE, storage, cloud, virtualization, security, or architecture certifications.
  • Experience with large Federal modernization, data-center consolidation, cloud, cyber-resilience, or mission-critical infrastructure programs.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Deep understanding of enterprise storage architectures, including block, file, object, backup, recovery, replication, disaster recovery, and cyber resilience.
  • Strong knowledge of HPE Storage technologies and the ability to architect, position, size, and differentiate HPE solutions.
  • Understanding of storage requirements for VMware, virtualization, Kubernetes/container, private-cloud, and hybrid-cloud environments.
  • Strong understanding of performance, availability, scalability, encryption, data protection, non-disruptive operations, and lifecycle management.
  • Working knowledge of Federal security, compliance, certification, and authorization requirements relevant to infrastructure solutions, including areas such as:
    • NIST security frameworks
    • FIPS requirements
    • RMF and Authorization to Operate processes
    • STIG requirements
    • FedRAMP considerations for applicable cloud services
    • CMMC/DFARS requirements where applicable
  • Understanding of Federal data sovereignty, encryption, access control, supply-chain, and information-protection considerations.
  • Strong understanding of the Federal acquisition lifecycle and the importance of influencing technical requirements before formal solicitation.
  • Ability to navigate complex buying ecosystems involving government customers, contracting organizations, Systems Integrators, prime contractors, and technology partners.

  • Advanced technical discovery, whiteboarding, sizing, architecture, demonstration, proof-of-concept, and presentation skills.

title: Automotive Experience Platform – Senior Engineer
location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

Job Overview/Summary: Senior automotive software engineer with 5+ years of experience focused on Android Automotive, software development, system integration testing, debugging, validation, and integration of next-generation automotive experience platforms.

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation toward a smarter, more connected future. The Automotive Experience Platform team within Qualcomm’s automotive business unit builds solutions that showcase future technologies in the automotive industry. The team highlights upcoming automotive technologies from Qualcomm and its partners at global trade shows and in private demonstrations for key industry stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Automotive Experience Platform team, you will design, develop, debug, validate, and integrate Android and automotive software features that demonstrate future vehicle experiences. You will work hands-on across development and system integration testing activities, including triaging complex issues, analyzing logs, debugging software across Android, Linux, QNX, middleware, and embedded interfaces, and driving issues to closure. You will collaborate with platform teams, UX teams, system integration teams, and partner organizations to support rapid prototyping, demo readiness, and reliable execution for customer and trade show showcases. This role is well suited for an engineer who can both build software and perform deep SIT-level debugging in a fast-paced automotive environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, in Android, Android Automotive, embedded systems, or automotive software platforms.

  • Strong understanding of Android framework, Android services, application lifecycle, IPC mechanisms, permissions, build systems, debugging tools, and system-level behavior.

  • BSP Integration, Performance analysis, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) management (multi virtual machine)

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Java or Kotlin, with solid working knowledge of C/C++

  • Compute platform architecture (SoC, GPU/DSP, accelerators) – Hypervisor /Virtual Machine

  • Embedded SW stacks (OS such as QNX/Linux/Android, middleware, frameworks, toolchains, AUTOSAR (Classic/Adaptive))

  • ADAS sensor integration: Cameras/RADARs/Ultrasound Sensors/

  • Experience with Android Automotive OS, automotive middleware, vehicle interfaces, CAN, SOME/IP, MQTT or other in-vehicle communication technologies is highly preferred.

  • Experience performing system integration testing, issue triage, log analysis, root-cause analysis, and debugging across software, middleware, operating system, and hardware interfaces.

  • Strong experience with Linux and QNX operating systems, embedded software environments, and cross-platform integration workflows.

  • Strong software design, development, unit testing, debugging, validation, and integration skills.

title: Process Engineer  - CIP/ SIP/ Autoclave
description:
Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Be part of Amgen's newest and most advanced drug substance manufacturing plant. When completed, the Amgen FleX batch facility will combine the latest in disposable technologies with traditional stainless steel equipment to allow for maximum flexibility in operations The FleX Batch facility will not only feature the best in-class drug substance manufacturing technologies with embedded industry 4.0 capabilities, but it will also integrate sustainability innovations to reduce carbon and waste, as part of Amgen's plan to be a carbon-neutral company by 2027.


Process Engineer - CIP/ SIP/ Autoclave


What you will do:

In this vital role you will be joining the Facilities & Engineering (F&E) group to partner closely with the corporate engineering team to design, build, commission, and qualify new equipment and systems needed for drug substance production as well as developing domain expertise to support operations upon start-up.


Site design, construction, start-up, and operational readiness:

Support the commissioning and qualification of manufacturing systems in alignment with GMP requirements and interact with regulatory inspectors.

  • Demonstrate technical expertise and provide lifecycle support for CIP skid systems, SIP circuits, autoclaves, transfer panels, process tanks, valves, instrumentation, and associated automation platforms. The role will support commissioning, qualification, startup readiness, routine manufacturing operations, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives with a focus on CIP, SIP and autoclave systems.
  • Ensure systems are installed and operate safely and comply with pertinent environmental health/safety practice, rules and regulations.
  • Interact with regulatory inspectors as a manufacturing systems owner to communicate and demonstrate appropriate regulatory compliance of operating systems.
  • Assist with new product/technology introductions by performing engineering assessments, implementing equipment modifications, and supporting engineering runs.

Site Operations:

  • Provide system support for biopharmaceutical process equipment – specifically CIP/SIP and/or autoclave systems. Assist in identifying and implementing engineering-based improvements or upgrades to equipment or facility systems.
  • Experience with CIP circuit design/validation and SIP
  • Support the development of business cases for improvements, identification of design requirements, and translation of these requirements into process equipment/system design, specifications, and supporting the construction, startup, and validation of improvements.
  • Develop equipment maintenance programs, ensure the availability of spare parts, and coordinate maintenance activities to ensure systems are in proper working order.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The engineering professional we seek enjoys challenges and is motivated to help serve patients with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

Master’s degree
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of Engineering experience
OR
Associate’s degree and 6 years of Engineering experience
OR
High school diploma / GED and 8 years of Engineering experience


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’ s degree in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering or similar engineer discipline.
  • 3+ years' of relevant work experience with 2+ years' experience in Biopharmaceutical operations/manufacturing environment
  • Direct knowledge of design and troubleshooting with GMP Biopharmaceutical Production facility equipment/systems with direct experience with Solution Prep, Upstream, and Downstream purification equipment such as weigh and dispense equipment, solution preparation vessels, cell culture reactors, centrifugation, chromatography, viral filtration skids, and UFDF skids as well as other equipment needed to support these processes such as autoclaves, clean in place (CIP) systems, washers, clean steam, water for injection, etc.
  • Ability to analyze problems, develop and propose engineering solutions in a scientific manner using data-driven techniques and analyses (e.g., Data Analytics, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Six Sigma, Predictive Maintenance, etc.)
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. cGMP, OSHA, EPA, etc.) and familiarity with GMP quality systems/processes such as change control, non-conformances, corrective and preventative actions, and qualifications/validation
  • Experience applying engineering principles to the design and implementation of system modifications, introduction of new processes, and the oversight of capital projects
  • Understanding of capital projects in a GMP Biopharmaceutical Production facility including procurement, construction, startup, and validation
  • Understanding of safety requirements working in a GMP Biopharmaceutical Production facility.
  • Independent, ambitious, organized, able to multi-task in project environments, and skilled in communication, facilitation, and teamwork
  • Collaborative teammate prepared to work in and embrace a team based environment that relies on communication for effective decision-making
  • Strong leadership, technical writing, and communication/presentation skills
  • Work schedule flexibility as required to support 24/7 operations, requiring occasional after hours engineering coverage
  • Ability for domestic/international travel.


What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.


Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team!

description:
Windows Server Admin

Position Summary

The Windows Server Administrator will support a limited Proof of Concept (PoC) of the Qualys Patch Management module on selected Windows servers. The role focuses on server readiness, controlled patch and remediation testing, validation of server health, and clear documentation of results. This is a testing assignment and does not include production rollout or ongoing administration of the Qualys platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare the selected Windows servers and confirm that prerequisites within the Windows server administration scope are in place.
  • Run and validate agreed test cases for Microsoft monthly patches, third-party application patches, vulnerability-remediation actions, and registry fixes.
  • Validate pre-patch and post-patch server health, services, application dependencies, event logs, restart behaviour, and system availability.
  • Troubleshoot Windows server issues within the infrastructure support scope and document issues requiring or Qualys support.
  • Support approved network or connectivity changes through the applicable process when a PoC test requires a new port, URL allow-list entry, or firewall change.
  • Maintain detailed test records and risk entries, including evidence of success, failure, rollback needs, and follow-up actions.
  • Contribute Windows server findings, risks, limitations, and recommendations to the PoC findings report.
  • Coordinate with the Desktop Support Engineer, Linux Administrator, application owners, and stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong hands-on Windows Server administration experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience with supported enterprise Windows Server versions.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft server patching using tools such as WSUS or Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM).
  • Ability to assess patch prerequisites, maintenance windows, restart requirements, service dependencies, and recovery considerations.
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows services, event logs, registry settings, network connectivity, and failed patch installations.
  • Working knowledge of vulnerability remediation and Windows security configuration changes.
  • PowerShell skills for validation, evidence collection, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to produce clear test logs and communicate risks and technical findings.

Preferred Skills

  • Previous exposure to Qualys VMDR or Qualys Patch Management.
  • Experience testing patching tools in windows server groups.
  • Knowledge of server backup, rollback, and recovery validation practices.
  • Experience working in hybrid or cloud-connected Windows Server environments.

title: Copy of Software Engineering Developer, DevOps
description:
Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team and enhance our development and operational efficiency. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a cloud-agnostic environment and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable infrastructure across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

The ideal candidate will work closely with a large number of stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery pipelines, strong infrastructure-as-code practices, and a robust DevOps culture. This will include integrating numerous open source and commercial applications such as Docker, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab Artifactory, VMWare, and Kubernetes. You will experience a diverse variety of tasks through all stages of the software development life cycle.

This role will be a combination of working remotely and onsite at our Calgary or Ottawa office. We have a number of measures in place for onsite working – our top priority remains the health and safety of our colleagues.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes.
  • Design and implement cloud-agnostic infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Ansible.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and applications.
  • Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Optimize system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system availability, scalability and reliability across cloud platforms.
  • Evaluate, prototype, and roll out new tools and technologies to support the DevOps automation transformation effort.
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices and implement system hardening and compliance measures.
  • Configure, manage and maintain functional and virtualized networks, devices and infrastructure.
  • Integrate tools together and automating their provisioning, configuration, and management across cloud and on-prem infrastructure.
  • Writing software and scripts necessary to deploy solutions and automate tasks.
  • Developing automated tests for new and updated functionality.

Qualifications

The candidate must meet each of the following criteria:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering; Computer Science; or a related technical/engineering degree
  • 4+ years of previous DevOps experience
  • Tools & Technologies
    • CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI (preferred)
    • Scripting languages: Python, Bash
    • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
    • Configuration: Ansible, Terraform, Packer
    • Observability (Prometheus, Grafana)
    • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and branching strategies
    • Strong understanding of Linux/Unix based systems
    • Experience working through the software development life cycle
    • Knowledge of networking concepts (DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, etc)
    • Experience with virtualized environments
    • Experience working across at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Thrive working in a team environment, developing consensus rather than working alone.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, develop and recommend options, and implement solutions
  • Understanding of DevSecOps practices.
  • Exposure working in an Agile environment, or an understanding of Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated practice thriving in a hybrid work environment
  • Familiarity with test automation tools and integrating those into your development process
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models.

How We Work

  • Work Schedule: 37.5 hours per week - flexible within core business hours.
  • Work Arrangement: A mix of onsite and remote work, as determined by business and role requirements.

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems-Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

Additional Information

What We Offer
The expected hiring range for this position is $85,000-$110,000 CAD annual.

Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

  • Technical and non-technical skills
  • Education and certifications

Benefits
At General Dynamics Mission Systems – Canada, we prioritize work-life balance. As a fulltime regular/term employee, you can enjoy a supportive, friendly and respectful environment with a competitive total rewards package.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents, from day one of employment at no cost to you.
    • Flexible benefit options available (including HCSA).
    • Emergency medical travel insurance.
    • 24/7 virtual health care services.
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP) – counselling, life coaching, lifestyle change support, and financial planning.
  • Onsite fitness facilities & employee resource groups.
  • Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP) with employer contributions after 3 months of service.
    • Access to financial advisors for investment advice and comprehensive financial planning.
    • Voluntary Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) accessible from day one.
  • Flexible time away to rest and renew with vacation, holidays, vacation purchase plan and parental leaves (with top up options).
    • Sick leave and disability programs.
  • Grow your career your way with free access to a learning platform offering a wide range of courses and resources.
    • Educational Assistance Program to support formal learning.
    • Self-directed mentoring opportunities.
    • Reimbursement for professional and industry-related memberships and dues.
  • Employee discounts on travel, home and auto insurance, as well as services and activities.
    • Free onsite parking.
    • Annual scholarship program for children of GD employees.
    • Employee social clubs and recreational activities.
  • Purposeful Innovation: You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
  • Connection: We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world‑class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensure every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
  • Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways: Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. You’ll work on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and provide opportunities to learn from experienced mentors and grow as an early‑career professional. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network.

title: Portfolio Messaging Strategist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Portfolio Messaging Strategist based in United States.

This highly visible role will shape the executive narrative for a strategic enterprise AI and industrial orchestration portfolio. You will sit at the intersection of Product Marketing, Content Marketing, and Corporate Communications, translating complex technologies into clear, differentiated, customer-focused stories. Your work will influence executive presentations, industry events, analyst engagements, customer forums, and broader go-to-market communications. You’ll partner with senior executives, product leaders, technical experts, marketers, and global stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization. The role combines strategic positioning, executive storytelling, technical fluency, and cross-functional leadership. It offers an opportunity to define how organizations understand the value of industrial AI, data foundations, intelligent applications, and agentic workflows.

Accountabilities:

  • Define and continuously evolve the master narrative for the enterprise AI and agentic orchestration portfolio, ensuring it remains differentiated, credible, and aligned with customer needs and business strategy.
  • Develop narrative frameworks based on customer challenges, product value, market dynamics, competitive differentiation, and industry expertise.
  • Establish consistent messaging architecture, terminology, proof points, and storytelling standards connecting corporate vision, portfolio positioning, product messaging, industry use cases, and customer outcomes.
  • Govern narrative consistency across executive presentations, leadership communications, events, analyst engagements, customer forums, and other high-visibility channels.
  • Identify messaging gaps, inconsistencies, and competing narratives, then facilitate alignment across stakeholders and teams.
  • Lead the strategic development of executive keynotes, high-profile presentations, customer events, analyst engagements, and other executive communications.
  • Partner with senior leaders, product teams, and subject matter experts to turn complex technical strategies and innovations into compelling, audience-specific stories.
  • Define presentation storylines, narrative arcs, proof points, visual direction, customer examples, and calls to action, while developing repeatable processes for speaker preparation, rehearsals, content governance, and post-event content reuse.
  • Build deep knowledge of portfolio capabilities, product roadmaps, technical architecture, customer adoption models, competitive positioning, and strategic ecosystems.
  • Translate concepts such as industrial data platforms, knowledge graphs, AI/ML lifecycle management, low-code development, agentic workflows, governance, and human-AI collaboration into clear customer value propositions.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Product Marketing, Solutions Marketing, Sales, industry teams, and strategic partners to connect messaging claims with measurable business outcomes and technical proof.
  • Build trusted relationships across global businesses and functions, lead narrative reviews, resolve competing priorities, and drive messaging decisions with speed and strategic judgment.
  • Coach executives and go-to-market leaders on customer-first storytelling, message hierarchy, narrative discipline, and effective executive presentations.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Strategic Marketing, Portfolio Marketing, Brand Strategy, Communications, or a related discipline.
    • Professional experience within enterprise software, industrial technology, artificial intelligence, data platforms, automation, cloud technologies, platform businesses, or similarly complex technology environments.
    • Demonstrated success creating category, platform, or portfolio narratives that strengthen market understanding, differentiation, and go-to-market execution.
    • Extensive experience developing executive keynotes, leadership presentations, high-visibility communications, and customer-facing narratives.
    • Exceptional storytelling, writing, editing, presentation development, and communication skills.
    • Strong product marketing expertise, with the ability to synthesize market trends, customer needs, product capabilities, competitive dynamics, and proof points into a compelling strategic narrative.
    • Ability to understand sophisticated technical products and translate their complexity into accessible business value without sacrificing technical credibility.
    • Proven ability to influence senior executives and align diverse stakeholders within a global, highly matrixed organization.
    • Strong executive presence and confidence working with senior leaders, technical experts, customers, analysts, and cross-functional teams.
    • Excellent stakeholder management, strategic judgment, collaboration, and prioritization skills.

      • Benefits:
