description:
Since 2012, Rightsline has been making work easier for rights and royalties professionals with our innovative rights and royalties management software, allowing our customers to maximize their portfolios without having to max out their daily to-do-lists.

Our fully integrated and configurable platform provides customers with comprehensive access to all their rights and royalties, across all markets and platforms, instantly. Departments can communicate, collaborate, and cohesively take action without worrying about mistakes; and in-app reports and timely alerts ensure our customers never miss an opportunity to do more.

________________________________________

The Position

As our IT Systems Administrator, you’ll support the charge in securing, optimizing, and scaling our endpoint and cloud-based IT operations. You’ll partner closely with IT leadership and Security teams to implement and maintain best-in-class systems and controls, supporting a hybrid workforce with a strong focus on proactive device management, data protection, and user experience. This is a hybrid role with an expectation to support in-office work, and it may occasionally require travel and lifting.

Mission & Impact

This role keeps Rightsline’s hybrid workforce secure, productive, and well-equipped — from the devices people use every day to the AI infrastructure the company is increasingly building on. You will be accountable for the security posture and compliance readiness of our endpoint and cloud environments, and for how safely and effectively AI tools are deployed and used across the organization. Success looks like a well-managed device fleet, audit-ready compliance, and IT and Security teams that trust the systems and controls you maintain.

What You Will Own

This role’s work spans five areas, each described below.

Endpoint Security & Device Management

● Support endpoint security and compliance across Mac and PC environments using modern MDM solutions (e.g., Mosyle, Hexnode, Intune), and ensure device hygiene, OS patching, and encryption are enforced

● Own and evolve device lifecycle management from procurement to decommissioning, including inventory tracking, configuration, and hardware budgeting

● Manage and optimize our MDM and security suite solutions (Mac & PC), working with vendors to evaluate performance, costs, and integrations

AI Infrastructure & Emerging Technology

● Support and advance our AI infrastructure and initiatives, including deployment, maintenance, and security

Data Protection & Compliance

● Maintain a secure environment with DLP, malware protection, phishing prevention, and cloud backup solutions

● Collaborate on device compliance strategy, supporting audit-readiness and SOC2 objectives through robust configuration and policy enforcement

Systems & Tools Administration

● Administer and enhance our enterprise communication tools (Slack, Google Workspace), including access policies, automation, and integrations

● Monitor and report on SaaS usage and shadow IT, using discovery tools to uncover risk and eliminate redundancy

● Oversee third-party professional IT services as needed to supplement support and project work

● Assist with Jira Service Management administration and the Atlassian suite in general

Support & Mentorship

● Provide Tier 2 escalation support and mentor junior admins or IT support specialists

What You Will Bring

● 4+ years of experience in system administration or IT infrastructure, ideally in a SaaS or fast-growth tech environment

● Education or hands-on experience with Artificial Intelligence, including tools such as Claude and Gemini, MCPs, Skills, and Plugins, and third-party inference platforms such as AWS Bedrock

● Working knowledge of AI security principles, enforcement, and policy, with experience deploying and managing AI tools across Mac and Windows environments

● Senior-level experience managing Windows and Mac devices via MDM platforms, including deep troubleshooting using logs, Active Directory/Entra/M365 administration, and management profiles, ABM, system recovery, and app deployment

● Strong grasp of endpoint security, DLP, phishing, and malware defense strategies

● Experience with cloud-first environments, especially Google Workspace and Slack administration

● Advanced knowledge and experience administering and securing AI technologies across the organization

● Comfortable with scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python)

● Proven ability to work cross-functionally with InfoSec, Engineering, HR, and Finance

● Excellent documentation and vendor management skills

● Analytical mindset with experience supporting IT budgeting and cost-control initiatives

Preferred Qualifications:

● Valid driver’s license, useful for the role’s occasional travel requirements

________________________________________

Our Core Values

At Rightsline, we look for these qualities in every hire, and we hold ourselves to them every day.

● Be Curious and Smart

Being smart isn't about having all the answers — it's about asking the right questions, seeking out new ideas, and never assuming you already know enough.

● Embrace Change

This industry moves fast and so do we. We don't resist change — we lean into it. That means staying flexible, letting go of what isn't working, and treating uncertainty as opportunity rather than obstacle.

● Show Up

Showing up means being present — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally. Your teammates count on you. Your customers count on you. We do our best work when everyone is fully engaged and accountable to each other.

● Get it Done

Ideas are easy. Execution is the job. We hold ourselves to what we commit to, push through the hard parts, and measure success by our actual accomplishments.

● Be Humble

Nobody here has a monopoly on good ideas. We listen more than we talk, share credit freely, and check our egos at the door. The best outcome matters more than whose idea it was.

________________________________________

title: Senior Thermal Engineer
description:
About the Role

Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.

As a Senior Thermal Engineer at Uber AV Labs, you will own thermal design, validation, and troubleshooting for autonomous vehicle hardware. This is a highly hands-on role working directly with sensors, compute systems, vehicle hardware, and environmental systems from prototype through production.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own end to end thermal design and validation for vehicle hardware, including compute units, power electronics and sensor systems
  • Design practical thermal solutions using liquid cooling, conduction, convection, heat sinks, fans/blowers, heaters, insulation, and thermal interface materials.
  • Design and develop liquid cooling systems, including coolant loops, cold plates, pumps, heat exchangers/radiators, reservoirs, valves, hoses, and vehicle integration.
  • Build and instrument prototypes; perform bench, thermal chamber, and vehicle testing across hot/cold environmental conditions.
  • Perform thermal and fluid calculations to size cooling components and evaluate system performance.
  • Use thermal/CFD simulation where appropriate and correlate models against physical test data.
  • Troubleshoot thermal and cooling-system issues directly on vehicles and hardware, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Work closely with mechanical, electrical, sensor, compute, vehicle integration, and operation teams.
  • Drive designs from early prototype through validation builds and release in production.

Basic Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of thermal engineering experience, preferably in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, aerospace, or high-power electronics.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and validating cooling systems. Demonstrated experience with liquid cooling.
  • Strong hands-on experience building, instrumenting, and testing thermal systems.
  • Strong understanding of heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and electronics thermal management.
  • Experience with environmental chambers and vehicle-level hot/cold testing.
  • Experience with CAD (Solidworks, NX, Catia or equivalent) and mechanical design
  • Comfortable working directly with prototype hardware, test equipment, and vehicles.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous thermal problem from measurement → root cause → design → validation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with thermal/CFD tools
  • Automotive coolant-loop or vehicle thermal-management experience.
  • Familiarity with automotive validation, reliability testing, and production design processes.

For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Data Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

If you have experience in data engineering and are looking for an opportunity to build your skills on modern enterprise data platforms, we would love to hear from you.
Zurich Canada is looking for a Data Engineer to build, operate and support data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets that power reporting, advanced analytics and AI-enabled solutions across the organization.
Reporting to the Data Platform Leader, you will work with data engineers, platform teams, analytics partners and business stakeholders to ingest, transform and curate high-quality data using Microsoft Azure and Databricks. You will gain hands‑on experience with enterprise data platforms while working within Zurich’s data governance, security and risk standards.
This is an opportunity to deepen your technical expertise, contribute to meaningful enterprise data initiatives and continue building your career in a collaborative environment where your ideas and perspective are valued.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
Zurich Canada uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, including the initial review and screening of applications. Artificial intelligence is not the sole basis for candidate shortlisting or selection. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by qualified hiring professionals.
Zurich follows a hybrid work model requiring three days per week of in‑person presence, which may include time in the office or market‑facing engagements.

What you will do:

  • Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks on Microsoft Azure for batch and incremental data processing.
  • Build data transformations using Python and SQL, following established engineering standards and patterns.
  • Support the ingestion of data from enterprise applications, files, APIs and event‑driven sources.
  • Help design and maintain curated datasets across Lakehouse layers, including raw, refined and curated data.
  • Perform data‑quality checks, anomaly detection and reconciliations to improve data accuracy and reliability.
  • Monitor production jobs, troubleshoot failures and resolve data issues.
  • Partner with analytics, data science and AI teams to create trusted data foundations for reporting, advanced analytics and AI‑enabled use cases.
  • Follow Zurich’s data governance, privacy and security requirements, including standards for sensitive and regulated data.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge sharing across the Data Management team.
  • Continue developing your technical capabilities by applying new platform features and engineering practices.

Job Qualifications – What you bring to the table

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline OR Equivalent practical experience AND

  • Hands‑on experience using Python for data processing and automation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and transforming data.
  • Exposure to Databricks, including jobs, notebooks and Delta Lake concepts, or a similar cloud data platform.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services such as storage, compute, identity and networking.
  • Understanding of core data‑engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, data modelling, schema evolution and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of data‑quality, validation and monitoring practices.
  • Awareness of modern analytics and AI/ML concepts and the role data engineering plays in enabling them.
  • Ability to write clear, maintainable code and work within version‑control and engineering standards.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn in a complex enterprise environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Delta Lake or Lakehouse architectures.
  • Exposure to CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy or regulated‑data environments such as financial services or insurance.
  • Experience supporting data solutions in an enterprise production environment.
  • Interest in AI‑enabled analytics and automation.

Compensation
At Zurich Canada, we are committed to pay equity. We determine compensation based on objective criteria such as skills, experience and internal equity. The salary range for this position is $65,000–$100,000. This range reflects the expected pay for the role across Canada and may vary depending on factors such as office location, specific responsibilities and individual qualifications.

Our Culture

  • At Zurich, we are proud of our culture. We are passionate about Diversity, Inclusion, Equity and Belonging (DIEB). We want you to bring your whole self to work, and we want our employees to be reflective of the communities in which we live and work. Our DIEB initiatives are creating an environment where everyone feels welcome.
  • We have a collaborative culture where diversity of thought is valued. We value your input and strive to give our employees the tools they need to make an impact.
  • We care about our employees’ well‑being and offer a comprehensive health/benefits plan with varying levels of coverage to suit your specific needs and a competitive total compensation package.
  • We understand how important it is to rest, recharge and do the things you love. At Zurich, all employees receive a minimum of four weeks of vacation per year to do just that.
  • We also understand that employees require time off for personal reasons. Maybe you have an appointment during a workday, a cultural or religious holiday you would like to observe, or you need time off to focus on your mental health. Zurich employees receive four personal days per year to be used at their discretion.
  • We are committed to continuous improvement and offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.
  • We care about our communities. Our communities are where our customers, people, and shareholders live and work. While we can be proud of the contribution to society Zurich makes through our core business of insurance, we must also give back to our communities through our talent, time and resources.
  • We have won numerous awards for our workplace culture. We are proud to be one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers and to have received Insurance Business Canada’s 5‑Star Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Award.

Make a difference. Be challenged. Be inspired. Be supported. Love what you do. Work for us.

About US

Zurich Canada is part of the Zurich Insurance Group, a multi-line insurer with approximately 55,000 employees worldwide serving customers in global and local markets. Zurich Canada has been a leading insurance provider serving mid‑size and large companies, including multinational corporations, in the Canadian commercial market for 100 years. With over 650 employees in offices across the country, Zurich offers the global strength of a top insurance provider combined with in‑depth knowledge of industries and local markets. Zurich Canada aspires to be risk management professionals’ first choice as their premier partner to help meet the risk challenges of today and tomorrow. Read more at www.zurichcanada.com .

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Shipping companies operate on systems that weren't designed to talk to each other: ERPs that only speak SOAP, supplier portals that require UI automation, forwarder platforms with inconsistent data formats, vessel systems with limited connectivity. You'll build the backend infrastructure that makes these systems work together, the integration layer, data synchronization engine, and workflow orchestration platform that powers Narwhal's AI agents.


What You'll Do



  • Design and build integration infrastructure: connectors for ERPs (BASSnet, ShipNet, MariApps), supplier systems, forwarder platforms, and vessel management software

  • Develop the data synchronization engine that keeps information consistent across disconnected systems in real-time

  • Build workflow orchestration systems that coordinate AI agents across procurement, logistics, and inventory management

  • Implement robust error handling, retry logic, and monitoring for integrations operating in unreliable network conditions (vessels at sea, port connections)

  • Design database schemas and data models for our vessel-centric data layer

  • Build APIs that expose Narwhal's capabilities to frontend applications and customer systems

  • Ensure enterprise-grade security, data isolation, and compliance for multi-tenant deployments

  • Instrument systems for observability: logging, metrics, alerting, and debugging tools


Who You Are



  • 5+ years backend engineering experience

  • Strong system design skills: you think about scalability, reliability, and maintainability

  • Deep experience with APIs: REST, GraphQL, webhooks, authentication, rate limiting

  • Solid understanding of databases: SQL, schema design, query optimization, data modeling

  • Experience building integrations with third-party systems, especially legacy enterprise software

  • Comfortable with RPA frameworks or UI automation for systems without APIs

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, you find root causes in complex distributed systems

  • Pragmatic about technology choices: you pick the right tool for the job, not the trendy one

  • Comfortable working directly with operators and technical teams during deployments, you'll debug issues on-site and explain technical decisions in operational terms


Nice to Have



  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, or industrial operations software

  • Background in enterprise integration platforms, ETL systems, or middleware

  • Familiarity with message queues, event-driven architectures, and async processing

  • Understanding of maritime operations or freight forwarding workflows


Why Join Narwhal



  • Core infrastructure role with ownership over critical systems

  • Solve hard integration problems that most companies consider impossible

  • Build for real-world conditions: unreliable networks, legacy systems, high-stakes operations

  • Work directly with customers, see your systems in production, debug real issues, understand impact

  • Equity stake in a company connecting a trillion-dollar industry

  • What excites you about building for maritime operations

  • A hard problem you've solved that's relevant to this role

  • Why you want to join at this stage


We'll respond within 48 hours.

Now, 400+ clients and over 13,000 companies worldwide count on Novata to make collecting, reporting, and acting on sustainability data easy.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team focused on our Companies team. This is a high-impact role, contributing to the continued development of core tooling that enables companies to manage and make sense of ESG data. You will collaborate closely with Product and Design teams, take ownership of key initiatives, and help scale our platform in alignment with Novata’s mission.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Developing and maintaining features across the stack for Novata’s Companies product
  • Driving projects that improve the ESG data experience for private companies – including dashboards, reporting tools, and data visualisations
  • Collaborating with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to build robust, user-friendly experiences
  • Participating in architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Helping to scale our engineering practices as we expand our UK-based team
  • Contributing to technical documentation and mentoring less experienced developers

About You

You are an experienced engineer who:

  • Leverages modern AI tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance productivity
  • Has 4+ years of experience building web applications, with expertise in React, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Has strong product sensibility and enjoys solving real-world user problems
  • Is comfortable owning full-stack features from design through deployment
  • Has excellent communication skills and thrives in cross-functional environments
  • Writes clean, maintainable code and values test coverage, security, and scalability
  • Enjoys collaborating with mission-driven teams and wants to help shape a growing company

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: Node.js
  • Databases: PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring & Logging: DataDog
  • Collaboration: Jira, Slack, Notion

Important Notes

  • This role is based in London, with hybrid working arrangements (2 days in office).
  • Applicants must be located in and eligible to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to support visa applications or relocation at this time.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity ownership opportunities
  • Comprehensive health benefits packages (medical, dental, non-contributory pension scheme)
  • Robust leave policies (PTO, parental leave, VTO)
  • Flexible work environment with two days working from the London Office
  • Mission-driven, collaborative, and inclusive culture

Why Join Us?

Novata is a mission-first company built to enable the private markets to drive more impact. We are at the unique intersection of ESG, the private markets, and mission driven impact. We are well-funded, have a top tier executive leadership team. We have a highly aggressive growth plan to establish ourselves as the industry leader of ESG with immediate plans for product and international expansion.

Members of our leadership team have been globally recognized for their success as leaders of large public companies, founders of successful startups, leaders of established ESG organizations, and builders of robust tech platforms. We are passionate, highly motivated, and experienced individuals who embrace our diverse backgrounds. Together, we will become the platform of choice and a catalyst for a change in the way business is done.

description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Swanson, and V8.

Location: Beloit, Wisconsin

Shift: 1st

Hours: 6:45 AM – 3:00 PM with overtime on an as needed basis based on business needs. Starting times and hours may vary depending on coverage due to report-offs and the production schedule especially during holidays. Good attendance and punctuality required.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE HISTORY HERE…

As a Seasoning Operator, you will play a critical role in ensuring products are seasoned to quality standards while maintaining a continuous flow of product to packaging operations. You will help drive product quality, food safety, operational efficiency, and equipment reliability through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and documentation.

WHAT YOU WILL DO…

  • Follow all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), food safety requirements, and safety regulations.
  • Maintain seasoning systems with the correct seasoning levels and ensure proper product flow.
  • Monitor product quality and make adjustments to ensure compliance with QA specifications.
  • Set up, operate, troubleshoot, and perform minor maintenance on seasoning equipment.
  • Assemble and disassemble seasoning line equipment for operation, cleaning, and changeovers.
  • Perform line cleanups, changeovers, and sanitation activities, including chemical, allergen, and Kosher cleaning procedures.
  • Complete documentation related to seasoning process monitoring and operational checks.
  • Calibrate load cells, assist with scale calibration, and verify sensors using calibration tools.
  • Perform seasoning drop tests, adjust seasoning settings, and operate equipment through operator interface panels.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and corrective actions related to seasoning application and equipment performance.
  • Retrieve supplies and materials from the warehouse to support production needs.
  • Operate case erectors and perform sanitation of scales and drums.
  • Support Research & Development activities by assisting with seasoning trials and new product testing.
  • Communicate effectively with Packaging, Quality Assurance, Maintenance, Warehouse, and other team members regarding operational needs and issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH…

  • Packaging Leads
  • Quality Assurance Team
  • Maintenance Team
  • Warehouse Team
  • Research & Development (R&D)
  • Production and Operations Team Members

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE… (MUST HAVE)

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • One (1) year of manufacturing or production experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Ability to follow GMPs, SOPs, safety procedures, and sanitation requirements.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and make minor equipment adjustments.
  • Ability to accurately complete production and quality documentation.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work a 3rd-shift schedule and overtime as required.
  • Demonstrated reliability, attendance, and punctuality.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand continuously and walk frequently throughout the shift.
  • Frequent bending, squatting, stooping, kneeling, pushing, pulling, and repetitive movements.
  • Continuous use of hands and hand dexterity.
  • Ability to lift:
    • Up to 10 lbs. continuously
    • Up to 25 lbs. frequently
    • Up to 60 lbs. occasionally

Work Environment

  • Manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels requiring hearing protection.
  • Frequent exposure to moving mechanical parts and humid or wet conditions.
  • Occasional exposure to heights, airborne particles, chemicals, outdoor weather, and temperature extremes.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAVE… (NICE TO HAVE)

  • Experience operating seasoning, packaging, or food manufacturing equipment.
  • Experience with equipment calibration, preventative maintenance, or troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of food safety, allergen controls, and sanitation processes.
  • Experience supporting new product testing or manufacturing trials.
  • Familiarity with automated production systems and operator interface panels.

We're hiring a Data Engineer to work on the Data Platform at Depop. This team owns Kafka and streaming infrastructure, the bronze data lake layer, and event tracking and sessionisation and is building out the next generation of streaming frameworks that will underpin how the rest of the business ingests and processes data. This role sits within the Data Enablement and you'll partner closely with Data Infrastructure and Analytics Engineering on the boundary between Bronze and Silver, and with ML and Insights, who depend on low-latency streaming data for features and experimentation.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain services in our Kafka Connect and streaming pipeline, including the kafka-forwarder and changelogs-processor, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Contribute to extending the bronze streaming layer across Depop's growing table catalogue, working from well-scoped tickets through to production rollout.
  • Help implement data contracts and freshness checks on streaming datasets, and build the quarantine/alerting that keeps bad data out of downstream consumers.
  • Take part in the team's support rota, helping other teams onboard new events and troubleshoot streaming issues.
  • Write clear documentation and contribute to design discussions, growing your judgement on trade-offs like latency vs completeness and cost vs freshness.
  • Pair with senior engineers on more complex pieces of the streaming framework work, building towards owning larger pieces of it yourself.

Requirements

  • Some experience building and operating production data pipelines, ideally including Kafka or another streaming/event-driven system.
  • Working knowledge of at least one of Scala, Kotlin or Python, and willingness to work across all three as the team requires.
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts (e.g. medallion architecture bronze/silver/gold) and an interest in data quality and freshness monitoring.

title: Quality Control NDT Inspector
description:
Schedule: Training: 1st Shift, Monday–Friday, 5:00 AM–4:30 PM (additional overtime for 18–24 months, then transition to 2nd Shift, Monday–Friday, 4:30 PM–5:00 AM.
10% shift premium for 2nd/3rd shift

Build Your Career. Own Your Future. Join a 100% Employee-Owned Company.

At Scot Forge, you can build a long-term career while working with some of the largest and most technically demanding forged components in the world.

At Scot Forge, we're more than a manufacturer—we're a 100% employee-owned company and a recognized leader in custom open-die and rolled ring forgings. Every employee is an owner, sharing in our success while helping build products that power some of the world's most demanding industries.

If you're looking for a career where your skills matter, your work has purpose, and your success is rewarded, we'd love to have you join our team.

Why Join Scot Forge?

  • 100% Employee-Owned Company – ESOP
  • Career Growth & Advancement Opportunities
  • Company-Wide Bonus / Profit Sharing
  • 10% 2nd / 3rd Shift Premiums
  • Competitive Pay
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Prescription Drug Plan
  • FSA & HSA Options
  • 401(k) with Company Match + Roth Option
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance
  • Company-Paid Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Paid Vacation & Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Hands-On Training & Certification Opportunities
  • Work on mission-critical components used around the world

We are looking for individuals who are analytical, mechanically inclined, detail-oriented, and serious about building a long-term career manufacturing.

What You'll Do

As a Quality Control / NDT Technician, you will play a critical role in ensuring our forged products meet customer, industry, and internal quality requirements. Willing to train entry level candidates providing they demonstrate willingness to work and ability to learn new skills and grow with company.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Inspect incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products.
  • Perform product inspections and evaluate conformance to specifications.
  • Set up, calibrate, and operate various non-destructive testing (NDT/NDE) equipment to verify steel integrity.
  • Perform NDE in accordance with NADCAP standards and applicable procedures.
  • Develop expertise and maintain internal certifications in Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Penetrant Testing (PT), and Magnetic Particle Testing (MT).
  • Obtain certifications in Niton, Brinell, and Final Inspection.
  • Review shop orders, specifications, drawings, and production prints to determine appropriate inspection and testing requirements.
  • Analyze inspection data and prepare NDE reports.
  • Document non-conforming material and identify the location and nature of non-conformances.
  • Prepare documentation for deviations and non-conformance reports.
  • Complete dimensional inspection reports and customer-required inspection documentation.
  • Work closely with Sales, Process Engineering, Metallurgy, and Production to resolve quality questions and communicate non-conformances.
  • Perform inspections at Scot Forge facilities and, when required, at customer locations.
  • Ask questions and raise concerns whenever a process, safety issue, or quality requirement is unclear.
  • Follow all Scot Forge safety, quality, and operating procedures.
  • Complete required training for cranes, rigging, forklifts, etchants, Niton equipment, radiation detectors, and other specialized inspection equipment.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of manufacturing, heavy equipment, Quality Control, or Quality Assurance experience.
  • Experience using micrometers, calipers, and gauges.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to analyze technical information.
  • Ability to read and understand specifications, drawings, and inspection requirements.

Preferred:

  • Associate degree (AAS or equivalent).
  • NDT/NDE Level I or Level II certification.
  • ASNT ACCP certifications in UT, PT, and/or MT.
  • ASQ CQI or CQT certification.
  • 1–3 years of applied NDE training or experience.
  • Ultrasonic/Ultrasound testing experience.
  • Strong QA/QC documentation and reporting experience.
  • Prior experience in manufacturing.

A Career With Scot Forge

For more than 130 years, Scot Forge has been creating custom open-die and rolled-ring forgings for some of the world's most demanding applications. Our components have been used in everything from NASA's Curiosity Mars Rover to nuclear submarines, large mining equipment, energy infrastructure, transportation, manufacturing, and national defense. When you join Scot Forge, you're not just inspecting parts — you're helping ensure the quality and reliability of products that matter. And because we're 100% employee-owned, your work contributes directly to the success of the company you own a piece of.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

title: Honing Set-Up Operator
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Honing Set-Up Operator to join our manufacturing team. This position is responsible for setting up and operating honing equipment to produce precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and quality requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience setting up honing machines, reading blueprints, using precision measuring instruments, and maintaining tight tolerances in a manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate honing machines to produce parts according to engineering drawings and specifications.
  • Select and install appropriate honing tools, fixtures, stones, mandrels, and other tooling required for each job.
  • Adjust machine settings, speeds, feeds, pressures, and stroke lengths to achieve required dimensions and surface finishes.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, work instructions, routers, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Verify dimensions, tolerances, bore size, roundness, straightness, and surface finish throughout the machining process.
  • Use precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, bore gauges, dial indicators, calipers, and other inspection equipment.
  • Perform first-piece and in-process inspections to ensure parts meet quality requirements.
  • Make machine and tooling adjustments as necessary to maintain dimensional accuracy.
  • Identify worn or damaged tooling and replace or adjust tooling as required.
  • Troubleshoot machining, tooling, and quality issues and make appropriate corrections.
  • Complete required production, inspection, and quality documentation accurately.
  • Maintain equipment and work areas in a clean, safe, and organized condition.
  • Perform routine preventative maintenance and basic troubleshooting on honing equipment.
  • Follow all company safety, quality, and manufacturing procedures.
  • Communicate production or quality concerns to the supervisor, lead, or appropriate department.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and delivery expectations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience setting up and operating honing machines in a precision manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Previous experience performing machine set-ups independently.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and blueprints.
  • Strong understanding of machining tolerances and surface-finish requirements.
  • Experience using precision measuring instruments, including micrometers, bore gauges, and calipers.
  • Ability to perform basic shop math, including decimals and fractions.
  • Ability to identify and correct machining or tooling issues.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal work instructions.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a manufacturing team.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment around machinery, noise, oils, and other production materials.
  • Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment.

$25hr

title: Technical Program Manager, Principal - Software Development
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Enterprise Technology (ET), where we’re developing the digital infrastructure needed to build the road to space, with an emphasis on digital capabilities required to advance Blue Origin’s mission. Enterprise Technology is the center of excellence for digital technology at Blue Origin, providing oversight and governance to align technology and business strategies.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate the release and deployment of large-scale systems to a variety of operational sites. You will manage internal and external stakeholders across engineering, supply chain, safety, operations, launch, maintenance, and corporate functions. You will be well-versed in all aspects of the systems you are responsible for, acting as a technical subject matter expert in support of cross-team collaboration efforts. You will track and report to executive audiences. As a Principal TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop plans, schedules and documentation to satisfy complex integration requirements and deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

In this role you will partner with strong technical leaders to drive the long-term vision of the organization, own delivery of cross organization initiatives, assist in developing and leading organization roadmaps, driving efficiency in processes, and delivering on goals. You understand, utilize and share program-management best practices. You may be assigned to manage the roadmap for an organization, which may include contributing to AOP narratives, and ownership of one or more organizational goals. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you are accountable to the overall strategy as well as driving teams inside and outside your organization to deliver. You can define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set goals, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. You understand the systems in your product or program space, their limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind architectural choices.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key job responsibilities:

  • Analyze product and technology service strategy and make strategic recommendations.

  • Coordinate the design, development, testing, and deployment of features into production across multiple technical teams.

  • Create and track project milestones, risks, and dependencies, and describe, own, and prioritize all technical requirements associated with delivery.

  • Dive deep to understand the design details of the systems in your area, especially those related to customer interfaces and the expectations for system dependencies.

  • Identify which existing systems or services require changes to implement new capabilities, and work with the SDM for each system to estimate the work involved.

  • Own the implementation plan across teams and report on progress against technical milestones to stakeholders.

  • Understand the significant business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions, and reasons behind decisions.

  • Demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate.

  • Be data-oriented, regularly review metrics, and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility.

  • Keep programs aligned with organizational goals.

  • Align stakeholder needs while driving mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions.

  • Partner with customers, internal/external teams, and/or engineering teams to determine which projects move forward and in what sequence.

  • Write effective narratives and program updates, and present them effectively to stakeholders and the management team.

  • Create plans with clear, measurable success criteria and return on investment, while overseeing the gap between teams, processes, and system architectures.

  • Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks.

  • Help teams and the organization reduce exposure to classic failure modes (e.g., requirements not sufficiently understood/documented, ineffective cross-team collaboration, long-term impacts from the use of third-party technologies, APIs not protected/hardened, insufficient testing/gaps in QA).

  • Apply organizational expertise, excellent communication skills, leadership skills, and a commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

​

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

  • 10+ years of technical product or program management experience working directly with software engineering and technology development teams

  • 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

  • Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Desired:

  • 5+ years of program management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

  • 3+ years of software development experience

  • Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

  • Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  • Proven track record of delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Excellent understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.

  • Experience with Confluence, JIRA

  • Experience with data analysis to capture, process, and organize data to uncover actionable insights.

At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Manager Business Analysis and Solutions
description:
Symetra has an exciting new opportunity to join us as a Manager Business Analysis and Solutions in our Benefits Division!

About the role

In this role, you will lead a team responsible for driving operational effectiveness, technology-enabled business solutions, and continuous improvement across our Group Benefits organization. This role combines people leadership, strategic planning, and business partnership to ensure processes, systems, vendors, and initiatives deliver meaningful value to the business and our customers.

You will work closely with operational leaders, technology partners, and vendors to prioritize work, optimize resources, and deliver solutions that improve performance, scalability, and customer outcomes.

What you will do

Lead and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Inspire, coach, and develop a team of Business Analysts, Configuration Analysts, and specialists.
  • Foster an inclusive, accountable, and growth-oriented culture where employees can do their best work.
  • Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business priorities.
  • Build team capabilities to support current and future organizational needs.

Drive Business Results and Operational Excellence

  • Lead business analysis, automation, and solution delivery efforts that improve operational effectiveness and customer experience.
  • Oversee work intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and execution across a portfolio of initiatives.
  • Use data, metrics, and business insights to inform decisions, improve processes, and measure outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline operations and implement continuous improvement practices.

Partner Across the Organization

  • Collaborate with business and technology leaders to align priorities, resources, and delivery plans.
  • Influence decisions and navigate competing priorities to achieve shared business objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and business partners to drive results.

Ensure Quality and Solution Effectiveness

  • Lead business requirements, testing, and user acceptance activities to ensure solutions meet business needs.
  • Promote best practices, governance, and consistency across business analysis and solution delivery processes.
  • Support the successful implementation of technology and operational changes through thoughtful planning and execution.

Manage Strategic Vendor Partnerships

  • Oversee key vendor relationships, service level performance, and issue resolution.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to evaluate vendor effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support budget management, contract oversight, and vendor governance activities.

Why Work at Symetra

“If you want to work for a company that is always considering its employees while working towards sustainable growth this is that company. Within Symetra, there is always innovation, empowerment, and growth opportunities, all while providing us with a great work/life balance and incredible benefits for a very reasonable cost!” - Cindy J. G., Sr. Product Owner

"Symetra will spoil you. There aren't many companies that will put as much effort into you being a success as Symetra. The culture will challenge you but simultaneously put you at ease. Failure is seen as integral to the learning process so there is less reason to be fearful of it." - Kerry S., Sr. Systems Analyst

What we offer you

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out our Symetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $106,400 – $177,300 plus eligibility for the company annual bonus program.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in business operations, business analysis, project management, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, coaching employees, and driving measurable business results.
  • Experience partnering across business and technology organizations to deliver complex initiatives.
  • Knowledge of user acceptance testing (UAT), operational processes, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience in Group Benefits insurance, including Short-Term Disability (STD), Long-Term Disability (LTD), Life, and Absence Management products and operations preferred.
  • An experienced people leader who is passionate about developing talent, building inclusive teams, and creating a culture of accountability and belonging.
  • A strategic thinker who can connect day-to-day execution to broader business goals and organizational priorities.
  • Skilled at influencing stakeholders, building partnerships, and leading through change in a collaborative environment.
  • Adept at balancing competing priorities, managing resources effectively, and making sound business decisions.
  • Experienced in business analysis, project leadership, operational improvement, and technology-enabled business solutions.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Professional certifications related to business analysis, project management, leadership, or process improvement are a plus.
  • Experience with Fineos and/or claims systems migrations is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred high school diploma required.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support the business.

Travel:

Required Training & Professional Development
All newly hired people leaders with direct reports are required to complete a comprehensive leadership development program within their first year. This program includes both virtual and in-person training. The in-person sessions will take place at Symetra’s corporate headquarters in Bellevue, Washington. Symetra covers all travel and accommodation expenses.

Reasonable Accommodations

We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Platform function at Perk builds the foundations that the rest of the company depends on. We own the shared infrastructure, core services, and developer tooling that enable product teams to move fast without breaking things. Our work is often behind the scenes, but its impact is everywhere: reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience.

We solve hard, systemic problems, make deliberate trade-offs, and hold ourselves accountable for the long-term health of the platform. If you care about leverage, clean abstractions, and building things other engineers actually enjoy using, you'll feel at home here.

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team and help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and tools that empower our developers to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing services. If you're an experienced Platform Engineer, or a Software Engineer with a passion for Platform and Developer Experience, we would love to speak with you.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure in AWS

  • Enable development teams to be owners of their systems and to deliver high impact products to our users

  • Partner with SRE and security teams to help developers build resilient and secure applications

  • Participate in our on-call and incident management process as part of a "you build it, you run it" mentality

Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience managing systems in AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)

  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.)

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and tools (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.)

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.)

  • Experience with containerisation and container orchestration (Docker, ECS, etc.)

  • Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Go, etc.)

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in distributed systems

  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

Advantageous but not essential:

  • Comfortable working across a mostly Linux estate, with some exposure to Windows systems and .NET applications

  • Experience with serverless architectures

  • Experience with defining advanced cloud networking setups

  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks

AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We're an equal opportunity employer, which means you're welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you're from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security (at) perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid

description:

HP IQ's Wireless Technology Team works cross-functionally with Electrical Engineering, Software, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Industrial Design, Program Management, and Operations to develop next-generation wearable and AI-connected products.

As a Lead RF Systems & Desense Engineer, you will own the RF system architecture from concept through mass production. You will lead RF integration across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB, NFC and emerging wireless technologies while driving RF desense, coexistence, and wireless performance for highly integrated products.

What You Might Do

  • Lead RF system architecture and integration for wearable and mobile platforms.
  • Own RF desense investigations and mitigation across the product lifecycle.
  • Define RF specifications, link budgets, validation plans and performance targets.
  • Lead coexistence strategy for Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB, NFC and other radios.

  • Perform CST and ADS simulations for RF front-end, coupling and matching optimization.
  • Review PCB layouts for RF routing, grounding, shielding and isolation.
  • Lead RF bring-up, characterization, tuning and root-cause analysis.
  • Drive OTA and conducted validation including TRP, TIS, sensitivity, EVM, throughput and coexistence.
  • Support FCC, CE, Wi-Fi Alliance, Bluetooth SIG, FiRa and NFC Forum certifications.
  • Mentor engineers and establish RF design guidelines and best practices. Present technical recommendations to executive leadership.

Essential Qualifications

  • 10+ years developing RF systems for high-volume consumer electronics, wearables or mobile products.
  • Expertise in RF fundamentals including impedance matching, S-parameters, link budgets, EVM, noise figure, linearity and receiver sensitivity.
  • Deep expertise in RF desense analysis and mitigation.
  • Strong knowledge of RF coexistence mechanisms and mitigation techniques.
  • Expert understanding of Wi-Fi (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be), Bluetooth Classic & LE, UWB and NFC.
  • Hands-on experience with RF front-end design including PAs, LNAs, FEMs, filters, switches and matching networks.
  • Expertise using CST Studio Suite and Keysight ADS.
  • Hands-on experience with VNA, spectrum analyzer, vector signal analyzer, signal generators and OTA chambers.
  • Strong understanding of EMI/EMC, PCB layout, grounding and shielding.

  • Python or MATLAB automation.
  • Cadence Allegro or equivalent PCB tools.
  • Experience working with Qualcomm, NXP, Broadcom or Nordic.
  • Knowledge of wearable RF architectures and compact antenna integration.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional architecture decisions.

Louisiana Bridge Builders offers a competitive salary, relocation assistance where relocation is required and approved, medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability, paid holidays, vacation, and sick time, and more.

Louisiana Bridge Builders is an equal opportunity employer.

POSITION PURPOSE/SUMMARY

The Crane Operator II (above 150 tons) is committed to supporting Louisiana Bridge Builders by operating Lattice boom cranes and/or hydraulic boom cranes as required and directed by Project Supervision.

LOCATION

This position is based in Lake Charles, LA.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Operate lattice boom or Hydraulic crane above 150 tons.
  2. Read and understand lift plans and always adhere to the lift plan.
  3. Daily inspections and complete inspection report that will be reviewed and actioned by the Crane Superintendent
  4. Candidates should be flexible if they have experience in different cranes, there may be instances where the operator will be expected to run a different crane.
  5. Perform all tasks efficiently and safely.
  6. Performing all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES, & SKILLS FOR SUCCESS

  1. Effectively communicate in a positive and professional manner through written and verbal communications in all interfaces with customers/public, fellow employees, vendors, etc.
  2. Ability to work as a team member and exert initiative to work independently to reach a goal.
  3. Ability to embrace change in the workplace while encouraging others to seek innovative approaches.
  4. Ability to function effectively as a team player and collaborator.
  5. Ability to work a flexible work schedule, including overtime, as needed, to best serve the business operations. In addition, it may include ability to work additional and/or different hours, including but not limited to nights, weekends, and/or holidays.
  6. Ability to operate other heavy equipment.
  7. Ability to operate machinery using throttles, switches, levers, etc.
  8. Ability to maintain a National Crane Certification (NCCCO or NCCER).

QUALIFICATIONS

At a minimum, the Crane Operator II (above 150 tons) must have a National Crane Certification (NCCCO or NCCER) that is good along with 5+ years of relevant crane operating Crane over 150t capacity. Experience driving concrete piles is preferred.

description:

How you will make history here...

The Training Supervisor is responsible and accountable for the design, implementation, delivery, and administration of initial and ongoing employee education. What you will do...

• Some travel may be necessary

This position will be responsible for direct supervision of 2 Training Tech's and will oversee training activity of 400+ employees. It would be great if you have... (Nice to Have)

$75,100-$103,300

title: Actuary II
description:
About the role
The Retirement Pricing team is looking for an Actuary II to support the development and pricing of new products and features across our Fixed Annuity, Fixed Indexed Annuity, and Registered Index-Linked Annuity product lines.
In this role, you will use MG-ALFA and other analytical tools to evaluate product ideas, identify key risks, and perform the pricing analysis needed to bring competitive and sustainable products to market. You will analyze competitor products to assess market positioning and identify product features or design approaches that may help mitigate risk.
You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop analytical approaches, and proactively identify the next steps needed to move projects forward.
Specific projects may include developing and enhancing MG-ALFA pricing models, establishing modeling assumptions, evaluating product profitability and risk under a range of scenarios, and partnering with stakeholders throughout the product-development process.
What you’ll do
  • Support the development and pricing of new Fixed Annuity, Fixed Indexed Annuity, and Registered Index-Linked Annuity products and features.
  • Build, maintain, and enhance MG-ALFA pricing models.
  • Develop modeling assumptions and perform profitability, sensitivity, and scenario analyses.
  • Evaluate product ideas to identify key financial, actuarial, and policyholder-behavior risks.
  • Analyze competitor products to assess market positioning and identify potential product-design or risk-mitigation opportunities.
  • Interpret modeling results and clearly communicate key findings, risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Take ownership of assigned work, develop appropriate analytical approaches, and proactively move projects forward.
  • Collaborate with Product Development and other business partners throughout the product-development process.
  • Improve pricing tools, processes, controls, and documentation.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior actuarial team members.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with a strong quantitative background, including college-level mathematics.
  • Six to nine years of relevant actuarial experience.
  • ASA designation required; may have an FSA designation.
  • Experience with actuarial pricing, product development, or financial modeling.
  • Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or enhancing models in MG-ALFA.
  • Knowledge of Fixed Annuity, Fixed Indexed Annuity, or Registered Index-Linked Annuity products is preferred.
  • Ability to analyze competitor products and translate findings into insights about market positioning, product design, and potential risk-mitigation opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of actuarial concepts, assumption development, profitability analysis, and risk assessment.
  • Ability to take ownership of your work, develop analytical approaches, and move projects forward with appropriate guidance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to interpret complex modeling results.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with actuarial and cross-functional business partners.
  • Creativity and flexibility to recommend and implement improvements to models, tools, and processes.
  • High school diploma required.

title: Supply Chain Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Supply Chain Intern to work alongside our supply chain team on impactful, project-based assignments spanning procurement, planning, production scheduling, materials management, supplier quality, supplier development, commodity management, and logistics.

You will partner with engineering, operations, quality, and mission operations to help solve real supply chain challenges tied to Saronic's growth in autonomous surface vessel production.

Responsibilities

• Support cross-functional supply chain projects spanning procurement, planning, production scheduling, materials management, supplier quality, supplier development, commodity management, and logistics

• Assist buyers and planners with purchase order creation, expediting, and supplier follow-up to help ensure on-time delivery of parts and materials

• Help build and maintain data trackers and dashboards to monitor supplier performance, on-time delivery, inventory levels, and material shortages

• Support production scheduling efforts by helping align material availability with build plans and program timelines

• Assist with supplier quality initiatives, including tracking non-conformances, corrective action requests, and supplier scorecards

• Support commodity management research, including should-cost analysis, market and spend analysis, and identifying cost-saving opportunities

• Interest in defense, aerospace, maritime, or advanced manufacturing industries

description:
Director, Solution Engineering – Solutions Validation & Customer Use CasesThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Job Description:

HPE-Juniper Networking is a leading telecommunications equipment vendor building high-performance network products for service providers, enterprises, data centers, campus, and metro customers.
The Solution Engineering organization is responsible for qualifying and validating HPE networking products and software solutions for customer deployment by developing comprehensive test strategies and executing test plans on representative topologies that accurately reflect real-world customer environments. Leveraging agile methodologies, AI-assisted engineering, automation, and innovation, the organization delivers production-grade solutions that meet the evolving requirements of customers worldwide.

The Director of Solution Engineering is a senior leadership position responsible for defining strategy, driving execution excellence, and leading teams of highly skilled engineering professionals focused on solution validation, customer use-case qualification, automation, and product readiness. This role requires a combination of exceptional technical depth, business acumen, organizational leadership, and stakeholder management. The Director serves as a trusted partner to executive leadership, architecture teams, product management, engineering development, and customer-facing organizations to influence strategy and deliver superior customer outcomes.



Key Responsibilities


Strategic Leadership and Organizational Excellence

  • Define and execute the long-term strategy for solution validation, customer use-case qualification, automation, and product readiness across multiple product portfolios.
  • Establish organizational goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational frameworks aligned with company objectives and business priorities.
  • Drive transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, release quality, predictability, and customer satisfaction
  • Build and scale high-performing teams through effective leadership, organizational planning, succession management, and talent development.
  • Create a culture focused on innovation, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

Product and Solution Delivery Leadership

  • Provide executive oversight for delivery of complex software and networking solutions spanning multiple programs, product lines, and customer segments.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, Development, Sales, and Field organizations to ensure alignment between customer requirements and solution deployment.
  • Drive strategic prioritization, resource allocation, and execution planning to meet business objectives and release commitments.
  • Ensure delivery excellence through predictable processes, quality metrics, risk management, and operational reviews.
  • Champion automation-first methodologies that improve productivity, product quality, test coverage, and scalability.

Customer and Market Leadership

  • Represent the organization in executive discussions involving strategic customers, partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer deployment environments, emerging use cases, competitive positioning, and market trends.
  • Drive customer-centric engineering practices to ensure solutions address real-world customer challenges.
  • Partner with sales, customer success, and field engineering organizations to accelerate adoption and customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Executive Collaboration

  • Partner closely with senior engineering leaders, architects, product management, business units, and executive teams to define technical and business strategies.
  • Drive alignment across multiple organizations to resolve cross-functional challenges and accelerate decision-making.
  • Lead executive reviews and communicate progress, risks, mitigation plans, and strategic recommendations.
  • Influence company-wide engineering initiatives, process improvements, and technology adoption strategies.
  • Partner with Release Management and key stakeholders to drive execution against strategic milestones, ensuring predictable delivery and successful release outcomes

Organizational and Talent Development

  • Build, mentor, and develop managers and senior technical leaders to create a sustainable leadership pipeline.
  • Create career growth frameworks that maximize employee engagement, retention, and performance.
  • Attract and recruit world-class engineering talent across technical and leadership positions.
  • Foster an inclusive and diverse workplace that encourages innovation and collaboration.
  • Drive employee recognition, coaching, and professional development programs.

Technology Leadership and Innovation

  • Provide technical leadership across networking, cloud, automation, AI-driven operations, and emerging technologies.
  • Influence future product direction by identifying strategic technology investments and innovation opportunities.
  • Promote industry participation through patents, standards contributions, certifications, technical publications, and conferences.
  • Encourage adoption of advanced automation, AI/ML, virtualization, containerization, and software-defined networking technologies.
  • Drive innovation initiatives that create measurable business value and competitive differentiation.

Business and Financial Management

  • Own budget planning, resource forecasting, and investment decisions for engineering infrastructure and tool ecosystems.
  • Optimize CAPEX and OPEX investments while maximizing return on engineering resources and test infrastructure.
  • Drive operational efficiency through strategic planning, utilization management, and infrastructure consolidation.
  • Manage organizational risks and ensure successful mitigation strategies for key business initiatives.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Proven executive leadership experience managing managers and large engineering organizations.
  • Strong strategic thinking with demonstrated success executing large-scale engineering initiatives.
  • Ability to align technology investments with business objectives and customer priorities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong customer-facing capabilities with the ability to influence business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success building high-performance engineering cultures.
  • Expertise in organizational scaling, workforce planning, and talent development.
  • Strong financial and operational management skills.
  • Outstanding problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
  • Proven ability to drive organizational transformation and innovation.
  • Deep understanding of networking technologies, architectures, and industry trends.

Technical Expertise

Strong knowledge of:

  • IP/MPLS Routing
  • EVPN-VXLAN
  • Data Center Networking
  • Cloud Networking Architectures
  • Service Provider Networks
  • Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, ISIS)
  • L2VPN, L3VPN, MPLS, Segment Routing
  • NAT, GRE, IPSec, and Security technologies
  • Automation Frameworks
  • Python, Network API Integrations
  • Containerization and Kubernetes
  • High Availability and Resiliency Architectures
  • Layer 2 Technologies (LAG, MC-LAG, Virtual Chassis)
  • CLOS and Spine-Leaf Architectures

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 18+ years of experience in networking, software engineering, or telecommunications.
  • 8+ years of leadership experience, including managing managers and large technical organizations.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex networking products, solutions, and customer use-case validations at scale, with deep experience in Solution Engineering and product readiness.
  • Deep knowledge of HPE networking products, architectures, and customer deployment models.
  • Experience working with multi-functional global engineering organizations.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering practices and tools is highly desirable.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and executive presentation skills.
  • Experience with any competitive networking platforms
  • Industry certifications such as JNCIE, JNCIP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
