title: Executive Director, Research – Integrative Sciences — Cardiovascular
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



About Integrative Sciences

Integrative Sciences is the external innovation engine of BMS Research. The group identifies and shapes collaborations with biotech, academic, platform, and venture partners that complement internal Discovery and Early Development priorities. Integrative Sciences connects Research strategy with external opportunity flow, working closely with Business Development, Global Alliance Management, Thematic Research Centers, and Therapeutic Area leadership to convert promising science into decision-ready, industry-workable collaborations. The group is expected to source strategically, triage rigorously, shape executable collaboration plans, manage scientific relationships effectively, and ensure external innovation strengthens the BMS pipeline and the broader Research operating system.


Position Summary

The Executive Director is a senior leader within Integrative Sciences focused on cardiovascular external innovation, and serves as a key interface across Global Research, Early Development, Business Development, Alliance Management, and external collaboration partners. The role is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and advancing high-value external scientific opportunities, collaborations, and assets in cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases.


The role requires particular attention to the interaction between cardiovascular and cardiometabolic disease, and to opportunities that span both.

Where appropriate the Executive Director will participate in Site Leadership teams.


Where appropriate, the Executive Director may serve as a Board Observer, or in other relevant governance roles, for external cardiovascular companies on behalf of BMS.


This position sits within the BMS Research organization and reports to the U.S. Head of Integrative Sciences. Travel is approximately 30%, domestic and international. The preferred location is Cambridge, MA (CMX); remote arrangements will be considered on a case-by-case basis.


Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Opportunity Triage

  • Communicate internal Cardiovascular Research pipeline priorities to the Integrative Sciences group, and align external search, evaluation, and triage activities with BMS Research principles and the Enterprise Cardiovascular Therapeutic Area strategy.
  • Lead the Cardiovascular triage process within Integrative Sciences, ensuring disciplined, criteria-driven evaluation of external opportunities.
  • Identify, evaluate, and bring forward cardiovascular opportunities — academic collaborations, biotech partnerships, platform technologies, and pre-IND or IND-stage assets — that add to or complement the internal pipeline.
  • Form and lead cross-functional diligence teams for the evaluation of Integrative Sciences collaboration opportunities, and provide expert scientific opinion during Business Development reviews and due diligence.
  • Partner with Search & Evaluation and Business Development transaction leads to advance prioritized opportunities on disciplined, accelerated timelines.
  • Work with Research Finance to ensure activities are aligned, captured, and approved within Research budgets.

Collaboration Design and Execution

  • Contribute to the design and execution of a blended external innovation strategy spanning corporate and academic collaborations.
  • Shape opportunities into practical collaboration plans with clear scientific objectives, work plans, milestones, governance structures, decision points, and success measures.
  • Advise on collaboration structures and contract development as the scientific lead, working closely with Business Development, transaction leads, Legal, and IP.

Governance, Representation, and Communication

  • Serve on joint governance committees and oversight bodies established to coordinate agreed research plans with academic and industry partners, ensuring collaborations remain scientifically focused and operationally accountable.
  • Represent Integrative Sciences, as appropriate, to other BMS organizations, regulatory agencies, investors, partners, and the broader scientific community.
  • Communicate regularly to internal client and partner groups — and their leadership — on external research activities and progress.
  • Compose progress reports and decision documentation for senior management, and deliver presentations and briefings on the scientific and organizational activities within the area of responsibility.

Leadership

  • Model scientific leadership, collaborative behavior, and an enterprise mindset across Research and Integrative Sciences, consistent with BMS values.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD or equivalent advanced scientific training in cardiovascular biology, cardiometabolic disease, or a related discipline relevant to cardiovascular medicine.
  • 10+ years of drug discovery and/or early development experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with deep, hands-on expertise in cardiovascular and cardiometabolic disease.
  • Strong understanding of cardiovascular and cardiometabolic disease biology, including the interaction between the two, with the ability to assess external opportunities against BMS Research priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate external scientific opportunities, including academic collaborations, biotech partnerships, platform technologies, and pre-IND or IND-stage assets.
  • Experience shaping external collaboration plans — scientific objectives, work plans, milestones, governance structures, decision points, and success measures — and negotiating them with external partners.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to represent Cardiovascular external innovation and the broader Integrative Sciences mission to internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Track record of advancing therapeutic programs toward IND stage or beyond, with knowledge of the scientific, translational, and operational requirements for decision-ready programs.
  • Experience working across Research, Early Development, Business Development, Alliance Management, Legal, IP, Finance, Thematic Research Centers, and Therapeutic Area leadership — or equivalent cross-functional structures — to support disciplined opportunity triage and execution.
  • Strong capability in building productive relationships, setting clear expectations, and keeping collaboration structures scientifically focused and operationally accountable.
  • Understanding of the financial, legal, contractual, and geographic considerations that affect external research collaborations, including non-U.S. partnerships.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure Ecosystem (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps)
  • Experience with Entity Framework Core or backend performance optimization
  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, front-end performance monitoring, or testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright)
  • Prior experience in the EdTech sector
  • 30 days' holiday per year (inclusive of UK bank holidays)

ABOUT WORDWALL

Wordwall empowers educators to create interactive, customisable teaching materials in minutes - turning static lessons into dynamic, student-centred learning experiences. We're flipping the script on traditional educational publishing by putting powerful creation tools directly into teachers' hands. Our platform fuels a bottom-up content ecosystem - scalable, shareable, and deeply attuned to real classroom needs - powered by a global community of educators. With millions of active users, strong organic traction, and a product that’s beloved by teachers worldwide, Wordwall is entering an exciting new chapter.

We're focused on building upon an already great product and increasing our impact and reach in key markets like the U.S. and Europe, deepening engagement with our paid user base, and driving innovation through emerging technologies such as AI. We're a lean, mission-driven, remote team building for long-term impact - and we're looking for sharp, strategic technical thinkers to help us scale both our product and our purpose.

title: Engineer, Principal
description:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

Agentic Software Development Engineer — Agentic Platform and Enterprise Workflow Automation

About the Role

As a Agentic Software Development Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade agentic AI systems that bring autonomous multi-step reasoning to complex, tool-heavy workflows. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and deep domain expertise — partnering closely with subject matter experts to decompose workflows, define knowledge schemas, and deliver agents that are reliable enough for production use by engineers who depend on them daily.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will define the standards that let teams scale in parallel, own the architecture end-to-end, and be the person other engineers come to when the problem is hard.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Architecture and Platform Onboarding

  • Design and implement LangGraph-based agent graphs for multi-step, tool-heavy workflows; own the decomposition of existing automation scripts and workflow descriptions into structured agent phases, HITL gates, and MCP tool interfaces
  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool wrappers that connect agents to enterprise data sources and domain-specific tooling; own retry logic, auth integration, format-version handling, and failure modes
  • Define design pattern archetypes that cover the majority of workflow types, enabling engineering pairs to agentize independently and in parallel using a shared playbook

Knowledge Systems and RAG

  • Design ontology schemas (OWL/RDF or equivalent) that capture domain-specific facts — signals, decisions, constraints, and validated outcomes — to ground LLM reasoning in verified knowledge rather than inference
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines and vector stores over domain documentation; own ingest, chunking strategy, embedding model selection, retrieval quality evaluation, and refresh automation
  • Drive the strategy for what facts belong in a structured ontology versus a RAG index versus a prompt

Evaluation and Regression

  • Build evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic agent outputs: golden dataset curation process, semantic correctness scoring, CI triggers on agent code changes, and regression gates on LLM model version updates
  • Own the quality bar: define what "correct" means for each agent, build the harness that measures it, and establish the process for expanding coverage as agents reach production

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the discovery phase: pair with domain experts to understand complex workflows end-to-end before any code is written; produce skill/task maps, EDA tool interaction catalogs, and archetype classifications that unblock parallel engineering work
  • Define and enforce standards: agent scaffold templates, ontology schema templates, dummy stage patterns, and co-design SOPs that let HW+SW pairs work independently without reinventing structure
  • Mentor engineers; review agent designs; drive architecture decisions for the agentic layer

Requirements

Experience

  • 10+ years in software engineering with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems in production
  • Demonstrated experience building agentic or multi-step LLM systems beyond demo/prototype scale: agents that run in production, handle failures gracefully, and are tested against real domain inputs
  • Experience working in a co-design model with non-engineering domain experts (scientists, analysts, domain specialists) — you can translate between domain knowledge and software architecture

Technical Stack

  • Python (strong): async, type annotations, production-quality code
  • LangGraph or equivalent graph-based agent framework; experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) or equivalent tool-serving pattern
  • Vector databases: Chroma, Milvus, pgvector, or similar; experience with embedding pipelines
  • Knowledge graphs or ontologies: OWL/RDF, SPARQL, or equivalent structured knowledge systems
  • CI/CD for AI systems: pytest, golden dataset frameworks, regression on non-deterministic outputs

Highly valued

  • Experience with workflow orchestration engines (Temporal, Airflow, or equivalent durable execution platforms)
  • Familiarity with enterprise API integration patterns: OAuth, rate limiting, retry strategies, auth token management
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs, including domain-expert-in-the-loop curation processes
  • Fine-tuning experience on domain-specific data

Education

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science or Engineering required
  • Master's with ML or Systems specialization preferred

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Data Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will own the data architecture across the company, setting the standards, patterns, and technology choices our engineers build on as we scale the platform. Your influence spans the full data stack: streaming telemetry off GPU compute and cooling systems, the data lake feeding hardware failure prediction models, the AI-native layers powering agent-based workflows, and the governance layer that keeps it all secure, discoverable, and compliant. You will be one of the most senior technical voices for data at Firmus: you make the architecture decisions the organisation lives with long-term, and you stay hands-on on the problems that are too complex or too consequential to delegate.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Architecture & Technology Strategy

Own the data architecture across Firmus: the patterns, technology choices, and technical standards that teams build on. Make the build-versus-buy, storage-topology, and streaming-versus-batch decisions the organisation lives with long-term and own the outcomes they lead to.

  • Platform Build & Operations

Build the core of the data platform hands-on: the real-time and AI data pipelines, the storage layer, and the transformation and semantic layers that serve BI tooling, internal analytics, and customer-facing reporting. Collaborate with the data engineers and platform engineers to deliver and operate streaming and batch ingestion from GPU telemetry, cooling sensors, billing, and incident sources, with clear reliability, schema-evolution, and latency SLAs. Data components run as infrastructure-as-code on the self-hosted, bare-metal Kubernetes. You own their deployment, quality, and storage cost, and work with platform engineers on backup, recovery, and incident response.

  • Governance, Quality & Compliance

Define and enforce data contracts, lineage, and access control across teams. Set organisation-wide data quality and observability standards: schema contract enforcement, freshness SLAs, and anomaly detection. Extend Firmus' existing SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls to the data platform as it scales into new data centres and meet the regulatory requirements that apply to our enterprise and government customers.

  • Technical Leadership

Raise the standard of data engineering in Firmus. Run design and architecture reviews, drive the RFC process, and catch architectural problems before they reach production. Mentor engineers on data architecture, data quality, and operational practice, building capability rather than a dependency on you.

  • Stakeholder & Customer Interface

Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to the CTO and engineering leadership, direct about risks and clear about recommendations. Partner with the AI and application team so the architecture supports AI agent workflows and hardware failure prediction. Engage enterprise and government customers on architecture, lineage, or compliance when the conversation needs a senior technical voice.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 5 years making platform-level decisions that other teams depended on. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way.
  • You have been the most senior data engineer or architect in an organisation before, owning the architecture rather than contributing to it.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of end-to-end data architecture: ingestion, storage patterns, transformation, semantic layer design, observability, and governance.
  • Track record designing large-scale data platforms that integrate data across multiple regions or data centres.
  • Production experience operating high-cardinality time-series and telemetry pipelines at high ingest and update rates.
  • Production experience across columnar, time-series, relational, object, and vector storage patterns. You know when to use each one and what it costs to operate.
  • Hands-on experience with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka for extremely high-throughput, low-latency ingestion.
  • Hands-on experience with both managed data platforms (such as Databricks or Snowflake) and their self-hosted, open-source equivalents (such as Spark, Trino, ClickHouse, and lake house table formats like Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.
  • Experience with pipeline orchestration and transformation tooling such as Airflow and dbt, with data quality testing built into standard pipeline development.
  • Kubernetes experience covering Helm-based deployments and operation of stateful data workloads on self-hosted, bare-metal infrastructure.
  • Experience delivering data governance programmes against compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001, not just awareness of them.
  • Experience running architectural reviews and setting engineering standards across teams.
  • Willing to take part in the incident-response on-call rotation for the services your team owns.
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. You can explain a complex architectural decision to a CTO or customer without losing the substance.

Preferred Experiences:

  • Background in AI infrastructure, GPU cloud, or high-performance compute, particularly working with infrastructure telemetry data at scale.
  • Experience with industrial IoT and OT telemetry pipelines.
  • Production experience with vector databases and embedding or retrieval pipelines for LLM and AI-agent use cases such as failure prediction and incident response.

Location: Singapore

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Assembly Supervisor
description:
Viper Northwest, Inc. is a precision, quick response, build-to-print manufacturing organization, making precision fabricated and machined parts and assemblies for satisfied customers since 1985.

Viper Northwest has a tenured staff of highly skilled manufacturing and technical professionals who manufacture capital equipment and OEM components for a variety of high-tech industries. We also provide engineering design assistance and verification, as well as drafting services and we are looking for skilled individuals to join our team!

We offer:

  • A Highly competitive total compensation package
  • Medical (3 medical plans to choose from)
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life (Free Provided, options for supplemental on top)
  • Disability Insurance (STD and LTD provided by the company for free)
  • 401(k) with company match,
  • A generous paid time off schedule
  • Discretionary quarterly bonus program.

Assembly Supervisor Job Summary:

  • Provide direction, guidance, and feedback to department personnel to achieve maximum output and efficiency.
  • Currently Hiring for a Day Shift (M-F 6am-330pm)
  • This position requires previous electromechanical assembly experience,
  • Preferred experience in GD&T and general manufacturing knowledge.
  • Takes direct supervision and direction from the plant manager.

Job Duties:

Equipment Maintenance:

  • Troubleshoot machine issues. (Laser, electropolish, assembly testing equipment.)
  • Ensure machine maintenance including regular service, and schedule for machine repairs.
  • Ensure general assembly staff has all tooling needed and kept in good working order.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Assign work to employees and work centers.
  • Maintain continuity among work shifts and departments by documenting and communicating actions, irregularities, and continuing needs.
  • Review schedule progress daily to ensure due dates are met.
  • Manage department employee performance through training, regular performance feedback and goal setting and tracking.
  • Ensure department compliance with all safety rules, regulations, and requirements.

Assembly Processes & Operations:

  • Provide on-time delivery of completed parts without compromising quality, safety, and equipment life.
  • Communicate department capabilities and estimated completion times to Quoting and Engineering.
  • Envision mechanical processes, product processes, and operations while completing prototyping and short-run, close tolerance complex parts for industrial robotics, automation, electronics, and wafer processing in a quick turn job shop environment.

Verification of Product:

  • Monitor and protects the assets of the company and ensure that appropriate tooling and equipment is used for each job.
  • Adhere to all quality policies and meets company quality goals of on-time delivery of completed parts without compromising quality, safety or equipment life.

What competencies you bring:

Builds and Leads Effective Teams: Strategically identifies talent based on business needs and objectives; hires the best people from inside and outside. Creates strong morale and spirit in the team where all staff are motivated to do their best; shares wins and successes; fosters open dialogue; let’s people finish and be responsible for their work; defines success in terms of the whole team; creates a feeling of belonging in the team. Sets clear, meaningful, challenging, and attainable group goals and expectations that are aligned with those of the organization. Sees the potential in others and takes opportunities to apply and develop that potential through goal setting, identifying resources and measuring success; provides encouragement and ongoing feedback to help others strengthen specific knowledge/skill areas needed to accomplish a goal, task, solve problem.

Directing Others / Managing & Measuring Work: Is good at establishing clear directions; sets stretch objectives; distributes the workload appropriately; lays out work in a well-planned and organized manner; maintains open dialogue with others on work and results.

Coaching & Training: Guides others in goal setting, identifying resources and measuring success; provides encouragement and ongoing feedback to help others strengthen specific knowledge/skill areas needed to accomplish a goal, task, solve problem.

Motivating Others: Creates a climate in which people want to do their best; can motivate any kinds of direct reports and team or project members; empowers others; invites input from each person and shares ownership and visibility; makes each individual feel his/her work is important; is someone people like working for or with.

Composure / Stress Tolerance: Maintains stable performance under pressure or opposition (such as time pressure or job ambiguity); maintains composure and control over behavior; does not become defensive or irritated when faced with challenges; can be counted on to hold things together during tough times; is not knocked off balance by the unexpected; doesn’t show frustration when resisted or blocked; is a settling influence in a crisis; handles stress in a manner that is acceptable to others and the organization.

Strategic Agility: Sees ahead clearly; can anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; has broad knowledge and perspective; is future oriented; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihoods; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans. Monitors incoming and forecasted workload and plans adequately to support the output needs of the business.

Cultural Leadership: Not only demonstrates key actions associated with the Viper Northwest’s values but inspires others to do so as well through modeling, communication and holding others equally accountable to these standards.

Safety: Follows safe work practices ensuring compliance with Viper safety policy and procedures. Assists others in working safely. Recognizes and reports real or possible safety hazards.

The experience you have:

Education: High School diploma or GED required. Associate degree or Trade School Certificate in a related discipline preferred.

Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, develop and interface with staff members.

Computer Skills: Basic computer skills with the ability to operate MS Windows environment, using email for communication. Usage of data collection software and ERP system is required.

Language Skills: Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical data, schematics, prints and travelers is required. Effective interpersonal communication skills through a variety of methods are required.

Mathematical Skills: Proficiency with intermediate level math skills is necessary, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and some trigonometry.

Reasoning Skills: Requires the ability to define complex problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. The ability to interpret a wide range of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form is an on-going requirement.

Physical Demands: Position requires frequent walking, bending, stooping, handling, fingering, and reaching. Occasional kneeling, climbing, and squatting required. Ability to lift and pull up to 15 pounds continuously and from 15 to 15 pounds frequently, 25 to 50 pounds occasionally.

Work Environment: The work environment for this position is that of an industrial machine shop/production facility. Employees may experience loud noises, at varying levels, throughout the workday. Available to travel when needed.

title: Safety Investigative Engineer
description:
At Ford, we’re defining the future of human mobility with a strong focus on corporate responsibility. If you share this commitment, join the diverse team of passionate professionals within our Sustainability, Environment & Safety group. You’ll be a key contributor to our efforts to provide the technical and regulatory expertise necessary for advancing such critical initiatives as product safety, emissions, fuel economy, vehicle recycling and much more.

In this position...

Safety Investigations Engineer supporting either the Automotive Safety Office's Pre-Investigation Review (PIR) team or Vehicle Hardware Critical Concern Review Group (CCRG).

What you'll do...

This position supports Ford’s product safety investigations process, within either the newly established Pre-Investigation Review (PIR) team or existing Vehicle Hardware Critical Concern Review Group (CCRG), in evaluation of issues which may present a potential safety defect or regulatory non-compliance.

You'll have...

In the Pre-Investigation Review (PIR) team, you’ll help determine if an issue should be further reviewed by Ford’s Critical Concern Review Group, Environmental Problem Review Committee, or Customer Satisfaction Forum, based on effect on vehicle occupants and other road users, potential compliance considerations, occurrence considerations, and other factors.
• In the Vehicle Hardware Critical Concern Review Group (CCRG), you’ll help support investigatory efforts seeking to evaluate concerns which present a potential safety defect or regulatory non-compliance related to hardware systems in Ford’s products.
• Lead collaborative interactions with many Ford organizations including Product Development (PD), Ford Customer Service Division, Supplier Technical Assistance, Manufacturing, Office of General Counsel (OGC) in the evaluation and resolution of potential issues.
• Develop broad range of contacts across the company and leverage in support of timely root cause ownership identification and support.
• Work with other organizations to develop and request special tests, field surveys, etc., to help assess the necessary facts in the evaluation of potential safety and compliance issues.
• Prepare presentations and reports, including engineering analysis and the coordination of special vehicle/component demonstrations, to be used in both technical and non-technical discussions with all levels of leadership.
• Create & maintain investigation documentation in accordance with document retention guidelines and submit regulatory documentation as necessary.
• Maintain trackers, dashboards, and status reports across multiple concurrent safety-defect and compliance investigations.

Even better, you may have...

Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering preferred.
• 1+ year of experience in engineering, quality, or project management.
• Strong strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving skills.
• High level of interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse, cross-functional organizations and global teams.
• Effective oral communication and strong technical writing skills.
• Ability to interface effectively with all levels of management.
• Strong working knowledge of vehicle systems.
• Experience in Design & Release and/or Manufacturing is preferred.

Even better, you may have...
• A strong understanding of automotive OEM product development lifecycles and manufacturing processes (Ford-specific experience is a plus, but not required).
• Strong working knowledge of Ford product development and manufacturing processes, and database systems (GSAR, etc).
• Experience providing technical assistance to legal teams, participating in legal investigations, or drafting regulatory documentation.
You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage.

description:

LBB will also be responsible for the reconstruction of interstate highway, various structures, ramps, and approaches for a 5.5 mile stretch between I-210 West End and Ryan Street.

Louisiana Bridge Builders offers a competitive salary, relocation assistance where relocation is required and approved, medical, dental, vision, life, short- and long-term disability, paid holidays, vacation, and sick time, and more.

Louisiana Bridge Builders is an equal opportunity employer.


POSITION PURPOSE/SUMMARY

The Bulldozer Operator II is committed to supporting Louisiana Bridge Builders by operating heavy machinery to push earth and materials to grade land or clear areas for the Project.

LOCATION

This position is based in Lake Charles, LA.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Operate machinery to complete tasks such as grading, leveling, clearing debris, digging trenches, and pushing materials.

  7. Performing all other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES, & SKILLS FOR SUCCESS

  1. Effectively communicate in a positive and professional manner through written and verbal communications in all interfaces with customers/public, fellow employees, vendors, etc.

  3. Ability to work as a team member and exert initiative to work independently to reach a goal.
  4. Ability to embrace change in the workplace while encouraging others to seek innovative approaches.
  5. Ability to function effectively as a team player and collaborator.
  6. Ability to work a flexible work schedule, including overtime, as needed, to best serve the business operations. In addition, may include ability to work additional and/or different hours, including but not limited to nights, weekends, and/or holidays.

QUALIFICATIONS

At a minimum, the Bulldozer Operator II must have 3+ years of relevant, proven, experience operating construction equipment. National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) Certification is preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Select one the following for the each of the items listed below:

title: QA Tech - Quality Assurance - PM Shift
description:
Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Swanson, and V8.

Your attention to detail and commitment to food safety, quality standards, and regulatory compliance will support operational excellence and help deliver products that meet customer and company expectations.

Take product temperatures and weights and accurately document results.

Verify dates, times, and coding on packaged products and maintain required records.

Conduct pre-operational inspections in accordance with established procedures.

Monitor and document the operation of X-ray and Metal Detector systems.

Ensure HACCP, GMP, food safety, and sanitation requirements are consistently followed.

Verify production areas are maintained according to company, regulatory, and food safety standards.

Monitor product handling, packaging, time controls, and temperature requirements.

Audit incoming raw materials for freshness, quality, and specification compliance.

Verify products meet recipe and formulation specifications.

Compile reports, maintain records, and organize quality documentation.

Follow all workplace safety policies and procedures.

Support continuous improvement efforts and perform other duties as assigned.

Quality Assurance Team Members

Production Associates

Production Supervisors and Team Leaders

Food Safety and Regulatory Compliance Teams

Warehouse and Receiving Personnel

Maintenance and Sanitation Teams

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Excellent verbal communication skills.

Basic math skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

Ability to use a calculator and complete quality-related measurements and calculations.

Basic knowledge of food safety principles.

Ability to follow GMPs, HACCP requirements, quality standards, and safety procedures.

Ability to stand for extended periods and work throughout production environments.

Experience conducting inspections, audits, testing, or compliance activities.

Familiarity with HACCP programs, GMPs, USDA regulations, or food manufacturing standards.

Experience working with metal detectors, X-ray systems, or other quality monitoring equipment.

Bilingual skills, particularly Spanish.

Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting.

Hearing protection is required in designated work areas.

Fast-paced environment requiring close attention to food safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

Documentation & Procedures

Safety Rules and GMP Compliance

Attendance and Training Records

Production Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

HACCP and Food Safety Requirements

Quality Inspection and Testing Documentation

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Requirements

title: Stamping Press Team Leader - 3rd Shift
description:
P
Position Summary
Lead daily stamping operations on assigned transfer and progressive presses. Coordinate people, material, die changeovers, startup checks and production priorities to meet schedule while maintaining safety, part quality and accurate production records. Work alongside operators and support teams, coach to standard work and promptly escalate conditions that cannot be corrected within the Team Leader’s authority.
Essential Responsibilities
Safety and Work Area Control

Start each shift by reviewing staffing, equipment status, open safety concerns and work area readiness; assign work only to associates trained for the task.
Verify guards, light curtains, interlocks, safety blocks and other required protections are in place and functioning. Stop and escalate unsafe operation; never bypass safeguards.
Ensure associates follow lockout/tagout, die handling, crane and forklift rules, PPE requirements and approved procedures for jams, misfeeds and die access. Perform restricted tasks only when trained and authorized.
Maintain 5S and TPM checks; address hazards, spills, scrap handling and material flow concerns promptly. Report incidents and near misses.

Press Operations and Changeovers

Assign operators and balance coverage across presses based on the production schedule, skill levels and staffing; communicate shortages and risks to the Group Leader.
Coordinate external changeover preparation, including the next die, coil or blanks, containers, setup instructions, gauges and required support. Assist qualified personnel during changeover without assuming unauthorized setup or maintenance work.
Confirm the correct material, part number, revision, routing and setup documentation before startup. Ensure first piece approval is completed under the applicable procedure before production proceeds.
Monitor progressive press operations for feed and coil conditions, straightener and feeder issues, strip progression, scrap removal, part ejection and in die sensor alarms.
Monitor transfer press operations for blank presentation, transfer timing and alignment, gripper or finger condition, part travel, lubrication, discharge and scrap removal. Stop and escalate abnormalities.
Respond to idle presses, misfeeds, die protection alarms and repeated downtime. Secure the condition, call tooling or maintenance as needed, and document the cause and action taken.
Review actual output against the plan and hourly production board. Address controllable losses and communicate schedule risks early.

Quality and Traceability

Verify operators perform first and last piece, in process and visual checks at the required frequency using approved gauges and instructions. Audit completed checks throughout the shift.
Confirm part identification, lot and material traceability, container quantities and labels before product leaves the area.
Stop production and segregate suspect product when defects, damaged tooling, material mix ups or process deviations are found. Initiate required containment and notify Quality and the Group Leader.
Document and communicate temporary process changes through the approved authorization process; never release suspect product independently.

Team Leadership and Communication

Confirm attendance, assign work, train and coach associates on standard work, quality checks and safe press practices; identify skill gaps and recommend training.
Provide timely feedback and report performance or conduct concerns to the Group Leader and HR under company procedures. Participate in evaluations or corrective action as assigned.
Keep production, scrap, downtime, checklists and work orders complete and accurate in ShopEdge and other required systems.
Coordinate with Tooling, Maintenance, Quality, Materials and the next shift on open issues, die status, containment, priorities and required follow up.
Lead practical improvement efforts using TQPS principles; help associates identify recurring losses and test approved countermeasures.

Qualifications

High school diploma or GED required; further technical or manufacturing education preferred.
At least two years of stamping press experience with transfer or progressive dies required; experience with both preferred. Previous team leadership or demonstrated ability to coach others preferred.
Ability to read work instructions, setup sheets and production schedules; use calipers, micrometers and applicable gauges; and recognize part and process abnormalities.
Working knowledge of press safety, die protection, material handling, quality containment and basic troubleshooting.
Ability to communicate clearly across shifts, use basic computer applications and production systems, and perform practical math for quantities, rates and scrap.
Crane, forklift, die handling or lockout/tagout qualifications required only for duties assigned and performed after company training and authorization.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements
Work is primarily on the manufacturing floor near operating presses, moving equipment and material handling activity. The role requires prolonged standing and walking, bending, reaching and handling parts or tools. May lift up to 50 pounds with appropriate assistance or equipment when required. Hearing protection, safety glasses and other assigned PPE are required. Shift, overtime and schedule flexibility may be needed based on production requirements. Essential functions may be performed with reasonable accommodation.

description:
Why this role matters
As Flywire scales a multi-product software platform across verticals, regions, and buyer types, software pricing and contracting become some of the most powerful levers for growth, consistency, and long-term value creation.
The Director of Pricing & Commercial Growth drives Flywire’s software pricing strategy and commercial frameworks across verticals. This role ensures we win deals while capturing the full value of what we deliver, balancing growth acceleration with margin discipline and scalability.


This is a senior commercial leadership role. It helps to set direction, defines guardrails, and shapes how value is captured across the business.


What this role exists to do
Own Flywire’s global software pricing, packaging, and contracting strategy, translating product value and market insight into scalable commercial models. Partner closely with Corporate Strategy/BizOps and transactional/payex pricing teams to ensure a cohesive, value-driven monetization approach across software and payments.


Key Responsibilities
Pricing & Packaging Strategy

  • Own Flywire’s software pricing and packaging strategy across products, verticals, and customer segments
  • Design value-based pricing models, bundles, and offers aligned to customer outcomes and willingness to pay
  • Define pricing frameworks including list prices, floors, guardrails, and discount thresholds by product and segment
  • Partner with Strategy/BizOps, Product and Product Marketing, Sales to align pricing with roadmap decisions, positioning, and launches
  • Lead pricing strategy for new software products, expansions, and major commercial initiatives

Contracting & Deal Structure

  • Own commercial deal structures and contracting strategy in close partnership with Legal
  • Develop standard contract templates and commercial terms that cover the majority of deals and accelerate deal velocity
  • Establish deal governance that balances Sales flexibility with margin protection and long-term portfolio value
  • Provide oversight on complex, high-value, or non-standard enterprise deals

Value Growth & Governance

  • Drive ACV/average deal size growth, price realization, and margin uplift through disciplined pricing execution
  • Establish discount discipline and approval frameworks that scale
  • Define and monitor pricing KPIs including ACV, margin, price realization, deal velocity, and exception rates
  • Use win/loss and deal data to continuously refine pricing and packaging strategies

Customer, Market & Data Insight

  • Lead pricing-specific customer and market research, including quantitative pricing studies when appropriate
  • Analyze usage, deal, and market data to identify pricing opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs
  • Translate insight into clear recommendations and decision points for executive leadership

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, and Product Marketing to operationalize pricing strategy
  • Present pricing recommendations, scenarios, and tradeoffs to senior leadership and the executive team
  • Partner closely with FP&A & Corporate Strategy/BizOps to align pricing with long-term growth and portfolio strategy
  • Work in tight collaboration with transactional/payment pricing teams to align software pricing with payment economics

title: Medewerker Internationale Vergunningen & Transportdocumentatie
description:
Bouw mee aan de groei van een internationale organisatie

Bij Aerinnova werken we dagelijks aan een efficiënte en toekomstbestendige productieomgeving waarin techniek en duurzaamheid hand in hand gaan. Onze recyclingactiviteiten worden steeds verder uitgebreid en dat vraagt om een sterke organisatie achter de schermen. Daarom breiden we onze organisatie uit met een medewerker Internationale Vergunningen & transportdocumentatie

Als medewerker Internationale Vergunningen & transportdocumentatie zorg jij ervoor dat onze internationale transportstromen administratief en juridisch vlekkeloos verlopen. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de diverse Europese recycling-locaties, klanten, onze commerciële-, operationele- en logistieke afdeling en de bevoegde autoriteiten van alle betrokken landen. Je verdiept je en houdt overzicht over complexe wet- en regelgeving (EVOA), creëert structuur in de documentstromen en zorgt ervoor dat alle dossiers correct, volledig en tijdig zijn goedgekeurd.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen, indienen en proactief opvolgen van internationale kennisgevingen

  • Je werkt dagelijks met gespecialiseerde systemen zoals DIWASS (EU) en IWS (UK) en ondersteunt bij de implementatie en optimalisatie hiervan.

  • Je verzamelt, controleert en beheert alle benodigde documentatie voor de afval- en grondstoffenketen.

  • Je bewaakt scherp de deadlines en de voortgang van de lopende dossiers.

  • Je onderhoudt het contact met bevoegde autoriteiten, klanten, partners en interne afdelingen zoals commercie, logistiek en operatie.

  • Je signaleert wijzigingen in de wet- en regelgeving en past deze correct toe binnen de organisatie.

  • Je structureert en verbetert het documentbeheer door actief in te zetten op digitalisering en automatisering.

  • Je rapporteert over de voortgang, signaleert knelpunten en draagt oplossingen en verbeteringen aan.

Wat maakt deze rol uitdagend?

  • Je krijgt veel vrijheid om administratieve en digitale processen slimmer, efficiënter en toekomstbestendig te maken.

  • Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het compliant en soepel laten verlopen van de internationale groei van VHB.

  • Je schakelt dagelijks met verschillende afdelingen en uiteenlopende externe internationale stakeholders.

  • Je denkt actief mee over innovatie, digitalisering en de optimalisatie van onze systemen.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij Aerinnova onderdeel van VHB Groep krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal familiebedrijf dat volop in ontwikkeling is. We waarderen initiatief, geven verantwoordelijkheid en bieden ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een afwisselende werkplek met Amsterdam als standplaats, waarbij je twee dagen per week vanuit onze locatie in Gameren werkt.

  • Een salaris van € 2.900, - tot € 3.500, bruto per 4 weken, gebaseerd op een 40-urige werkweek.

  • Een jaarcontract met de intentie om dit bij wederzijdse tevredenheid om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

  • Een laptop en mobiele telefoon van de zaak.

  • 31 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • Deelname aan de basispensioenregeling via BPL, waarbij VHB 70% van de pensioenpremie betaalt.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen via de NRC Academy.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

Wat zoeken we?

Jij bent nauwkeurig, georganiseerd en houdt overzicht. Je werkt graag gestructureerd, schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende partijen en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+ of hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in een administratieve, logistieke, compliance- of coördinerende functie.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, bent analytisch en weet goed prioriteiten te stellen.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Engels. Daarnaast heb je een goede basis van de Nederlandse taal, zodat je ook met Nederlandse collega's en instanties kunt communiceren.

  • Je bent digitaal vaardig en denkt graag mee over procesverbeteringen

title: Physical Design Engineer
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Canada ULC

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive communication and data processing transformation, helping create a smarter, more connected future for all.


Qualcomm is seeking talented Physical Design Engineers to join our growing SoC and ASIC Design organization. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute across a variety of projects spanning high-performance computing, AI, mobile, automotive, data center, and next-generation semiconductor technologies. Engineers in this role may work on different aspects of Physical Design ASIC and SoC development, including floorplan, Clock Tree Synthesis, low power implementation, timing analysis, design methodology, automation and enabling new technology nodes.


This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced engineering team developing leading-edge products on advanced process technologies while collaborating with world-class design, verification, implementation, and physical design teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and drive all stages of the physical design flow from synthesized netlist to tape-out.
  • Develop and implement physical design solutions for complex, high-speed, and low-power ASICs and SoCs.
  • Perform floorplanning, partitioning, power planning, and IR-drop analysis.
  • Execute placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, timing optimization, and timing closure across Multi-Mode Multi-Corner (MMMC) scenarios.
  • Analyze and resolve timing violations, signal integrity issues, crosstalk effects, and physical design rule violations.
  • Perform RC extraction, physical verification, and formal verification activities.
  • Implement engineering change orders (ECOs) and support design convergence through sign-off.
  • Collaborate with architecture, RTL, DFT, verification, and methodology teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Contribute to the development of innovative low-power implementation methodologies and customized place-and-route solutions.
  • Develop automation and productivity tools using scripting languages and software development techniques.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 2-10+ years of industry experience or relevant academic/project experience in Physical Design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
  • ASIC/SoC Physical Design implementation.
  • Place and Route using Cadence Innovus and/or Synopsys Fusion Compiler.
  • Static Timing Analysis and timing closure using Synopsys PrimeTime SI.
  • Physical verification and design sign-off methodologies.
  • Formal verification techniques and tools.
  • Power domain implementation and low-power design methodologies.
  • Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), routing, and timing optimization.
  • Low power implementation techniques experience
  • Signal integrity, noise analysis, and MMMC sign-off flows.
  • DFT-aware physical implementation and constraint management.
  • Programming and automation using Python, Perl, TCL, Shell scripting, C/C++, and Linux/Unix environments.
  • Perl/Tcl, Python skills are needed.
  • Strong problem solving and ASIC development/debugging skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: Specialist II, General Ledger
description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Copeland is a global provider of sustainable climate solutions, creating efficient residential, commercial, and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. By joining us as a General Ledger Accountant, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial records. You will be responsible for performing bank and balance sheet reconciliations, fixed asset accounting, and ensuring compliance with internal controls.

  • Perform bank reconciliation to protect the organization's assets and verify the accuracy of cash transactions.
  • Reconcile and analyze balance sheet accounts, ensuring accuracy through vouching for source details and resolving discrepancies.
  • Generate reports and perform account analysis to resolve mis-recordings before the finalization of financial statements.
  • Collaborate with various partners for critical financial deliverables and maintain an audit trail of supporting documents.
  • Handle Fixed Asset Accounting, including asset recognition, depreciation, transfer, retirement, and write-off.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), as well as Corporate Policies and Procedures (CP&P).
  • Decisions are made through standard operating procedure.

Who You Are:

You take ownership of your work and ensure accountability by consistently producing accurate and timely financial reconciliations (Ensures Accountability). You are adept at analyzing financial transactions and identifying discrepancies before recommending solutions (Manages Complexity). You effectively collaborate across teams, fostering strong partnerships to meet critical financial deliverables (Interpersonal Savvy). You maintain a high level of attention to detail and ensure that processes are followed thoroughly (Action-Oriented).

Required Education, Experience, & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or any Accounting-related field.

  • Strong knowledge of internal controls and GAAP.
  • Proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) applications, including Oracle and SAP.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

Apply now and be part of our team!

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

title: Staff Mixed-Signal Digital Design Engineer - Cork, Ireland
description:
Company:

General Summary:

Job Description

Qualcomm Mixed-Signal IP (MSIP) Digital Design team is looking for experienced and talented digital design engineers to help designing the next generation of high-performance and low-power mixed-signal IPs. The MSIP digital design team consists of architects, ASIC designers, protocol experts, digital signal processing engineers, and algorithm designers who are driving the definition and realization of IPs for next-generation of Qualcomm’s products targeted for mobile, compute, automotive, and AI applications.

This role requires prior work experience in ASIC digital design flow, including micro-architecture definition, RTL coding, front-end implementation, as well as collaboration with DV and PD teams for verification and physical implementation of the design.


Responsibilities:

  • Architecture, design, and implementation of digital sections of mixed-signal IPs (SerDes, DDR, PLL, DAC, ADC, Sensors, etc.)

  • Apply computer architecture, digital signal processing (DSP), and optimization techniques for improving power, performance, and area (PPA) of IPs

  • Run full suite of ASIC design tools (lint checking, CDC, DFT, synthesis, FV, STA, etc.) to validate and implement the design

  • Work with design verification (DV) team to define test plans, verify the design, and fix bugs

  • Work with physical design (PD) team for physical implementation of the design

  • Create design specifications and documentations

  • Work with testing team for silicon bring-up and debug


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in ASIC digital design, including micro-architecture and RTL design

  • Experience working with various front-end ASIC tools such as Design Compiler, Fusion Compiler, Modelsim, VCS, Spyglass, and primetime.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to contribute strongly within a high-performance team

Highly Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in low-power digital design

  • Experience in computer architecture, digital signal processing, and algorithm design

  • Experience in scripting languages (Python, Perl)

  • Experience with at least one mixed-signal IP, such as SerDes (USB, PCIe, MIPI, UFS), DDR PHY, Timing circuitries (PLL, DLL, FLL), Data Convertors (DAC, ADC), or sensors

Cork has a proud reputation as Ireland's second largest economic engine and is now one of the Top 20 location choices in Europe with 39,000 people being employed by over 170 overseas companies.
There's a growing diversity in the region with people from many nationalities relocating to Cork, relishing the opportunity to work and live in a location that offers an excellent quality of life.

Role Overview

As a Machine Learning / AI Engineering Intern, you will help build best-in-class solutions and tools that enable state-of-the-art technologies for next-generation mobile and embedded machine learning platforms. These platforms power smartphones, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and IoT devices. You’ll work in a dynamic research environment as part of a multi-disciplinary team of researchers and software developers, collaborating with internal teams, working with popular neural network frameworks, and gaining exposure to Qualcomm’s SOC compute and ML hardware accelerators. Projects may also focus on AI systems infrastructure, distributed inference platforms, compiler technologies, runtime systems, GPU acceleration, model serving, performance optimization, and large-scale deployment of machine learning workloads. You will design, develop, and test software for machine learning tools and frameworks that make models smaller and more efficient for edge devices.

This internship supports the Machine Learning/ AI Engineering track. Based on your resume you will be aligned to projects within this track.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. degree program in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field

  • Must be available for 11–14 weeks during Summer 2027 (May–September)

  • Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, TFLite, PyTorch

  • Skills in neural network programming, video/image processing, and application development

  • Knowledge of compiler frameworks (LLVM, GCC, TVM, XLA) and parallel computing

  • Experience with AI infrastructure, inference systems, distributed computing, runtime systems, GPU programming, CUDA, Kubernetes, MLIR, or performance optimization of machine learning workloads.

  • Understanding of linear algebra operations and fast math libraries

  • Theoretical knowledge of ML, deep learning, model compression, quantization, and optimization

  • Experience with reinforcement learning, neural architecture search, kernel optimization, Bayesian optimization

  • Familiarity with on-device training, transfer learning, personalization, federated learning, NLP, and ML security/privacy

  • Experience with deep generative models, audio/speech processing, NLP, computer vision, and wireless communication

  • Background in ML data pipelines, data management, backend/frontend applications

  • Experience in object-oriented software design (OOSD)

Our interns join world-class teams to help define and build what is next for mobility and the world. You’ll be paired with a mentor with visibility to your project and team, receive support from your manager, and have access to the entire Qualcomm employee community to ensure your success. To round out your summer internship, we host professional development workshops, social events, cross-functional speaker sessions, and an executive speaker series. title: Senior People Analytics Specialist (Workday)
description:
The Opportunity

Flywire is seeking a highly skilled Senior People Analytics Specialist (Workday) to strengthen the People team's ability to make timely trusted data-informed decisions. This role will own the design, development, maintenance and continuous improvement of People reporting and analytics within Workday.

You will partner closely with People leaders, People Operations, People Technology, Finance and Business Intelligence teams to translate business questions into scalable reporting solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong Workday reporting professional who is equally comfortable working with stakeholders, improving data quality and turning complex workforce data into clear actionable insights.

What you will do

  • Design, build, test and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards and data extracts that support People, Finance, executive and board-level reporting needs.
  • Translate stakeholder needs into clear reporting requirements, including metrics definitions, data sources, security considerations, delivery cadence and expected business outcomes.
  • Develop advanced Workday reporting solutions using Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, composite reports, matrix reports and related Workday capabilities.
  • Partner with People Technology and Workday implementation stakeholders to support a successful post-go-live reporting model, including prioritisation and delivery of critical People reports.
  • Establish trusted consistent definitions for core workforce metrics such as headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, organisational structure and talent outcomes.
  • Validate report logic and data accuracy, investigate discrepancies and resolve issues through disciplined testing and root-cause analysis.
  • Build and maintain documentation covering reports, metrics, data sources, business logic and operating procedures.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence and data teams when advanced analytics, cross-functional data sets, automation or enterprise-level insights are required beyond native Workday reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual reporting, improve self-service access to data and strengthen the overall People analytics experience.
  • Support reporting governance by ensuring appropriate data security, confidentiality, access controls and adherence to applicable privacy requirements.
  • Provide guidance and enablement to People team stakeholders on how to interpret and use reports effectively.

Here's what we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in People Analytics, HRIS, Workforce Analytics or a related analytical role.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building and maintaining reports in Workday, including advanced and matrix reports, calculated fields and composite reporting.
  • Experience with Workday Dashboards and Discovery Boards, along with Worksheets.
  • Strong knowledge of Workday HCM data structures, business processes, security domains and reporting best practice.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation and data analysis.
  • Experience transforming ambiguous business questions into practical scalable reporting solutions.
  • Strong analytical judgement and attention to detail, with the ability to validate data accuracy before communicating findings.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and insights clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, People Operations, HR Technology and/or Business Intelligence teams.
  • A strong commitment to data privacy, confidentiality and responsible handling of employee information.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving global environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Workday implementation, stabilisation period or major Workday reporting transformation.
  • Experience with workforce planning, organisational analytics, talent analytics or executive People reporting.
  • Knowledge of Workday EIB, Orchestrator, Studio and Extend.
  • Experience with Prism Analytics.
  • Workday Reporting or a related certification is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with BI and visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar platforms.
  • Experience with data querying, data modelling or integrating HR data with enterprise data sources.
  • Experience working in a global matrixed organisation.

Technologies we use

  • Workday HCM and Workday Reporting
  • Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets
  • Business intelligence and visualisation tools
  • Jira and collaboration tools, including Slack and Google Workspace

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Competitive time off, including Digital Disconnect and FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in.
  • Flying Start - Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs & Global Teams)
  • Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
  • Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
  • Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
  • Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)

Submit today and get started!

We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

title: TikTok LIVE Producer (Freelance)
description:
about somerce.

Somerce is a full-service TikTok Shop agency working with 100+ global brands across shop operations, live, content, affiliates and ads, with over £5m GMV under management. We hold the world record for the biggest single TikTok Shop live, $2.7m with P.Louise. We are now building agentic AI into how the whole agency runs.

why this role exists.

LIVE is one of the biggest sales channels we run, and our schedule is growing every month. Every stream is measured on GMV per hour, and what happens behind the camera decides a lot of that number.

Our hosts are at their best when they can focus on selling. That needs a producer running the stream around them: the right product at the right time, offers landing on cue, and someone watching the numbers and changing the plan as they move. We're building a bench of freelance producers who can do exactly that.

Requirements

what you'll do.

  • Run the LIVE studio from set-up to pack down for some of our biggest brands.
  • Run the stream in real time: pinned products, flash deals, vouchers and comment moderation.
  • Work closely with our hosts, including talent from LiveHost, our presenter platform.
  • Track performance live and change the plan when the numbers say so.
  • Send a short post-LIVE debrief covering GMV, what worked and what to change next time.

what we're looking for.

  • Hands-on TikTok LIVE production experience, ideally on TikTok Shop.
  • Confident with TikTok LIVE Studio and Seller Center.
  • A cool head on long streams and a commercial eye for what sells.
  • Available for a mix of daytime, evening and weekend shifts.
  • Able to work from our London or Manchester studios.

title: Regional Echo Liaison (REL) - Arizona
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Are you passionate about advancing cardiovascular care and improving patient outcomes? Join our field medical team as a Regional Echo Liaison, where you’ll play a critical role in bridging clinical science and real-world practice.

In this role, you will engage directly with healthcare professionals and thought leaders, providing scientific expertise and education in echocardiography—particularly in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). Your work will help ensure the safe and effective use of therapies while delivering valuable insights from the field to inform broader medical strategy. You’ll be part of a team committed to innovation, collaboration, and improving patient outcomes. We offer a supportive and high-performing environment where your expertise is valued, your voice is heard, and your work makes a meaningful impact across the healthcare community.

  • Lead peer-to-peer scientific discussions focused on the safe and appropriate use of therapies
  • Gather and communicate field-based insights on disease state, clinical practice, and patient management
  • Translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, actionable insights for echocardiography and sonography professionals
  • Serve as a trusted scientific resource within the healthcare community
  • Align field activities with medical strategy and evolving stakeholder needs

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

Additional Requirements

You will support critical permitting and compliance activities, with a particular focus on air quality regulations, reporting, and operational requirements. The position combines environmental expertise with process improvement, data management, automation, and cross-functional collaboration. Your work will help strengthen compliance systems, improve audit readiness, and support safe and efficient operations.   • Partner with Operations and O&M teams to embed environmental compliance into daily activities and longer-term operational planning.

  • Develop guidance, training materials, playbooks, and best practices that help operational teams consistently execute environmental compliance requirements.
