title: Software Engineer, Internship
description:
A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations around the world use data. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll have an opportunity to grow more quickly than you ever envisioned, as you contribute high-quality code directly to Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, or Palantir Apollo: products that are deployed at some of the most important institutions across the public and private sectors. You'll create features used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world. Palantir's Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers, each focusing on a specific aspect of a product. For example, you might join a team that builds a Foundry front-end application, or a component of the Gotham release infrastructure. We encourage communication and collaboration among teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different aspects of each product.

Core Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer, you are involved throughout the product lifecycle - from idea generation, design, and prototyping to execution and shipping while also being paired with a mentor dedicated to your growth and success. You'll collaborate closely with technical and non-technical counterparts to understand our customers' problems and build products that tackle them. One of the most effective ways to understand what our users need is to meet them. You may receive an opportunity to tour the assembly line at an auto-manufacturer or join a counter-terror analyst at their desk to really understand their mission and difficulties.

SWE principles include:

  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers and Product Reliability Engineers. We also partner with our business development teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategists) in order to understand and solve our customers' problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities, and don't micromanage. We want people to have the space to think for themselves, while feeling supported by their team.

Technologies We Use

  • Varying languages, including Java and Go for backend and Typescript for frontend
  • Open-source technologies like Cassandra, Spark, Elasticsearch, React, and Redux
  • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Webpack, and GitHub

What We Value

  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members.
  • Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.

What We Require

  • Engineering background in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, and Physics.
  • Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Experience coding in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Must be planning on graduating in 2027. This should be your final internship before graduating.

Palantir is particularly interested in applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and we encourage Singapore citizens to apply.

Salary

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $8,500 SGD/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Life at Palantir

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

title: Engineer, Staff
description:
Company:

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

About the Role

Qualcomm is seeking an experienced engineer to own and lead the design, development, and deployment of rack management software for AI accelerator products in data center environments. This role spans provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, and lifecycle management across heterogeneous hardware and software stacks, with an emphasis on building secure, reliable, and resilient software that operates close to hardware and at scale.

The ideal candidate will apply secure‑by‑design principles to distributed infrastructure systems, helping define security patterns and system behavior, focusing on strong isolation, controlled access, and predictable behavior in complex, multi‑tenant data center environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure software for rack‑scale and distributed environments.

  • Lead development of high‑performance, security‑critical services, making informed tradeoffs across concurrency, fault tolerance, isolation, and system reliability.

  • Define and evolve secure control‑plane designs, including APIs and automation for provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

  • Establish and drive security design patterns and best practices for multi‑tenant infrastructure, including isolation, access control, and resource governance.

  • Collaborate across software, hardware, firmware, and platform teams to ensure cohesive system behavior and end‑to‑end security properties.

  • Lead or participate in architecture reviews, threat modeling, and design discussions for complex, cross‑team systems.

  • Design and implement observability strategies (telemetry, logging, tracing) to support operational reliability and security visibility at scale.

  • Contribute to technical direction, documentation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure and security practices across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience building infrastructure, platform, or distributed systems, including systems operating at scale or close to hardware.

  • Demonstrated experience owning technical design or architecture for complex software systems, including making and documenting significant design tradeoffs.

  • Strong proficiency in Python or Go; experience with C++ or other systems‑level languages is a plus.

  • Experience building or securing control‑plane services, internal platforms, or developer‑facing infrastructure APIs.

  • Practical experience designing for secure, multi‑tenant environments, including authentication, authorization, isolation, and resource controls.

  • Hands‑on experience with Linux‑based systems and containerized environments; familiarity with Kubernetes security mechanisms (e.g., RBAC, network policies) preferred.

  • Experience applying secure software development practices, such as threat modeling, design reviews, security testing, and incident analysis.

  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews, documentation, and technical leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

  • OR Master’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

  • OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

  • 2+ years of work experience with one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, or similar.

References to a particular number of years of experience are for indicative purposes only. Candidates with equivalent experience will be considered if they demonstrate the ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possess the required competencies.

title: DevOps Engineer London, United Kingdom
description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role

As a DevOps CI/CD Engineer, you’ll work on the build and CI/CD systems that enable Wayve’s engineering teams to develop, test, and release software efficiently and reliably.

You’ll help make our pipelines faster, more scalable, more secure, and easier for engineers to use. You’ll work closely with software engineers across the business to understand workflow pain points, troubleshoot complex build and pipeline issues, and deliver infrastructure and tooling improvements that have a direct impact on engineering productivity.

This is a hands-on engineering role with opportunities to deepen your expertise across CI/CD infrastructure, build systems, developer experience, automation, and operational best practices.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and build infrastructure across development, testing, and release workflows.
  • Improve build performance, reliability, and scalability, including caching, dependency management, incremental builds, and reproducible builds.
  • Develop tooling and automation that improves developer workflows and reduces build and test feedback times.
  • Operate and scale CI infrastructure, including build agents, runners, artifact storage, and supporting services.
  • Monitor, investigate, and troubleshoot build and pipeline failures, working with engineering teams to identify root causes and implement long-term fixes.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Wayve’s CI/CD architecture, security, and operational practices as engineering workloads scale.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve developer experience and support efficient software delivery.
  • Take part in a team on-call rotation, providing out-of-hours support for critical systems when required.

Essential skills

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, build engineering, CI/CD, developer infrastructure, platform engineering, or a related engineering role.
  • Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or significantly improving CI/CD pipelines and automation systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, Azure DevOps, or similar.
  • Experience with build tooling and concepts such as dependency management, caching, incremental builds, artifact management, and reproducible builds.
  • Strong experience working with Linux, Git, and shell scripting. Programming or scripting experience using Python, Bash, Go, or similar.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, especially in complex build, pipeline, or infrastructure environments.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams to improve developer workflows.

Desirable skills

  • Experience operating CI infrastructure at scale, including runners, agents, distributed build systems, or self-hosted CI environments.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code.
  • Exposure to security best practices in CI/CD environments, including secrets management, dependency security, and pipeline hardening.
  • Experience improving developer experience or internal platform tooling.
  • Experience supporting software delivery in complex engineering environments, such as robotics, autonomous systems, machine learning, or large-scale software platforms.

title: HR Representative
description:

Purpose of Position: The Human Resources Representative provides administrative and operational support for the Human Resources Department. This position assists with benefits, HRIS maintenance, compliance activities, employee engagement initiatives, recruitment, special projects, and serves as the designated backup for payroll processing. The HR Representative acts as a resource for employees and managers by providing accurate information, exceptional customer service, and timely support while maintaining confidentiality and compliance with applicable employment laws.

  • Training Coordination: Coordinate employee training activities by scheduling classes, maintaining training records, tracking completion status, preparing reports, and assisting with compliance-related training requirements and documentation.

title: AVP Collections
location: Headquarters North, Santa Ana, CA, US
description:
At Orange County’s Federal Credit Union (OCFCU), banking is personal—and it always has been. For more than 87 years, we’ve built genuine relationships, provided trusted guidance, and put people before transactions to help our members achieve life’s most important milestones.

Today, with more than $3 billion in assets and 145,000+ members, we continue to grow while staying true to the values that have made us one of Orange County’s most respected financial institutions. We’ve been named #1 Credit Union by the Orange County Register for several years and most recently in 2024 & 2025. We’re also honored with workplace satisfaction—driven directly by employee voices. When you join OCFCU, you’re joining a workplace where people genuinely enjoy showing up and feel empowered to do meaningful, impactful work every day.

As the AVP Collections you'll lead the overall function and strategy, with accountability for the health and performance of the delinquency portfolio. The role develops and executes strategies designed to minimize credit losses, improve delinquency, charge-off and recovery performance, and maximize member retention and goodwill. It also provides strategic leadership to the Assistant Manager and the collections team, while overseeing collection practices, loss mitigation, recoveries, repossessions, bankruptcies, foreclosures, loan modifications, commercial collections and related third-party relationships.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Owns the overall health and performance of the Credit Union’s delinquency and collections portfolio, including monitoring delinquency trends, roll rates, charge-offs, recoveries, repossessions, cure rates and other key portfolio indicators.
  • Analyzes portfolio and member data to identify trends, emerging risks, opportunities and treatment effectiveness and translates findings into actionable collection strategies.
  • Uses account segmentation, risk tiers and member data to optimize cross-channel collection treatments, including automation, digital outreach, outbound calls, inbound interactions and other appropriate human interventions.
  • Continuously evaluates collection treatment effectiveness and refines segmentation, workflows, channels, timing and strategies to improve contact rates, cure rates, recoveries and member outcomes.
  • Directly manages and develops the Assistant Manager, Collections and provides leadership, coaching and accountability for the seven collectors.
  • Oversees daily collections operations through the Assistant Manager, including workload management, staffing, productivity, quality, training, coaching, cross-training and adherence to policies and procedures.
  • Ensures effective management of payment arrangements, promise-to-pay commitments, delinquent loans, negative shares, hardships, credit card delinquency and charge-offs.
  • Provides oversight of repossessions, deficiency balances, bankruptcies, foreclosures, loan modifications and other complex or high-risk collection matters.
  • Oversees commercial collections and develops appropriate strategies for commercial delinquency and recovery.
  • Determines or approves accounts for charge-off in accordance with Credit Union policy and ensures timely placement, recovery and reporting of charged-off accounts.
  • Evaluates, selects, manages and monitors third-party collection agencies, legal counsel, skip-trace vendors, repossession companies and other collection-related service providers.
  • Establishes performance expectations and service standards for third-party vendors, evaluates results and takes corrective action when performance, compliance or contractual requirements are not met.
  • Maintains effective relationships with collection agencies and legal counsel and consults on bankruptcy, foreclosure, litigation and other legal collection matters.
  • Represents the Credit Union in relationships with repossession companies and oversees the recovery and liquidation process, including appropriate auction and floor-limit decisions.
  • Prepares, reviews and maintains accurate delinquency, charge-off, recovery and portfolio reports for the Board of Directors, senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Provides senior management with timely analysis of loan portfolio trends, collection performance, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
  • Prepares and manages the Collections budget, reviews invoices and controls expenses within Credit Union guidelines.
  • Selects, hires, develops, motivates and coaches associates; promotes cross-training, knowledge transfer and succession planning.
  • Evaluates associate performance through timely reviews and recommends promotions, salary adjustments and corrective actions, including termination, as appropriate.


Experience / Training / Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Lending, Accounting or a related field, or equivalent knowledge and experience.
  • Seven years of progressively responsible experience in collections, loan servicing, lending operations, recoveries or a related financial institution environment.
  • Three - five years of supervisory or management experience, preferably with responsibility for collections, recoveries or delinquency portfolio management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing delinquency, charge-offs, recoveries, repossessions, bankruptcy, foreclosure and loss mitigation activities.
  • Experience using portfolio data, account segmentation and analytics to develop or improve collection strategies.
  • Experience managing third-party collection agencies, legal counsel, skip-trace vendors, repossession companies or other collection service providers.
  • Experience in customer relations, problem resolution and error correction.


What We Offer

  • A People-First Culture: We lead with empathy and authenticity.
  • Comprehensive Benefits:
    • Anthem HMO/PPO, Delta Dental, and Unum options – from day one!
    • 401(k) with up to 6% employer match
    • Annual discretionary bonus
    • Annual merit increase
    • Educational grants up to $1,000
    • 18 vacation days/year (increases to 21 after 5 years)
    • 7 sick days/year + paid holidays
  • Final offers based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity. The range for the AVP Collections role is $125,761 - $157,200 annually.


Orange County's Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pre-employment screenings, including background and credit checks, are required.

title: Pavement Inspector - Mid
description:
Overview

description:

description:

  • Fluency in English (essential) - Turkish language skills are preferred and will significantly strengthen your impact in this role
  • Proficiency in SAP, Blackline and Workiva experience a bonus
  • The leadership presence to engage confidently with boards, regulators, and global finance teams alike
  • A customer-first mindset, strong analytical instincts, and the drive to hold yourself - and others - to the highest standards

Based in Chester. Leading across borders.

This role is based at BMS's Chester, UK office, with travel to Turkey as the role requires. Chester is a well-connected, vibrant location and the perfect home base for a truly international finance leadership role.

Your market is waiting for a leader. That could be you.

If you're a senior finance professional with the expertise, the ambition, and the regional knowledge to lead financial operations across Turkey we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and bring your financial leadership to a company with a mission that matters.

title: Azure DevOps Deployment Consultant
description:
Location: Home / Milton Keynes (on site 2 days a week)

We are looking to recruit an Azure DevOps Deployment Consultant to join an established technology team on an initial 1 month contract with chances for extensions.

This is a hands‑on role focused on reviewing, improving and troubleshooting an existing Azure DevOps CI/CD environment, while also supporting and upskilling the internal development team.

This is not a Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure-focused DevOps role. The environment uses Azure DevOps tooling alongside predominantly on‑premise Windows/IIS application hosting, so we are looking for someone with strong application deployment and release management experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and identify performance, reliability and configuration issues.
  • Improve and optimise build, release and deployment pipelines.
  • Support application deployments from Azure DevOps into predominantly on‑premise Windows Server/IIS environments.
  • Troubleshoot failed or slow builds and deployments.
  • Review existing code analysis and quality‑checking processes, including SonarQube.
  • Investigate performance issues within SonarQube and its integration with deployment pipelines.
  • Improve automation across build, test, release and deployment processes.
  • Work closely with development teams to improve deployment practices and release reliability.
  • Provide hands‑on coaching, knowledge transfer and technical guidance to the existing team.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation, deployment procedures and runbooks.

Experience Required

  • Strong hands‑on experience with Azure DevOps.
  • Good knowledge of Azure Pipelines, YAML pipelines and release management.
  • Experience deploying applications into on‑premise Windows Server and IIS environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, application build and deployment processes.
  • Experience troubleshooting and improving existing deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with SonarQube would be highly desirable, although experience with similar static code analysis or code quality tools will also be considered.
  • PowerShell or similar scripting and automation experience would be beneficial.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work closely with developers and upskill internal teams.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked across hybrid environments, combining Azure DevOps tooling with traditional on‑premise application infrastructure rather than purely cloud‑native DevOps environments.

title: Lead, Enterprise AI FinOps
location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Incorporated

Job Area:

Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Management

General Summary:

The Enterprise AI FinOps Lead establishes and operates the financial governance discipline for company-wide AI usage. This role owns cost visibility, show-back, optimization, budgeting, forecasting, and stakeholder engagement across a multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), SaaS, and on-premise AI landscape.

This is not a traditional cloud cost role. It requires deep understanding of AI-specific cost drivers—models, tokens, prompts, agents, embeddings, context windows, RAG systems, and adoption behavior—and the ability to translate telemetry into actionable insights, optimization programs, and executive reporting.

The role also owns full budget management for the Enterprise AI department.

This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).

**This role is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.**

Key Responsibilities

1. Build & Operate the AI FinOps Function

  • Establish the AI-FinOps operating model: visibility, cost accountability, show-back, optimization cadences, and leadership reporting.

  • Define processes, metrics, and governance mechanisms that manage costs while enabling adoption.

2. AI Cost Visibility & Intelligence

  • Own end-to-end usage visibility across all cloud, on-premise, internal, and SaaS AI platforms.

  • Identify major cost drivers and flag areas where cost growth outpaces value delivery.

3. Show-Back & Chargeback Readiness

  • Design and implement show-back methodology with transparent allocation rules for shared platforms, model gateways, agent platforms, RAG systems, and SaaS AI.

  • Deliver monthly/quarterly show-back packages to business unit and functional leaders.

4. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Management

  • Own AI cost forecasting and budget planning based on usage trends, adoption growth, model pricing, and optimization initiatives.

  • Manage departmental budget: planning, tracking, accruals, purchase planning, and vendor cost visibility.

  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Cloud FinOps, Legal, and platform owners to ensure financial discipline.

5. Optimization & Cost Reduction

  • Identify and drive cost reduction opportunities without compromising business value or adoption.

  • Lead recurring reviews with high-consuming teams to eliminate waste and promote efficient usage.

6. Executive Reporting & Leadership Engagement

  • Produce executive-ready AI cost/usage reporting for CIO, Finance, IT, and business unit leaders.

  • Develop narratives around cost growth, business value, adoption health, and efficiency gains.

  • Define KPIs that distinguish healthy adoption from uncontrolled consumption.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in FinOps, cloud cost management, technology finance, IT financial management, or enterprise analytics.

  • Proven experience managing budgets, forecasts, financial reporting, and cost optimization programs.

  • Strong understanding of cloud cost models (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

  • Ability to analyze large-scale usage data and deliver actionable business insights.

  • Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders, finance partners, and technical teams.

  • Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and recurring operating reviews.

  • Excellent executive communication skills (written and verbal).

  • Ability to operate independently and develop operating models and business processes from the ground up.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI/GenAI/LLM platforms, token-based pricing, or AI platform operations.

  • Familiarity with tokens, embeddings, RAG, agents, context windows, model routing, prompt optimization, and inference workloads.

  • Multi-cloud cost management experience.

  • On-premise infrastructure cost allocation experience.

  • Cross-functional partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal, Contracts, and Engineering.

  • Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, SQL, Python, or similar tools.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A practical operator who sits at the intersection of AI platforms, finance, data, and enterprise leadership—equally comfortable analyzing raw usage data and presenting cost trends to senior executives. Treats FinOps not as cost-cutting, but as enabling responsible AI adoption with visibility, accountability, and efficiency.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 7+ years of IT-related work experience with a Bachelor's degree.
OR
9+ years of IT-related work experience without a Bachelor’s degree.

• 4+ years in a leadership role in projects/programs.

title: Technician, Field
description:
Are you looking to grow your career with one of the largest crane and heavy equipment distributors in the West and part of the largest Manitowoc and Grove dealer in the world? We are looking for skilled Crane Field Technicians to join our team! We offer highly competitive wages, benefits, and factory training to increase your knowledge.

Pay Range: $31 to $50 depending on experience.

Our highly skilled crane technicians are responsible for the maintenance and repairs of complex crane and heavy equipment with limited or no supervision in a safe, and professional manner. Critical functions include:

  • Maintenance and repair of complex mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems on a variety of company owned and customer’s equipment while using a high degree of independent judgment.
  • Providing service documentation
  • Training of lower level technicians
  • Demonstrating of equipment for customer use.
  • Use schematics and diagrams to provide repairs on AT Crane
  • Ensure compliance in all safety, health, and environmental regulations, policies and procedures for a goal of zero incidents and injuries.
  • Communicate consistently on all activities to appropriate individuals (internal & external).
  • Maintain ongoing communication and adhere to all Companywide policies to eliminate and/or reduce exposure to liability.
  • Participates as needed in special projects or work as assigned.
  • Maintain and repair Rough Terrain Cranes.
  • Maintain and repair Crawler Cranes.
  • Provide certified crane inspections.

Qualifications Guidelines

Experience/Training/Education:

Required: High School or equivalent, 3+ years of experience with Hydraulic, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining preferable Grove, National, Manitou and Manitowoc Cranes. GMK Training. Willingness to travel with some overnights. A valid driver’s license.

Desired: Highly developed mechanical and electrical troubleshooting background, particularly with an emphasis on cranes, extensive knowledge of crane equipment, an advanced understanding of schematics and diagrams on German made AT Cranes, own the tools applicable to position, and exhibit strong teamwork, verbal, and written skills. Factory training certifications a plus. GMK/AT crane factory training.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Hydraulic experience read and understand schematics
  • Electrical experience read and understand schematics ( Can-Bus systems)
  • Willingness to travel at will throughout assigned region when called upon.
  • Willingness to work at various heights. Safety minded/oriented.
  • Detail Oriented
  • Skilled in the use of Microsoft Office products and computer diagnostic system experience ( Cummins, MTU, Yanmar)

Physical and Environmental Elements:

This is a field service classification and employees work in a factory environment or in the field with exposure to noise and machinery and weather. Accurate hand/eye coordination is required. Finger dexterity is required, as well as hand strength, with the ability to grasp, lift, push and pull; access, enter and retrieve data using a computer keyboard, typewriter keyboard or calculator and to operate standard office equipment Work involves considerable standing, walking, climbing, crawling, driving, reading, seeing, hearing, speaking, concentrating, communicating, stooping, bending, or sitting for long periods of time. May lift parts weighing up to 50 pounds and have exposure to working at heights. Potential for travel in other locations around the country. Ability to work overtime is a must.

Special Requirements/Certification:

Factory training on crawler cranes, hydraulic rough terrain and truck cranes.

description:

Central Valley, NY - Woodbury Commons

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.

About the team:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.

About the role:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.

What you’ll do:

Customer Experience (90%)

  • Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

  • Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

  • Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

  • Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

  • Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance

title: Director Analyst - Semiconductor Foundry and Advanced Packaging
description:
About This Role

Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interactions. You will meet with clients every day, whether by phone, videoconference, on stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.

As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow.

You will own the quantitative and market-intelligence view of global foundry and advanced packaging capacity, technology transitions, and economics, and translate manufacturing constraints into implications for semiconductor supply and competitive strategy.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain market forecasts for global foundry capacity, wafer demand, utilization, revenue, and market share.
  • Track leading-edge and mature-node capacity across TSMC, Samsung, Intel Foundry, GlobalFoundries, UMC, SMIC, and other relevant suppliers.
  • Analyze process-node migration, fab expansions, capex, utilization, pricing, and customer allocation.
  • Maintain market intelligence on advanced packaging, including 2.5D/3D integration, CoWoS-class packaging, chiplets, hybrid bonding, fan-out, and advanced substrates.
  • Quantify packaging capacity, throughput, utilization, supplier share, and technology migration.
  • Track the interaction between foundry, HBM, substrates, OSAT/test, and advanced packaging constraints.
  • Analyze how AI accelerators, custom ASICs, CPUs, GPUs, and other high-performance devices translate into wafer and packaging demand.
  • Monitor customer/supplier relationships, capacity commitments, geographic expansion, and semiconductor localization strategies.
  • Maintain quarterly trackers, forecasts, supplier databases, and scenario models.
  • Identify emerging capacity bottlenecks and assess their implications for availability, pricing, and competitive positioning.
  • Support client inquiries and produce differentiated research for VP, market-intelligence, and strategic audiences.
  • Collaborate with analysts covering AI accelerators, memory, semiconductor equipment, interconnect, and infrastructure economics.
  • Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and informal knowledge-sharing sessions.

What You Will Need

Educational Qualifications

  • BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, Semiconductors, or Software Engineering.
  • Graduate + MBA in Marketing or Operations from leading A and B-schools is desirable.

Work Experience

  • 10-12+ years of experience in semiconductor foundry, advanced packaging, manufacturing strategy, market intelligence, product planning, or industry research.

Domain Knowledge / Business Acumen

  • Strong knowledge of semiconductor process technology, capacity planning, and advanced packaging.
  • Understanding of foundry economics, yield, utilization, node migration, and customer allocation.
  • Experience building quantitative market models and forecasts.
  • Familiarity with TSMC, Samsung, Intel Foundry, GlobalFoundries, UMC, SMIC, ASE, Amkor, and other major ecosystem participants.
  • Strong ability to connect manufacturing detail with market, competitive, and financial implications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to challenge prevailing industry assumptions using evidence and quantitative analysis.
  • Awareness of major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor, and electronics industries affecting software technologies and the competitive landscape, with an eagerness to learn more.

MS Office Tools

  • Ability to design, develop, and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting.
  • Strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools, including Word and PowerPoint, for writing and presenting analysis.

Project Management Skills

  • Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule, resolve issues, and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.

Communication Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
  • Written: Strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts, and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
  • Oral: Ability to converse by telephone, face-to-face, and on stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.

Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and providing insightful and original analysis.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients, with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
  • Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must.
  • Ability to represent Gartner research, methodologies, and strategies at multiple levels, including Board, C-Level, Business Unit, and Operational.
  • Ability to engage with multiple client organization types, including End User Clients, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, and Channel Partners.
  • Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, and coach and develop colleagues where required.
  • Ability to provide constructive feedback to peers and remain receptive to feedback from others.
  • Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity, intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and willingness to follow internal processes and policies, including HR, IT, and Finance.

Core Quantitative Coverage

You are capable of modeling and forecasting:

Foundry

  • Wafer starts / wafer-equivalent capacity
  • Capacity and utilization by supplier and node
  • Node migration
  • Customer demand by device/application
  • Foundry revenue and market share
  • Capex and fab additions
  • Pricing and wafer economics
  • Constrained versus available capacity

Advanced Packaging

  • Package volumes and capacity
  • Package type and technology mix
  • CoWoS/2.5D/3D-equivalent throughput
  • HBM stacks/package
  • Substrate and interposer demand
  • OSAT versus foundry/IDM share
  • Packaging ASPs and revenue
  • Capacity expansion and utilization

Research Boundaries

This role owns the manufacturing-market and quantitative view of foundry and advanced packaging.

It does not own:

  • GPU/CPU/ASIC competitive strategy
  • HBM/DRAM market forecasts
  • Semiconductor equipment markets
  • End-to-end AI infrastructure strategy

However, the analyst must quantify how these adjacent markets translate into wafer, node, and packaging demand.


Who You Are

To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as THE experts. This means that:

  • You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc. well and are able to see both the forest and the trees.
  • You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
  • You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence. Prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus.
  • You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
  • You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

General Summary:

Qualcomm’s Automotive Platform Systems team designs and delivers reference platforms used for post-silicon validation, software development, and high-volume production test of Qualcomm Automotive chipsets. These highly integrated reference designs incorporate our high‑performance SoCs and a wide range of digital and analog peripherals required to showcase our performance in use cases for both Snapdragon Cockpit In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) and Snapdragon Ride Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) applications.

The APS Software team is composed of embedded software engineers with deep expertise in low‑level device drivers, firmware, and hardware/software interfaces. The team develops bare‑metal software and validation firmware used to bring up, test, and validate Qualcomm reference platforms. Work is performed in a fast‑paced, hands‑on environment that directly supports hardware design validation, factory test enablement, and early platform bring‑up across multiple global sites.

This role requires strong technical depth in low‑level embedded software development and close collaboration with hardware, silicon, and systems teams. The ideal candidate is a self‑motivated problem solver who can work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team.

Technical Skills and Experience:

  • Strong expertise in device driver and bare‑metal software development, including register‑level programming, GPIO configuration, and hardware bring‑up.
  • Working knowledge of hardware interfaces and protocols including SPI, USB, I2C/I3C, I2S, PCIe, UART, UFS, DP, MIPI CSI/DSI, CAN, and Ethernet.
  • Proficiency with debug and bring‑up tools such as Lauterbach Trace32 and JTAG‑based debuggers.
  • Experience with common Automotive peripherals such as ASIL-D Microcontrollers, CAN Transceivers, Camera/Display SerDes, PCIe Switches, Ethernet Swtiches and PHYs.
  • Hands‑on experience using lab equipment including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and bench power supplies.
  • Solid understanding of ARM and/or RISC‑V processor architectures.
  • Experience using software revision control systems such as Perforce.
  • Ability to interpret datasheets, hardware design documents, schematics, and CCA drawings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain bare‑metal firmware and low‑level device drivers to enable bring‑up and validation of Qualcomm Automotive reference platforms.
  • Perform early hardware bring‑up and debug of new boards and chipsets, identifying issues across hardware, firmware, and system boundaries.
  • Implement and extend test firmware used for platform validation, manufacturing test, and factory enablement.
  • Collaborate closely with hardware design, silicon, systems, and validation teams to define requirements and resolve hardware/software integration issues.
  • Analyze failures using schematics, register traces, logic analyzer data, and lab instrumentation, and drive issues to resolution.
  • Support multiple platforms and hardware variants, adapting software to different configurations and use cases.
  • Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and best practices for low‑level embedded software development.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on embedded software, debugging techniques, and platform bring‑up.
  • Participate in cross‑site and cross‑functional reviews, providing clear technical communication and status updates.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
    OR
    Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
    OR
    PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  • 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in embedded systems development, device drivers, or firmware development.
  • 8+ years of hands‑on experience with engineering lab tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and JTAG debuggers.
  • 8+ years of programming experience using languages such as C, C++, Python, Assembly, or similar.

title: Shop Helper
description:
The Shop Helper supports technicians and the service team in the safe, efficient maintenance and repair of cranes and lifting equipment. Typical duties include:

Essential Functions

  • Keep shop, yard, and work areas clean and organized (sweeping, trash removal, wiping down equipment, spill clean-up).
  • Assist with moving cranes, components, and attachments under supervision (using forklifts, overhead cranes, pallet jacks, etc., as trained).
  • Set up and tear down work areas for incoming jobs (stands, cribbing, blocking, drip pans, lighting, extension cords)
    • Help technicians with basic tasks: removing/installing covers, panels, guards, and components as directed.
    • Hold, position, and secure parts or tools during repairs.
    • Run for parts, tools, and supplies from the parts room, yard, or trucks.
    • Help with basic lubricating and greasing, checking fluid levels, and simple inspections under direct supervision
      • Clean and put away shop tools, cords, and hoses at the end of jobs.
      • Inspect basic shop tools for obvious damage and report issues.
      • Help maintain shop equipment (cleaning pressure washers, welders’ leads, torches, etc.).
      • Ensure ladders, stands, rigging, and cribbing are stored properly.
        • Assist with rigging and moving components under the direction of a qualified rigger/technician.
        • Help set up blocking and cribbing for booms, counterweights, and other heavy components.
        • Follow all rigging and signaling instructions from designated personnel.
          • Follow all shop safety policies, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout instructions.
          • Maintain clear walkways, exits, and equipment access areas.
          • Immediately report unsafe conditions, leaks, spills, or damage to equipment.
          • Participate in safety meetings and basic safety training as required.

          Other duties and qualifications

            • Assist with fueling, washing, and detailing cranes and service vehicles as directed.
            • Help stage units and equipment for pickup, delivery, or field service.
            • Perform other tasks assigned by the Shop Foreman, Service Manager, or lead technicians.
            • Comfortable working around heavy equipment and large components.
            • Able to lift [e.g., 50–75 lbs] and perform physically demanding tasks.
            • Willing to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
            • Good attitude, dependable, and able to follow directions.
            • Basic mechanical aptitude and hand-tool knowledge is a plus.

            This role requires to drive company vehicle. Good driving record required.

            Pay range: $20.00 to $21.00

title: GIS Technician - Entry
description:

Location: Hickam Air Force Base, Hawaii.

description:

Qualcomm relentlessly innovates transforming businesses, enriching lives and fortifying societies. Our solutions are pivotal in crafting a smarter, interconnected world. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. Join us for our U.S. 2027 summer intern class!

Maximize Your Opportunities:
Our internship hiring model routes candidates from this application into multiple project specific roles. Your "Profile Visibility" choice will guide how we manage your data across our systems. To be considered for the full breadth of internship opportunities, select the option to use your profile data for "Any Roles Globally".

Steps:

  • Log Into Your Eightfold Candidate Home Account

  • Open Settings

Role Overview

As a Qualcomm RF/Analog or Mixed-Signal Engineering Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of what exists and help establish the new standards for tomorrow. Project opportunities span 5G/6G mmWave, RF system design, transceiver performance analysis and optimization, RFIC/Analog IC design, PA architectures, RF front-end engineering, signal processing/integration, RF microwave design, power amplifiers, WLAN/Bluetooth LNAs, ADC/DAC, and more.

This internship supports two technical tracks:

  • RF/Analog Design

  • Mixed-Signal Design

Based on your resume you may be aligned to one or more of these tracks. Please clearly indicate your track interest(s) in your resume, as this is the only way to communicate preferences during the recruiting process.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s, master’s, or Ph.D. degree program in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field

  • Must be available for 11–14 weeks during Summer 2027 (May–September)

  • Expected graduation date of November 2027 or later

Preferred Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a Master’s or PhD degree program in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field

  • Candidates actively pursuing a degree with an anticipated graduation between November 2027 and June 2028

Track 1: RF/Analog Design

  • RF, microwave theory, antenna theory

  • Analog IC design or RFIC design

  • Electromagnetics, digital pre-distortion, RF matching networks

  • S-parameters, linear systems, filter design

  • Digital communication systems, noise figure, linearity (IP3), impedance matching

  • Memory system design and analysis

  • High-speed interface system design

  • Printed circuit board design

  • Electrical system analysis and modeling

  • Signal and power integrity (SIPI) analysis

  • Power delivery network (PDN) design/analysis

  • Transmission lines, power amplifiers, transmitters, receivers, ACLR

  • Layout experience and chip tape-out

  • Programming experience in Perl, MATLAB, Cadence, HFSS

Track 2: Mixed-Signal Design

  • Mixed-signal IP and high-speed interface (ADC/DAC, PLL, sensor, SerDes, DDR) architecture definition, design, implementation, and SoC integration

  • RTL coding, lint checks, CDC checks, DFT updates, formal equivalency checks, ECO implementation

  • SERDES (PCIe, USB), memory (DDR, HBM), or 2D/3D die-to-die (D2D) interface system exploration and co-optimization

  • Static timing analysis and optimization of high-speed critical paths and complex mixed-signal IPs

  • Cadence design environment

  • Low-power analog/digital design

  • Programming experience in Perl, Verilog, Shell, Python, Tcl, SystemVerilog

Qualcomm’s Internship Program

Our interns join world-class teams to help define and build what is next for mobility and the world. You’ll be paired with a mentor with visibility to your project and team, receive support from your manager, and have access to the entire Qualcomm employee community to ensure your success. To round out your summer internship, we host professional development workshops, social events, cross-functional speaker sessions, and an executive speaker series. In addition to competitive hourly pay and accrued vacation time, you will receive relocation coverage and furnished housing accommodations for the duration of your internship.

Internship opportunities may be available in the following locations, depending on team and project needs: Austin, Boulder, Boxborough, Bridgewater, Chandler, Irvine, New York City, Louisville, Raleigh, San Diego, Santa Clara, and Seattle.

title: Senior Product Manager, Atom Engine
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Atom Engine based in United States.

This senior individual contributor role will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for content within a sophisticated simulation and operational planning environment. You will translate user needs and organizational priorities into clear product direction and actionable requirements. The role combines product strategy, systems thinking, workflow optimization, and close collaboration with content specialists and technical teams. You will help define the quality, consistency, usability, and effectiveness of scenarios, units, and entities that support complex exercises. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, and domain experts, you will resolve ambiguity and drive focused execution. Your decisions will influence both the content itself and the processes and tools used to create, validate, maintain, and improve it. This is a fully remote opportunity for a product leader interested in simulation technology and the defense and military technology space.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the vision and strategic roadmap for Atom Engine content, ensuring it evolves in line with user needs and broader product priorities.
  • Partner with users, content specialists, and internal stakeholders to identify content gaps, gather requirements, and establish clear priorities for what should be built and why.
  • Translate broad goals and user needs into actionable product requirements, priorities, and execution plans.
  • Own and continuously improve the content lifecycle, including how content is requested, scoped, created, validated, maintained, and reused.
  • Identify process bottlenecks and prioritize improvements to workflows, supporting tools, and production practices.
  • Define clear standards and expectations for the accuracy, consistency, usability, quality, and fitness for purpose of scenarios, units, and entities.
  • Resolve ambiguity, manage competing requests, and make timely scope and prioritization decisions that enable content specialists to focus on effective delivery.
  • Collaborate across Product, Engineering, Design, and subject-matter experts to align content requirements with product capabilities, technical dependencies, and broader user experiences.
  • Use exercise feedback, user research, production data, and other insights to evaluate content effectiveness and guide continuous improvement.
  • Balance quality, speed, maintainability, and scalability when making product and process decisions.
  • Build alignment across technical teams, domain experts, users, and senior leadership while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated experience owning strategy and execution for a complex product, content portfolio, production workflow, or similarly sophisticated domain.
    • Strong product judgment and the ability to prioritize competing needs, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and translate broad objectives into clear, actionable requirements.
    • Deep understanding of simulation technologies and workflows, with an appreciation for how content quality influences user experience and operational outcomes.
    • Systems-oriented approach to product and process improvement, with the ability to understand how individual content decisions affect broader experiences and workflows.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with attention to detail and the ability to work effectively within complex systems.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and build alignment among technical teams, domain specialists, users, and senior leaders.
    • Collaborative and pragmatic working style, with respect for specialist expertise and confidence in making decisions when information is incomplete.
    • Comfortable working autonomously, navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of results.
    • Understanding of, or strong interest in, the military and defense technology sector.
    • U.S. citizenship is required.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:

Responsible for architecting solutions that will achieve customer business outcomes either within a specific technical domain, or across the broader company portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third-party components (e.g. software and integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.

Management Level Definition:

Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time-to-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates unique mastery within the company in one or more solution domains as well as the customer's technical and business environment.
  • Orchestrates the design of complex proposals to deliver and communicate tangible business value to customers.
  • Mitigates risk to the company by managing both customer and company stakeholder expectations.
  • Critical review proposal, applies market intelligence and thought leadership to translate the functional view into a technical view, enhancing proposed workload-optimized solutions.
  • Provides input to all global business units to address key end-customer IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
  • Leads the team to develop and present high-level, unique, and imaginative outcome-based solutions to customer business challenges, translating the business needs of the customer into a functional solution design aligned to those needs.
  • Communicates HPE’s end solution value propositions in the language of the customer and demonstrates how the proposition aligns to business outcomes and customer needs.
  • Develops and maintains adjacent technology knowledge, along with in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies and trends.
  • Contributes to the industry for one or more domains with an active presence at conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support), social media, business events, etc.
  • Monitors changing competitive landscape (emerging competitors, start-ups etc.).
  • Drives the Account Business Planning process, leverage knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
  • Facilitates and leads deep-dive discussions with the client and accounts teams to build customer relationships, understand business needs, evaluate the customer's ecosystem and advocate and present technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
  • Identifies acceptable technical solution trade-offs, risks, and suggests possible remediation.
  • Drives collaboration among internal account teams, sets direction, provides guidance, and engages the full portfolio of partners to build effective solution strategies aligned to customer's technical and business challenges.
  • Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver an effective solution to the customer.
  • Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up-selling, and cross-selling opportunities) within the account.
  • Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
  • Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
  • Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
  • Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
  • Engages with and builds consultative presence and advisory influence with VPs, CxO, and line-of-business (LOB) management and customer thought leaders.
  • Anticipates customer needs and proactively engages partners and resources to design innovative solutions and generate customer demand.
  • Proactively shares knowledge with peers and actively helps develop knowledge and expertise within the Presales community.

Education and Experience:

  • Advanced degree in technology or related field preferred, or equivalent technical qualifications
  • 12+ years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling;
  • 2+ Industry standard relevant technology certifications or equivalent experience expected.
  • Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Unique mastery and experience leading solution configurations and overall architecture design and creating, managing, and positioning demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
  • Unique mastery of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, and adjacent solution domain(s), showing how they can be combined to address customer needs, and how the workload solution can be adapted for strategic customer and industry solutions.
  • Unique mastery with expertise and deep working knowledge with the as-a-service (aaS) business model, business value, and complete ecosystem and how that drives aaS strategic goals within one or more domains.
  • Expert ability to collaborate cross-functionally and across HPE to generate new revenue through increased subscription consumption and other aaS models.
  • Mastery of executive-level written, verbal and nonverbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, with ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as need to perform job requirements.
  • Demonstrates unique mastery of discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point-of-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
  • Unique mastery of financial and business acumen- sales cycle, funnel management, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage - including typical KPIs important to CxOs; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
  • Unique mastery of consultative and value selling skills, advisory influence, and executive gravitas, including presenting, white boarding, storytelling, objection-handling, and closing skills.
  • Unique mastery of company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
  • Strong resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
  • Hands on experience with multiple products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
  • Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
  • Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Unique mastery of project and time management skills or experience with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
  • Unique mastery of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization.
  • Unique mastery of and understanding of company’s preferred go-to-market strategy, global context, coverage options relative to partners and has expert knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals within area of specialization.
  • Unique mastery of strategic planning and account planning skills and expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.
